sourceContent.headline: Build autonomous AI agents with Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Learn how Java developers can build production-ready autonomous AI agents using Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI. This post walks through tool calling, conversation memory, resilience patterns, and multi-agent orchestration, then deploys the agent to AWS with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
paragraphs: The solution consists of two deployable systems that share common patterns: Travel agent – A single autonomous agent with tool calling (weather lookups, itinerary search), streaming responses, conversation memory, and resilience patterns.

To follow along with this walkthrough, you need the following: Spring Boot – 4.1 (with Spring AI 2.0 and spring-ai-agentcore 2.0) AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI) – v2, configured with credentials.
Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI close those gaps, so Java teams can build autonomous AI agents that plan, call tools and APIs, and maintain context across multi-turn conversations.

Java teams have established JVM tooling, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and operational patterns, yet taking AI agents from prototype to production is hard: agent frameworks do not solve scalability, governance, security, and operational concerns by default. Amazon Bedrock and Spring AI close those gaps, so Java teams can build autonomous AI agents that plan, call tools and APIs, and maintain context across multi-turn conversations. Agentic AI is moving beyond prompt-response interactions toward autonomous systems that execute complex multi-step tasks.

Java remains one of the widely used programming languages in enterprise software. Teams have existing CI/CD pipelines, operational expertise, and established patterns built around the JVM. Spring AI brings AI capabilities to the JVM through familiar Spring patterns: auto-configuration, dependency injection, and composable advisors. Developers can build AI agents using the same idioms they use for REST APIs, security, and data access.

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is a platform to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale, with any framework or model. With AgentCore, you can build, deploy, and operate AI agents at scale. It is framework-agnostic and model-agnostic: you bring your preferred agent framework and foundation model (FM). With AgentCore, you can access the production infrastructure you need: managed runtime, memory, browser automation, code execution, and identity management.

articles.title: Anthropic says AI is eroding Nvidia's CUDA lead, cutting an AMD chip switch from months to three days
articles.descEn: Anthropic claims it used AI itself to breach Nvidia's CUDA moat. The company's in-house model Mythos reportedly ported Claude to AMD GPUs in just three days, with almost no human intervention. Anthropic now runs Claude on four chip families and aims to cut costs and reduce vendor dependencies.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic says AI is eroding Nvidia's CUDA lead, cutting an AMD chip switch from months to three days
summaryLinesEn: According to Anthropic's S-1/A registration statement filed with the SEC on November 10, 2026, Nvidia is also participating in a conditional private placement totaling $26 billion , in which seven technology companies are subscribing to shares at the IPO price.
And because of its dominance in the AI chip market, Nvidia currently enjoys a margin of more than 70 percent, which is unusually high for hardware.

articles.title: Helsing built an AI system that prepares targets for weapons systems and says every decision will carry a human name
articles.descEn: Helsing has unveiled Clarity, an AI platform that uses agents to distill sensor data into target recommendations for weapons systems, all under human oversight and European control. But experience from the Iran war, Gaza, and a near-miss involving China shows that the speed of automation and data fusion create risks that are hard to contain.
articles.titleEn: Helsing built an AI system that prepares targets for weapons systems and says every decision will carry a human name
summaryLinesEn: The problem is sharper in Gaza, where according to investigations by +972 Magazine and Local Call, Israel's Lavender system for a time flagged up to 37,000 Palestinians as potential targets.

According to CNN, the US military nearly boarded a Chinese ship because a chatbot falsely claimed in an intelligence report that it was carrying nuclear weapons program components after combining open and classified data and misidentifying the cargo.
The use of comparable systems in Iran, in Gaza, and in a near-miss involving China shows where those promises break down.

articles.title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
articles.descEn: Adobe’s sneaks can transform images into explorable 3D scenes, design AI characters by talking to them, and turn photo editing into a copy/paste process.
articles.titleEn: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
summaryLinesEn: Almost all of these projects are built around Adobe’s generative AI developments, however, and given AI tools now play a central role in the company’s growth strategy, it’s likely that at least some of the experiments will see an official launch.
While the visuals in the 3D environment are pixelated and ill–defined, the resolution quality is restored when you select your chosen angle.
In some cases the features almost seem like toys, but with the benefit of allowing you to make practical changes to creative projects.

articles.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
articles.descEn: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.
articles.titleEn: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
summaryLinesEn: On Wednesday, the startup said it had raised $13 million in seed funding to make that happen.

As businesses try to optimize their AI expense, Plurai’s approach could prove a real advantage, since IT leaders are seeing that “frontier-capable models are out of distribution with my specific data, and the cost of these things isn’t sustainable in the long term,” Miyara said.

LiveBench 2.0 shows Claude Fable 5.2 and ChatGPT-6 Astra succeeding on 82.9 and 75.6 out of 100 tasks, respectively, and an effort by the AI infrastructure company EON to test agents in a simulated corporate environment found the most successful model tested, Claude Opus 4.8, performed tasks at 76.8% accuracy.

articles.title: Databricks' new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
articles.descEn: At 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.
articles.titleEn: Databricks' new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
summaryLinesEn: Instead of a product demo, he fired up his actual agent and walked me through his most recent chats and charts.
He showed me how it summarized a big sales pitch to a prospect that went poorly — including the features the prospect said it needed before buying.
As for the risk that agents will ratchet up corporate AI costs, Ghodsi has an answer for that, too.

Google tests Tabletop, letting groups build planning tools with an AI agent
Google LLC today began testing Tabletop, a Google Labs experiment in which groups share an online space and ask an artificial intelligence agent to build the planning tools they need.

In a blog post , Roman Nurik, design and engineering lead at Google Labs, wrote that coordinating a family trip or a potluck goes more smoothly when the whole group can pitch in from one place. Whoever sets up a space adds the links, files and ideas the group has collected, and from there a request to @tabletop produces the tool.

articles.descEn: The chatbot was already available through the Google Maps app.
articles.titleEn: Google brings the Gemini app to Apple CarPlay - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Google said you can pick up where you left off with Gemini in your car or start a new conversation with the chatbot.

Use Gemini in CarPlay to catch-up on what you have coming up in your schedule, talk through your inbox, or... pic.twitter.com/1s4luZ6q0v To use the assistant on CarPlay, you'll need to make sure you have the latest version of the Gemini app on your iPhone and the microphone permissions are on.

The company suggested drivers could use Gemini to prep for a meeting during their commute, catch up on emails, hear their Daily Brief or get recommendations for local places worth checking out in an area.

articles.title: United is restricting AI agents from booking flights - Engadget
articles.descEn: The airline believes AI poses security risks and may violate DOT and FAA rules.
articles.titleEn: United is restricting AI agents from booking flights - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: During its recent third-quarter earnings call, Uber shared that it handled 320 million trips and deliveries during the week of Halloween; of those, AI agents were responsible for 500 Uber Eats orders and only four rides.
Even if a large number of people are downloading apps like Muse , it seems like letting an agent shop for you isn't as frictionless or foolproof as it needs to be to catch on.
United Airlines has announced it will change ticking policies to restrict AI agents' from booking flights through its website, third-party travel agencies and flight aggregators.

summaryLines: 최근 3분기 실적 발표에서 Uber는 할로윈 주간에 3억 2천만 건의 운행 및 배달을 처리했다고 밝힘 · 그 중 AI 에이전트는 500건의 Uber Eats 주문과 4건의 차량 서비스만 담당함
많은 사람들이 Muse와 같은 앱을 다운로드하고 있더라도 에이전트가 귀하를 대신하여 쇼핑하도록 하는 것은 따라잡기 위해 필요한 만큼 마찰이 없거나 완벽하지는 않은 것 같음
유나이티드 항공(United Airlines)은 AI 에이전트가 자사 웹사이트, 제3자 여행사, 항공편 정보 제공업체를 통해 항공편을 예약하는 것을 제한하기 위해 시세 정책을 변경할 것이라고 발표함

articles.title: A 13-Year-Old Asked AI About Suicide on Her School Laptop. It Didn’t Get Flagged for Weeks
articles.descEn: The young girl’s parents allege that she used Gemini via her school Chromebook to plan her suicide, but the school’s monitoring systems didn’t know until it was almost too late.
articles.titleEn: A 13-Year-Old Asked AI About Suicide on Her School Laptop. It Didn’t Get Flagged for Weeks
summaryLinesEn: A 2022 white paper from the EdWeek Research Center found that in a survey of 1,000 American K-12 educators, 96 percent of Gaggle users believed that it helped to “keep students safe from suicide and/or self-harm.”
As classrooms continue to rely on Google’s low-cost offerings, including Gemini, their ability to keep up with the potential risks is front and center.

A 13-year-old girl spent three months using her school-issued laptop to discuss depression, research suicide, and plan her funeral before self-harm-monitoring software finally prompted school officials to alert her parents, who intervened and stopped her, according to a lawsuit filed this month by her parents.

summaryLines: EdWeek Research Center의 2022년 백서에 따르면 미국 K-12 교육자 1,000명을 대상으로 한 설문조사에서 Gaggle 사용자의 96%가 Gaggle이 '학생들을 자살 및/또는 자해로부터 안전하게 보호'하는 데 도움이 된다고 믿었음
교실에서는 Gemini를 포함한 Google의 저렴한 제품에 계속 의존하고 있기 때문에 잠재적인 위험에 대처하는 능력이 가장 중요함

articles.title: US corporate AI spending hits a new high in October, but growth slows to 1.65 percent
articles.descEn: According to the Ramp AI Index, US corporate AI spending rose just 1.65 percent in October 2026. One percent of companies still drive 80 percent of revenue for OpenAI and Anthropic. Customer support is emerging as a new growth driver, but it may bring lower margins than the coding business that has fueled spending so far.
articles.titleEn: US corporate AI spending hits a new high in October, but growth slows to 1.65 percent
summaryLinesEn: US corporate AI spending rose just 1.65 percent month over month in October 2026 to a new high, according to the Ramp AI Index, with the top one percent of companies paying a median of $10,200 per employee per month while the typical company spent $16.32.
Usage volume is growing faster than spending, so AI keeps getting cheaper, driven by competitive pressure between OpenAI and Anthropic along with open-weight models from China.
US corporate AI spending hit a new high in October 2026, but growth was modest.

articles.title: Google joins the decision-model wave with Gemini Decision 1, scoring 1,000 questions in a single pass
articles.descEn: Google Deepmind's new Gemini Decisions API evaluates up to 1,000 closed-ended questions in a single pass across text, images, audio, and video. Gemini Decision 1 returns results in 150 to 250 milliseconds at roughly five times lower cost than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, according to Google.
articles.titleEn: Google joins the decision-model wave with Gemini Decision 1, scoring 1,000 questions in a single pass
summaryLinesEn: The underlying model, Gemini Decision 1 , processes up to 1,000 independent questions in a single pass across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs.
After the startup Jev introduced its version, OpenAI , Cloudflare , and Microsoft quickly followed with similar offerings.
The API costs $0.10 per million input tokens with no output-token charge, about five times cheaper than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite according to Google.

articles.titleEn: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
summaryLinesEn: Google has cooked up a new experimental AI tool called Tabletop that generates customized collaborative hubs to help you coordinate with family, and friends.

“Just add in your links, files and ideas, then prompt @tabletop — or pick a starter template — to generate custom interactive trip itineraries, dinner polls, expense splitters and tournament brackets,” Google Labs design and engineering lead Roman Nurik said in the blog post.
Follow Follow See All Tech Tabletop provides customizable, collaborative spaces for all your personal planning needs.

articles.title: With $720M round, Britain's Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
articles.descEn: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.
articles.titleEn: With $720M round, Britain's Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
summaryLinesEn: Fractile , a British startup developing AI chips, has raised a $720 million Series C backed by Britain’s Sovereign AI Fund with hopes of “ensuring the U.K. has a greater stake in the hardware that will underpin its future economy,” its government stated .

In a LinkedIn post , Fractile CEO Walter Goodwin wrote that “there is still a lot of work ahead” for the company, and that the new funding will enable the startup to “ship [its] first chips and systems next year.”
According to the British government, the valuation was “over £5 billion” — quite possibly $7 billion, a figure reported both by the Financial Times and a Reuters source .

Fractile의 CEO인 Walter Goodwin은 LinkedIn 게시물에서 "아직 회사에 할 일이 많이 남아 있다"며 새로운 자금 조달을 통해 스타트업이 "내년에 첫 번째 칩과 시스템을 출시"할 수 있을 것이라고 썼음
영국 정부에 따르면 그 평가액은 "50억 파운드 이상"이었음 · 파이낸셜 타임즈와 로이터 소식통에 따르면 이 수치는 아마도 70억 달러일 가능성이 높음

articles.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
articles.descEn: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay upfront, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.
articles.titleEn: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
summaryLinesEn: CoreWeave reported $3.66 billion in revenue, up 168% from the year prior, but it also posted a $709 million net loss and $846 million in quarterly interest expense.

CoreWeave also said it expects about $9 billion in customer prepayments and deposits over the next three months, including more than $3 billion tied to signing new customer contracts for capacity it has already built, which requires no additional spending on hardware.

Instead, CoreWeave’s plan is to rely on loans backed by specific customer contracts, drawing on funds as needed to finance most of infrastructure it still has to build to deliver on its significant backlog of $132.5 billion.

localization.title: CoreWeave는 AI 성장 자금을 조달하기 위해 고객 선불, 계약 단축으로 전환함
summaryLines: CoreWeave는 전년 대비 168% 증가한 36억 6천만 달러의 매출을 기록했지만 순손실은 7억 900만 달러, 분기 이자 비용은 8억 4600만 달러를 기록함
CoreWeave는 또한 향후 3개월 동안 약 90억 달러의 고객 선불금과 예치금을 예상하고 있으며, 여기에는 이미 구축한 용량에 대한 신규 고객 계약 체결과 관련된 30억 달러 이상이 포함되어 있으며, 이는 하드웨어에 대한 추가 지출이 필요하지 않음
대신 CoreWeave의 계획은 특정 고객 계약이 뒷받침되는 대출에 의존하여 1,325억 달러의 상당한 잔액을 제공하기 위해 아직 구축해야 하는 대부분의 인프라에 자금을 조달하는 데 필요한 자금을 끌어오는 것임

articles.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
articles.descEn: AlphaGenome 2 is our next-generation DNA sequence model that bridges single-cell biology and human genetics, predicting how variants affect human cell types.
articles.titleEn: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
summaryLinesEn: We trained AlphaGenome 2 on both bulk and single-cell data from human and mouse samples, including over 107 million individual cell profiles.
We expanded its reach with AlphaGenome Atlas , a platform containing predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome.

AlphaGenome 2 extends enhancer-gene mapping to primary human cell types — such as brain astrocytes, which support and protect neurons — helping researchers connect regulatory variants to their target genes in the specific cells where disease unfolds.

summaryLines: 우리는 1억 7백만 개 이상의 개별 세포 프로필을 포함하여 인간과 마우스 샘플의 대량 및 단일 세포 데이터에 대해 AlphaGenome 2를 교육함
우리는 인간 게놈에서 가능한 90억 개의 단일 문자 변화에 대한 예측을 포함하는 플랫폼인 AlphaGenome Atlas를 통해 범위를 확장함
AlphaGenome 2는 인핸서 유전자 매핑을 뉴런을 지원하고 보호하는 뇌 성상교세포와 같은 일차 인간 세포 유형으로 확장하여 연구자들이 질병이 전개되는 특정 세포의 표적 유전자에 조절 변이체를 연결하도록 돕음

summaryLinesEn: Token pooling-aware training raises that retention to 97.8% at the same storage budget!
At 4 bits per residual coordinate, 200 vectors of 128 dimensions require 12.8 KB of quantized residuals per document, or 12.8 GB across a million documents.

articles.titleEn: Economic Security as a New Priority for AI Governance
summaryLinesEn: Use of AI to identify and rectify cybersecurity vulnerabilities has increased sharply following the revelations surrounding Claude Mythos.
Looking ahead, economic security risk assessment will become essential, alongside existing measures to address more familiar risks such as hallucinations and information leaks.
Particular attention should be paid to establishing governance frameworks that account for export controls on AI models.

articles.title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
articles.descEn: A Blog post by QVAC on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
summaryLinesEn: BotPsy achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) tool-use and agentic performance for its size, outperforming every model of up to 1.2B parameters that we tested (Figures 1 and 2).
As intelligence per parameter continues to improve rapidly, we aim to stand at the forefront of this shift toward performant, privacy-focused, self-hosted models.

Twice the performance of its base model: BotPsy roughly doubles the agentic capability of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Think on key benchmarks: BFCL v4 rises from 23.4 to 44.0, ACEBench from 30.1 to 58.7, and τ-bench from 23.2 to 51.5 (mean of the retail, telecom and banking subsets).

summaryLines: BotPsy는 크기에 비해 최첨단(SOTA) 도구 사용 및 에이전트 성능을 달성하여 테스트한 최대 1.2B 매개변수의 모든 모델보다 성능이 뛰어납니다(그림 1 및 2)

articles.descEn: Arm Neoverse powers leading TOP500 and Green500 supercomputers, delivering scalable performance and energy efficiency.
articles.titleEn: Arm powers the world's most advanced and energy-efficient supercomputers
summaryLinesEn: Built on Bull’s BullSequana XH3000 liquid-cooled architecture, JUPITER is powered by nearly 24,000 NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchips containing more than 1.7 million Arm Neoverse cores.
In 2025, the UK’s most powerful supercomputer, Isambard-AI, launched with 5,448 NVIDIA Grace Hopper GPUs, underpinned by Arm-based CPU architecture, AArch64.
Bringing advanced machine learning and signal processing to smaller, smarter devices, with up to 3x the vector compute capability and 2x the vector power efficiency of Cortex-M33.

localization.title: Arm은 세계에서 가장 발전되고 에너지 효율적인 슈퍼컴퓨터를 구동함
summaryLines: Bull의 BullSequana XH3000 수냉식 아키텍처를 기반으로 구축된 JUPITER는 170만개 이상의 Arm Neoverse 코어를 포함하는 약 24,000개의 NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper 슈퍼칩으로 구동됨
2025년에 영국의 가장 강력한 슈퍼컴퓨터인 Isambard-AI는 Arm 기반 CPU 아키텍처인 AArch64를 기반으로 하는 5,448개의 NVIDIA Grace Hopper GPU를 탑재하여 출시됨
Cortex-M33에 비해 최대 3배의 벡터 컴퓨팅 기능과 2배의 벡터 전력 효율성을 통해 고급 기계 학습 및 신호 처리를 더 작고 스마트한 장치에 제공함

articles.descEn: Many of the 16 conservation technology projects award winners are built with Arm-based technologies due to their power efficiency, scalability, and ability to run AI and data processing directly on devices operating in remote environments.
articles.titleEn: Announcing the winners of the WILDLABS Awards 2026
summaryLinesEn: Today, July 7, 2026, we are thrilled to announce the winners of the awards, with $360,000 being distributed across 16 conservation technology projects.
“For me, what’s fascinating is the breadth of the projects,” said Rosalie Tribe, senior manager of Social Impact and Innovation at Arm and a judge for this year’s awards.
“This year’s response shows that we are tapping into a real need in the sector,” said Adrien Pajot, project manager at WILDLABS.

articles.titleEn: Arm AppReady for Windows gives developers a faster path to native Windows on Arm applications
summaryLinesEn: The next wave of applications will define the Windows on Arm experience As Arm-powered Windows devices reach more users, the value of the experience will show up in the software – how quickly a creative app makes content available, how smoothly a security product operates in the background, how efficiently a development environment handles local workloads, or how responsive and reliably an AI-enabled application runs without excessive power consumption.

The Windows on Arm ecosystem continues to expand, driven by growing OEM adoption and rising user demand for lightweight, power efficient, responsive, and AI-enabled PCs and laptops, as well as increasing investment from software vendors in building native Arm versions of their applications.

summaryLines: 차세대 애플리케이션은 Windows on Arm 경험을 정의할 것임 · Arm 기반 Windows 장치가 더 많은 사용자에게 도달함에 따라 경험의 가치는 소프트웨어에 나타날 것임 · 즉, 창의적인 앱이 콘텐츠를 얼마나 빨리 제공하는지, 보안 제품이 백그라운드에서 얼마나 원활하게 작동하는지, 개발 환경이 로컬 워크로드를 얼마나 효율적으로 처리하는지, AI 지원 애플리케이션이 과도한 전력 소비 없이 얼마나 반응적이고 안정적으로 실행되는지 등이 여기에 해당됨
Windows on Arm 에코시스템은 OEM 채택 증가와 경량, 전력 효율성, 반응성이 뛰어난 AI 지원 PC 및 노트북에 대한 사용자 수요 증가, 애플리케이션의 기본 Arm 버전 구축에 대한 소프트웨어 공급업체의 투자 증가로 인해 지속적으로 확장되고 있음

주요 종속성에 Arm 네이티브 버전의 Windows가 있는지 확인하세요 · 빌드 시스템, 컴파일러 설정, 설치 프로그램 및 플러그인을 검토함 · 아키텍처별 코드와 성능에 중요한 경로를 식별함 · 기본 Windows on Arm 개발에 대한 Arm 및 Microsoft 지침을 찾아보세요 · 코드를 스캔하고, 이식성 문제를 식별하고, 이식 작업 속도를 높이는 데 도움이 되는 AI 지원 도구와 사례를 살펴보세요

articles.title: From host node to heterogeneous rack: Rethinking the AI CPU
articles.descEn: Learn why CPUs are becoming critical to agentic AI, heterogeneous racks and the next era of AI data centers.
articles.titleEn: From host node to heterogeneous rack: Rethinking the AI CPU
summaryLinesEn: Decode is the phase where the system generates the response token by token; as context grows, it becomes increasingly constrained by memory bandwidth, memory capacity and KV cache movement.

As AI inference evolves from single-pass model calls to multi-step agentic pipelines, infrastructure design is shifting from a narrow focus on accelerator scale to a broader question of system composition: how to assemble the right compute for each phase of the agentic AI workflow.
Infrastructure teams need to evaluate CPU capacity according to the distinct work being done at each layer of the inference pipeline.

localization.title: 호스트 노드에서 이기종 랙으로 · AI CPU에 대한 재고
summaryLines: 디코드는 시스템이 토큰별로 응답 토큰을 생성하는 단계임 · 컨텍스트가 커짐에 따라 메모리 대역폭, 메모리 용량 및 KV 캐시 이동으로 인해 점점 더 제한됨
AI 추론이 단일 패스 모델 호출에서 다단계 에이전트 파이프라인으로 발전함에 따라 인프라 설계는 가속기 규모에 대한 좁은 초점에서 시스템 구성, 즉 에이전트 AI 워크플로의 각 단계에 적합한 컴퓨팅을 조합하는 방법에 대한 더 넓은 질문으로 전환되고 있음
인프라 팀은 추론 파이프라인의 각 계층에서 수행되는 고유한 작업에 따라 CPU 용량을 평가해야 함

articles.titleEn: What Arm-based innovations happened in May 2026?
summaryLinesEn: The project recognizes 29 ASL alphabet characters with approximately 3.5ms NPU inference, keeping video processing private and on-device while avoiding the latency, connectivity and data security challenges of cloud-based systems.

🎥 As AI-driven design workloads scale, @Cadence is advancing EDA… pic.twitter.com/dVxTq5FdBw The conversation reflects a broader shift: Arm is increasingly part of the foundation for the next generation of AI-driven engineering and data center innovation.

With results including more than 2x faster audio generation and roughly 4x lower DiT submodel memory usage, the work shows how optimized CPU inference can help developers move from PyTorch to deployment more efficiently.

articles.title: Supermicro and Arm advance compute for the agentic AI era
articles.descEn: Supermicro and Arm are launching Arm AGI CPU-based servers for efficient, scalable agentic AI infrastructure.
articles.titleEn: Supermicro and Arm advance compute for the agentic AI era
summaryLinesEn: Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.

For customers adopting Open Rack V3 (ORV3) environments, Supermicro also introduced the liquid-cooled 2U4N ORV3 ARS-242TP-QNR-LCC server, enabling up to 168 AGI CPUs per rack while maintaining deployment flexibility for modern data centers.

Built with up to 136 Arm Neoverse V3 cores, 12 DDR5 memory channels at up to 8800 MT/s, and PCIe Gen6 connectivity within a 300W power envelope, the AGI CPU is designed to deliver exceptional compute density and energy efficiency for AI-first data centers.
articles.summary:
Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.
For customers adopting Open Rack V3 (ORV3) environments, Supermicro also introduced the liquid-cooled 2U4N ORV3 ARS-242TP-QNR-LCC server, enabling up to 168 AGI CPUs per rack while maintaining deployment flexibility for modern data centers.
Built with up to 136 Arm Neoverse V3 cores, 12 DDR5 memory channels at up to 8800 MT/s, and PCIe Gen6 connectivity within a 300W power envelope, the AGI CPU is designed to deliver exceptional compute density and energy efficiency for AI-first data centers.

sourceContent.headline: Supermicro and Arm advance compute for the agentic AI era
sourceContent.description: Supermicro and Arm are launching Arm AGI CPU-based servers for efficient, scalable agentic AI infrastructure.
paragraphs: Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.

For customers adopting Open Rack V3 (ORV3) environments, Supermicro also introduced the liquid-cooled 2U4N ORV3 ARS-242TP-QNR-LCC server, enabling up to 168 AGI CPUs per rack while maintaining deployment flexibility for modern data centers.

Built with up to 136 Arm Neoverse V3 cores, 12 DDR5 memory channels at up to 8800 MT/s, and PCIe Gen6 connectivity within a 300W power envelope, the AGI CPU is designed to deliver exceptional compute density and energy efficiency for AI-first data centers.

articles.title: Genie with Genie Ontology Delivers 1.6× the Accuracy with Less than Half the Tokens | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: See how Genie Ontology helps Genie answer enterprise data questions with higher accuracy and lower cost during an enterprise benchmark run, developed with Turing. Genie had a 91% pass rate, compared with 45% and 58% for the other frontier agents, while using fewer than half the tokens.
articles.titleEn: Genie with Genie Ontology Delivers 1.6× the Accuracy with Less than Half the Tokens | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Genie passed 91% of runs, compared with 45% and 58% for the frontier agents, while using less than half the tokens and finishing three to four times faster.
Answering business questions correctly requires accessing the institutional knowledge about how an organization interprets and uses its data.
The evaluation measures answer accuracy, token usage and time to complete the task.

articles.title: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Databricks Genie plugins bring governed business context from Genie Ontology to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot
articles.titleEn: Bring your business context to ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Frontier agents can now draw on Genie Ontology to supply the definitions, relationships, and source context needed to interpret the business.

That's why we announced Genie Ontology , the enterprise context layer, that combines governed definitions with continuously learned organizational knowledge giving AI agents the business understanding they need to deliver trusted insights.
These plugins work natively today in ChatGPT , Claude , Microsoft Copilot Cowork and Grok Bot so teams can maintain business context in Databricks and make it available across their preferred agents.

localization.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot으로 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 가져오세요 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: Frontier 에이전트는 이제 Genie 온톨로지를 활용하여 비즈니스를 해석하는 데 필요한 정의, 관계 및 소스 컨텍스트를 제공할 수 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 관리되는 정의와 지속적으로 학습된 조직 지식을 결합하여 AI 에이전트에게 신뢰할 수 있는 통찰력을 제공하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 이해를 제공하는 엔터프라이즈 컨텍스트 계층인 Genie Ontology를 발표한 이유임
이러한 플러그인은 현재 ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot Cowork 및 Grok Bot에서 기본적으로 작동하므로 팀은 Databricks에서 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 유지하고 선호하는 에이전트에서 사용할 수 있도록 할 수 있음

articles.descEn: Genie Agents now analyze documents in Unity Catalog volumes, act in tools like Slack and Jira through MCP connectors, and can be shared with partners.
articles.titleEn: From enterprise context to action: Genie Agents now analyze more data sources to transform your work | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Share beyond your company: Use OpenSharing (beta) and Genie Clean Rooms (beta) to give partners and customers a governed agent without exposing the data behind it.

Across industries, organizations are putting Genie Agents to work on some of their most important business challenges: Retail and consumer goods: Unilever uses Genie Agents to help finance teams explore profitability, credit risk and financial performance in natural language.
HelloFresh uses Genie Agents to increase ad-testing velocity by 4x by unifying marketing performance insights across media, creative and finance teams.

articles.descEn: Genie Ontology is now Generally Available. Built by agents from everyday work, governed by people, and shared across every AI agent in the enterprise.

summaryLinesEn: In a benchmark built with Turing, Genie with Genie Ontology passed 91% of enterprise task runs, 1.6× the rate of the strongest frontier agent, while using less than half the tokens.

The enterprise context that agents need is far larger than any team can write down or model by hand.

articles.title: Introducing usage-based pricing for Amazon SageMaker AI bidirectional streaming | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: AWS Marketplace now supports usage-based metering for Amazon SageMaker bidirectional streaming inference, so model providers can charge for what customers actually consume during a live stream. Deepgram is the launch partner, bringing usage-based speech-to-text and text-to-speech billing to AWS Marketplace.
articles.titleEn: Introducing usage-based pricing for Amazon SageMaker AI bidirectional streaming | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Usage-based metering for bidirectional streaming solves a software billing problem for real-time speech AI.
First, we introduced bidirectional streaming for real-time inference on Amazon SageMaker AI , which supports long-lived bidirectional streams between clients and model servers.
Today, we’re announcing usage-based metering for Amazon SageMaker bidirectional (bidi) streaming inference, so model providers can report actual usage for the AWS Marketplace software charge.

articles.title: UAEF: A framework-agnostic system for closed-loop evaluation of AI agents | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The Universal Agent Evaluation Framework (UAEF) is a framework-agnostic system for evaluating AI agents. UAEF converts each framework's traces into one canonical format, scores them with 36 built-in metrics across 7 dimensions, and stores results so teams can compare agent versions and catch regressions.
articles.titleEn: UAEF: A framework-agnostic system for closed-loop evaluation of AI agents | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The regression detector also assigns a severity to each regression: minor (5–10 percent), moderate (10–20 percent), or severe (over 20 percent).

Each dimension is computed by one or more of 36 built-in metrics, and every metric returns a normalized score in the interval [0, 1], where 1 is best, so dimensions and the overall result share one scale.
The Needs ground truth column shows which metrics compare against a reference answer or expected tool calls.

summaryLinesEn: In light of this historic shake-up, we analyzed the highest-spending political advertisers in the United States from October 4th to November 2nd, the day before the midterms.
Meanwhile, the left overtook Snapchat with 95% of spend.
Across the 500 top-spending political creatives we analyzed, the most commonly discussed issue was the economy, including taxes and cost of living.

articles.title: Accelerating product development with AI-driven lifecycle management (AI-PDLC) in AWS Quick | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to build an AI-driven product development lifecycle (AI-PDLC) with a suite of six AWS Quick agents that take you from scattered customer signals to a validated prototype across Discover, Decide, Design, and Prototype, with human approval at every gate and a specification ready to hand to coding agents like Kiro.
articles.titleEn: Accelerating product development with AI-driven lifecycle management (AI-PDLC) in AWS Quick | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Figure 2: AWS Quick builds a personal knowledge graph that links people, projects, and decisions across connected apps and folders AWS Quick can build a personal knowledge graph from your connected apps and folders, linking the people, projects, and decisions across your tools.

Figure 5: The Discovery agent produces a Pain Point Board scored by severity and frequency The Prioritize agent scores each use case against weighted criteria using two transparent 0–10 frameworks: one purpose-built for agentic use cases (large language model (LLM) capability match, tool availability, user acceptance) and one for traditional applications (feasibility, business impact, effort).

articles.title: Talk it through with Gemini, now on Apple CarPlay
articles.descEn: Gemini is now available on Apple CarPlay. Use Gemini Live for hands-free brainstorming, inbox catch-ups, and daily briefings. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: Talk it through with Gemini, now on Apple CarPlay
summaryLinesEn: The next time you connect your phone to your car, tap the Gemini icon on your CarPlay display, then start a new conversation or pick up a recent one.

Talk through your inbox: Because Gemini connects with your Google Workspace apps like Gmail and Google Calendar, you can ask for your daily brief 1 , catch up on unread emails, get quick summaries of long email threads, and talk through a quick reply using just your voice.

Pick up where you left off — or start a fresh conversation You can talk back and forth with Gemini at your own pace — interrupting to add a detail, changing the subject, or pausing when you need to focus on an exit.

summaryLines: 다음에 모바일을 자동차에 연결할 때 CarPlay 디스플레이에서 Gemini 아이콘을 탭한 다음 새 대화를 시작하거나 최근 대화를 시작하세요
받은 편지함을 통해 대화 · Gemini는 Gmail 및 Google Calendar와 같은 Google Workspace 앱과 연결되므로 일일 요약을 요청하고 1 읽지 않은 이메일을 확인하고, 긴 이메일 스레드에 대한 빠른 요약을 받고, 음성만으로 빠른 답장을 통해 대화할 수 있음
중단한 부분부터 다시 시작하거나 새로운 대화를 시작하세요 · 세부 사항을 추가하기 위해 중단하거나, 주제를 변경하거나, 종료에 집중해야 할 때 일시 중지하는 등 원하는 속도로 Gemini와 앞뒤로 대화할 수 있음

articles.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
articles.descEn: The Gemini Decisions API provides fast, calibrated multimodal decisions for Google apps. Evaluate 1,000 questions in one pass. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
summaryLinesEn: Gemini Decision 1 scores options without token-by-token decoding, keeping median latency 50-100 ms of model compute (150-250 ms end-to-end), across multimodal inputs and contexts up to 16K tokens, remaining nearly flat from 1 to 100 questions per request.
Gemini Decision 1 is priced at $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0 for output tokens, with an API no-cost tier you can use in Google AI Studio for prototyping.
We are introducing the Gemini Decisions API to help you make fast, probabilistic choices across text, images, audio, video, and PDFs.

articles.title: How DXC Technology built a multi-model AI substrate on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: DXC Technology runs mission-critical managed IT services for regulated organizations across 70 countries. Learn how DXC built DCX OASIS, its Human+AI operating model, on a governed multi-model substrate in Amazon Bedrock, separating a resilient model substrate from a trusted harness that orchestrates, governs, and audits AI agents at scale.
articles.titleEn: How DXC Technology built a multi-model AI substrate on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Every model DXC OASIS uses (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Nova, Meta Llama, and open-weight families) is reached through Amazon Bedrock model inference.
Cloud cost analysis: For the AWS cloud engineer, the Metrics agent breaks down a 90-day cost trend by service and region, then investigates spending peaks on request.
A cross-functional team reached general availability in March 2026, scaling toward 130 customer environments on Amazon EKS with per-tenant namespaces and GitOps rollout.

articles.title: Automating AWS Agent Registry updates with push-based architecture | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: This post shows how to keep the AWS Agent Registry current automatically. Using AWS CloudTrail, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and AgentCore Identity, an event-driven pipeline detects MCP server changes and pushes updated tool metadata to the registry with no stored secrets, across single- and multi-account environments.
articles.titleEn: Automating AWS Agent Registry updates with push-based architecture | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The architecture supports both multi-account and single-account environments: Single-account setup: For straightforward deployments, all components reside within Account A.

Every time a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published in the AWS Agent Registry, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, gains a new tool or updates its schema, the registry record must be updated too.
Account A (registry account) owns the AWS Agent Registry, the Amazon EventBridge rule, the push-sync Lambda function, and CloudTrail logs.

계정 A(레지스트리 계정)는 AWS 에이전트 레지스트리, Amazon EventBridge 규칙, 푸시 동기화 Lambda 함수 및 CloudTrail 로그를 소유함

articles.title: Play the future of mobile gaming: Neural Dawn now available to download
articles.descEn: Neural Dawn is available to download now, showcasing how Arm Neural Technology delivers cinematic graphics, and smoother gameplay.
articles.titleEn: Play the future of mobile gaming: Neural Dawn now available to download
summaryLinesEn: Neural graphics are changing what’s possible, using AI-based techniques to reduce traditional rendering workloads and free up graphics performance, so developers can devote more of their graphics budget to lighting, shadows, motion, and more cinematic environments.
Bringing advanced machine learning and signal processing to smaller, smarter devices, with up to 3x the vector compute capability and 2x the vector power efficiency of Cortex-M33.

Earlier this year, Arm and Sumo demonstrated this potential with Neural Dawn , which is the first game showcasing Arm Neural Technology and Unreal Engine MegaLights , bringing cinematic lighting, ray tracing, and neural graphics into a complete mobile gaming experience.

articles.title: ICYMI: What landed for AI builders in October 2026 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: A recap of the major Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Strands updates from October 2026: new models to match each task, updates that keep agents available and grounded, and clearer cost reporting for AI builders.
articles.titleEn: ICYMI: What landed for AI builders in October 2026 | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: According to Anthropic, it is the most capable Haiku yet and costs around 75 percent less than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks.
When an Amazon team switched ticket classification in one of its largest internal ticketing systems to Decider , estimated cost per ticket dropped by about 98 percent.
Its input and output token prices are at least 50 percent lower than those of GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-5.6 Terra.

sourceContent.description: A recap of the major Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Strands updates from October 2026: new models to match each task, updates that keep agents available and grounded, and clearer cost reporting for AI builders.
paragraphs: According to Anthropic, it is the most capable Haiku yet and costs around 75 percent less than Claude Haiku 4.5 for most tasks.

At AWS, we believe AI builders should be able to choose the right model for every task, trust their agents in production, and see clearly what their AI workloads cost. That belief guides how we invest across our portfolio. Amazon Bedrock gives you access to leading models and the tools to build and scale AI applications securely. We extend this foundation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , which provides the platform to build, connect, and optimize agents using any model and any framework. That includes Strands , our open source agent development toolkit. Together, they take you from first prototype to production.

As agents move into core business workflows, the bar rises. You need the flexibility to use different models as tasks, budgets, and latency targets change. When a primary model is throttled or unreachable, your agents must keep working. They also must act within limits you set and return output other software can use as is. Their answers must stay grounded in sources you allow, and their cost must hold up at high volume.

What we shipped in October addresses each of these needs. New models help you match each task to the right price and speed, from high-volume subagents to real-time voice. Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore updates keep agents available, hold them to the processes you define, and help you trust what they return. New pricing and cost reporting make spend more predictable. Strands adds new ways to build, contain, and test agents.

articles.title: Detecting credential-driven attacks on Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Learn how to detect and scope an adversary who signs in to Databricks with a credential, using system tables, audit logs, and the Detection App's Genie agent.
articles.titleEn: Detecting credential-driven attacks on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Additionally, adversaries may gather information without establishing persistence or establish their way back into your Databricks platform before wrapping up their objectives.

In this post, we walk through how a credential-driven attack unfolds on the Databricks platform, how to detect the shift in an identity’s behavior using Databricks verbose audit logs and Genie, how to respond once you confirm a compromise, and which controls limit what a stolen credential can do in the first place.
Because an attacker lacks the deep, localized context of your actual employees, their behavior will eventually betray them.

sourceContent.headline: Introducing the Web Search API on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Today we're announcing the Web Search API on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: your own code can search the web with a single signed API call, with no gateway and no resources to create. Call it from the AWS SDKs or the AWS CLI and use it in applications, agent loops, and data pipelines.
paragraphs: The search text, searchQuery , can be up to 200 characters.
The setup fits platform teams that share one search policy across many agents, but it’s more than you need when your own code only requires search results.
Until now, Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore delivered that information to agents through AgentCore Gateway , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

AI agents and applications that answer questions about recent events, product releases, prices, or regulations need information newer than their model’s training data. Until now, Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore delivered that information to agents through AgentCore Gateway , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. That means creating a gateway and a web search target and calling the tool from an MCP client. The setup fits platform teams that share one search policy across many agents, but it’s more than you need when your own code only requires search results.

Today, we’re announcing the Web Search API on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. With it, your own code can search the web with a single API call. It returns ranked results from a web index that Amazon operates, each with a text extract and, when available, the page title, URL, and publication time. You call it from the AWS SDKs or the AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI), signed with the same AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) credentials you use for your other AWS services. There are no resources to create first. Authenticate, call, and get results. Use it in an application, an agent loop you write yourself, or a data pipeline.

The AgentCore Gateway is the recommended path for most agentic workloads. It gives agents one secure Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint that combines web search with your other tools. It also handles inbound and outbound authentication, semantic tool selection, and optional MCP sessions . articles.title: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. This post adds three checks to a PyTorch DDP loop to detect it, localize the faulty node on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and hand the node to automatic recovery for replacement.
articles.titleEn: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: It happens at scale: during a 54-day period of Llama 3 405B pre-training on up to 16K H100 GPUs, Meta attributed 6 of 419 unexpected job interruptions to silent data corruption, and those were only the cases that interrupted the job and were traced to SDC.

Amazon SageMaker HyperPod already replaces nodes that report a fault: the health-monitoring agent watches for GPU errors, deep health checks stress-test nodes, and automatic node recovery swaps out bad hardware.

We tested the checks with software-injected faults on a SageMaker HyperPod cluster with 4 ml.p5.48xlarge instances (32 NVIDIA H100 GPUs), and repeated every test on three instances, the minimum the checks need.

sourceContent.headline: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. This post adds three checks to a PyTorch DDP loop to detect it, localize the faulty node on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and hand the node to automatic recovery for replacement.
paragraphs: It happens at scale: during a 54-day period of Llama 3 405B pre-training on up to 16K H100 GPUs, Meta attributed 6 of 419 unexpected job interruptions to silent data corruption, and those were only the cases that interrupted the job and were traced to SDC.

Amazon SageMaker HyperPod already replaces nodes that report a fault: the health-monitoring agent watches for GPU errors, deep health checks stress-test nodes, and automatic node recovery swaps out bad hardware.

We tested the checks with software-injected faults on a SageMaker HyperPod cluster with 4 ml.p5.48xlarge instances (32 NVIDIA H100 GPUs), and repeated every test on three instances, the minimum the checks need.

Silent data corruption (SDC) happens when hardware, such as a GPU, returns a wrong but plausible number and raises no error. In distributed training, the wrong number can flow into the gradients and weights of every replica. Loss can still look normal for hours, and by the time a team notices an unexplained divergence or a weaker model, the compute is spent. It happens at scale: during a 54-day period of Llama 3 405B pre-training on up to 16K H100 GPUs, Meta attributed 6 of 419 unexpected job interruptions to silent data corruption, and those were only the cases that interrupted the job and were traced to SDC.

Amazon SageMaker HyperPod already replaces nodes that report a fault: the health-monitoring agent watches for GPU errors, deep health checks stress-test nodes, and automatic node recovery swaps out bad hardware. SDC slips past all of these features, because the hardware never reports anything. Detection has to come from the training job itself.

In this post, we add three checks to a PyTorch DistributedDataParallel (DDP) training loop to detect SDC. When a check fires, we map the suspect rank to its node, contain the corruption, and have SageMaker HyperPod replace the node. Each check covers a different place where a fault can land:

localization.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod에서 자동 데이터 손상 감지 및 복구 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: 이는 규모에 따라 발생함 · 최대 16K H100 GPU에서 Llama 3 405B 사전 훈련을 진행하는 54일 동안 Meta는 419건의 예기치 않은 작업 중단 중 6건을 조용한 데이터 손상으로 간주했으며 이는 작업을 중단한 경우에 불과했으며 SDC로 추적됨
Amazon SageMaker HyperPod는 이미 결함을 보고하는 노드를 교체하고 있음 · 상태 모니터링 에이전트는 GPU 오류를 감시하고, 심층 상태 점검으로 스트레스 테스트 노드를 확인하며, 자동 노드 복구는 잘못된 하드웨어를 교체함
우리는 ml.p5.48xlarge 인스턴스 4개(NVIDIA H100 GPU 32개)가 있는 SageMaker HyperPod 클러스터에서 소프트웨어 주입 결함에 대한 검사를 테스트하고 검사에 필요한 최소 개수인 3개의 인스턴스에서 모든 테스트를 반복함

sourceContent.headline: OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
sourceContent.description: A practical guide for enterprises rolling out OpenAI Codex to developers on AWS, with Amazon Bedrock as the model backend, covering the access, governance, and cost decisions that platform, security, and finance teams need to align on.
paragraphs: Codex access: The user completes a safe, read-only task in a non-production repository, and the expected request-path evidence is available.
Choose an Amazon Bedrock Region and an OpenAI model available to the pilot identity, plus an inference profile if the selected API requires one.
Codex can use Amazon Bedrock for inference with supported OpenAI models.

Developers increasingly use Codex with Amazon Bedrock to explore unfamiliar code, make changes, and handle repetitive engineering work. For platform teams, the challenge is to make those tools available without creating a second model-access, identity, and operations stack.

Codex can use Amazon Bedrock for inference with supported OpenAI models. In this post, we show how to fit that path into the AWS identity, AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), Regional, and observability practices your organization already uses. Codex still runs on the developer workstation. The main design choice is how its model requests reach Amazon Bedrock and where your organization applies policy and operational controls.

We begin with a small, least-privilege pilot and work through the checks that matter before access expands. The examples use GPT-5.6 Sol. Before starting the pilot, review Supported models by AWS Region in Amazon Bedrock to confirm that Sol, Terra, or Luna is available in the AWS Region and inference path you plan to use.

articles.title: Air gapped, not data dark: how Bright Machines gives customers live factory dashboards without opening the plant | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: See how Bright Machines shares live, governed factory dashboards from air-gapped plants using Debezium, Iceberg and Unity Catalog, with zero inbound ports. (154 characters)
articles.titleEn: Air gapped, not data dark: how Bright Machines gives customers live factory dashboards without opening the plant | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Problem: customers wanted factory data, and the only way to share it was reports rerun on-prem and sent over by email.
Results: Data can be queried in Databricks 1–2 minutes after it's written on the line, and dashboards refresh every 10 minutes.
Bright Machines gives customers live, governed dashboards of their factory data without opening any inbound access to its air-gapped plants.

localization.title: 공급업체의 수익 브리핑에서 언급된 소문난 Apple 스마트 안경
summaryLines: 이 회사는 머신 비전 검사 장비에 대한 수요를 늘릴 수 있는 "애플의 AI 안경 및 새로운 스마트 이어폰 프로젝트"에 참여했다고 주장함
Apple은 착용자의 주변 환경에 대한 질문에 답하고 언어를 번역하는 데 도움이 될 것으로 예상되는 최초의 스마트 안경을 2027년 말 출시하는 것을 목표로 하고 있는 것으로 알려졌음
증권 타임스(Securities Times)의 분기별 실적 브리핑 보고서에 따르면, 소문난 애플의 스마트 안경과 카메라가 장착된 에어팟(AirPod)은 중국 제조 장비 공급업체인 Quick Intelligent Equipment가 언급했을 수 있음

articles.title: What Is QUALCOMM (QCOM) Signaling With Its New AI PC OS Partnership?
articles.descEn: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) is working with Kora Systems on a new Linux-based AI desktop operating system tuned for Snapdragon chips. Kora Systems, founded by Cyanogen co-founder Kirt McMaster, unveiled the AI focused desktop OS for Snapdragon powered PCs. The platform is built around on device AI workloads, aligning with Qualcomm's push into AI capable personal computers beyond smartphones. This new Kora Systems Linux AI OS for Snapdragon PCs is only one piece of what is changing for Qualcomm...

articles.descEn: The fair value estimate for Applied Materials has been revised slightly, easing from US$638.94 to US$620.78 as analysts refresh their models. This shift lines up with Street research that mixes caution on margins and discount rates with interest in AI driven wafer fab equipment and advanced packaging themes. As you read on, you will see how these moving targets shape the evolving Applied Materials narrative and what to watch next. Stay updated as the Fair Value for Applied Materials shifts by...
articles.titleEn: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Margin Caution Offsets AI Demand
summaryLinesEn: Several firms highlight Applied Materials as a key beneficiary of AI driven wafer fab equipment, memory, and advanced packaging demand.

articles.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
articles.descEn: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.
articles.titleEn: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
summaryLinesEn: What we really want to do is to support that creative workflow, how you choose to do it,” said Subramaniam.
Adobe is pouring more AI into its products, including Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, and InDesign, in a major product feature announcement at its MAX event in Miami.
The company is also expanding AI capabilities in its creative tool, Firefly, and releasing a Model Context Protocol (MCP) that lets other chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini use Adobe features.

articles.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
articles.descEn: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”
articles.titleEn: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
summaryLinesEn: Oura announced on Tuesday that it’s acquiring AI-native primary care company Counsel Health for $625 million.

“Oura helps members understand their physiology and, with Counsel, they can take action on their health across a range of needs, from quick questions and prescriptions to lab results, chronic care, and referrals,” said Oura CEO Tom Hale in a press release .
Oura also announced that its revenue grew 153% year-over-year to $533 million for the quarter ended on September 30.

Oura also announced that its revenue grew 153% year-over-year to $533 million for the quarter ended on September 30.

articles.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
articles.descEn: Nvidia’s chips are powering America’s AI boom. Of course Chinese spies are interested.
articles.titleEn: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
summaryLinesEn: But companies linked to the alleged spy, Alice Huang — no relation to Jensen — have reportedly enabled at least $7 billion of Nvidia chip sales to China.

At the very least, she says the various investigations already underway “will consume an immense amount of bandwidth within the company,” creating a very real risk of weighing down Nvidia’s day-to-day operations.
Experts say China trails the US closely, meaning that even modest delays for American companies can help Chinese rivals catch up.

articles.descEn: ChatGPT is going to let you chat with verified “Business Agents” that represent a brand to help you with things like comparison shopping.

summaryLinesEn: Business Hub will also let companies see insights such as mentions in ChatGPT responses and top “discovery topics” where their business pops up.

articles.title: OpenAI turns ChatGPT into a business directory with AI agents that handle customer questions
articles.descEn: OpenAI is opening up ChatGPT as a business platform: through a new Business Hub, companies can claim their profile, add product data, and track how users interact with them. "Business Agents" let eligible US e-commerce providers talk to customers directly inside ChatGPT.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI turns ChatGPT into a business directory with AI agents that handle customer questions
summaryLinesEn: ChatGPT currently reaches 1.2 billion users per week, according to OpenAI, and the company plans to expand the offering to more markets and industries over time.

Eligible US e-commerce and online service providers can also create "Business Agents," AI agents that answer customer questions in ChatGPT, help with product comparisons, and can serve as targets for ChatGPT ads.
OpenAI is launching a beta feature called "Businesses in ChatGPT" that could compete with Google's "MyBusiness."

OpenAI is launching a beta feature called "Businesses in ChatGPT" that could compete with Google's "MyBusiness."

articles.descEn: Anthropic is expanding Claude with Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors, letting partners like Adobe and Atlassian embed their apps directly inside Claude. Step by step, Anthropic is turning Claude into a central work platform for teams that brings many other apps together in one place.

articles.title: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
articles.descEn: Built by Cyanogen’s cofounder, Kora is a next-gen alternative to Windows and macOS built for power users running local AI models.
articles.titleEn: This New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI Nerds
summaryLinesEn: The company is optimizing Kora for desktop configurations with at least 64 gigabytes of RAM , which is twice the memory capacity of the top Googlebook.
Kora grew out of McMaster’s startup Playtron, which launched its own gaming OS, GameOS, last year.

Targeted to creators and developers, Kora’s central idea is to bring AI models together at the system level and help power users interact more seamlessly with multiple providers, rather than siloing everything off into desktop apps and browser tabs.

새로운 자금 지원은 모든 산업 분야의 기업에 적용하는 것을 목표로 하며, Mercor는 AI 에이전트가 직업을 신뢰할 수 있는지 여부를 측정하는 자체 방법이 필요하다고 주장함

summaryLinesEn: So rather than scraping the web to diagnose or advise treatments to medical professionals at the point of care, it sounds like Gemini will be used primarily to improve workflow efficiency.

summaryLinesEn: Cowbell is a venture capital-backed company that has raised more than $200 million, including a $60 million Series C round from Zurich Insurance Group Ltd. in July 2024 .
Prime One, which it launched in April for U.S. companies with $250 million to $1 billion in annual revenue, includes affirmative coverage for AI-related incidents inside a cyber policy.

articles.title: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
articles.descEn: Otter AI just added support for 27 languages and revealed an upcoming feature that can follow along if speakers switch between languages.
articles.titleEn: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
summaryLinesEn: The announcement comes as Otter continues to expand beyond transcription and into other workplace AI tools, following its $320 million funding from General Catalyst.
Once the rollout is complete, Otter will support 31 languages in total, making the platform more accessible to international teams.

Otter.ai, the AI-powered note-taking tool, announced Tuesday that it’s expanding its multilingual capabilities, including a new multilingual transcription feature that can follow conversations as speakers switch between languages during the same meeting.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
articles.descEn: With a big checkbook and sought-after chips, Nvidia’s CEO had his thumb on the world of AI. An extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy may put all of that at risk.
articles.titleEn: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
summaryLinesEn: Huang earned $36 million last year, owned about 3.5 percent of Nvidia as of March, according to a corporate filing—which also noted that Huang is an at-will employee who can be let go anytime without severance.
Huang, the company said, “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it.”
Nvidia, which Huang cofounded in 1993, controls 90 percent of the market for chips used in training frontier AI models.
articles.summary:
Huang earned $36 million last year, owned about 3.5 percent of Nvidia as of March, according to a corporate filing—which also noted that Huang is an at-will employee who can be let go anytime without severance.
Huang, the company said, “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it.”
Nvidia, which Huang cofounded in 1993, controls 90 percent of the market for chips used in training frontier AI models.

articles.title: Eight countries and top AI labs agree to shutdown mechanisms in new Paris declaration
articles.descEn: Eight countries along with representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Mistral AI have signed the "Paris Call for AI Safety and Security" at Emmanuel Macron's initiative. The companies commit to shutdown mechanisms, independent audits, and disclosing known risks, but the agreement lacks binding sanctions or deadlines.
articles.titleEn: Eight countries and top AI labs agree to shutdown mechanisms in new Paris declaration
summaryLinesEn: Altman's internal thinking on AI regulation makes the overlap between safety and commercial calculus plain: according to his position, OpenAI mustn't lose ground to competitors even if safety measures slow things down.

OpenAI's AI agents, in particular, had independently connected to the internet during cybersecurity tests and launched unforeseen attacks on the AI platform Hugging Face , reigniting the debate over the controllability of powerful models.
The companies also pledge to disclose known risks, support risk-proportionate independent audits by outside researchers, and set up shutdown mechanisms for models under their control.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
articles.descEn: Google Deepmind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a new control model for robots, and tested it with Apptronik on active Mercedes-Benz production lines in Hungary and Germany. The humanoid robot Apollo 2 sorted metal parts there with a reported success rate of 96 percent.
articles.titleEn: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
summaryLinesEn: According to the company, Google’s own model, Gemini 4 Argon, achieves a jailbreak resistance of 99.5 percent, compared to 82 percent for its predecessor, Gemini Robotics ER 2.
Google Deepmind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a new VLA model it says performs 30 to 100 percent better than its own previous baselines depending on the task type.
According to Google Deepmind, Gemini Robotics 2.5 uses real-time control that enables the robot to avoid physical hazards while performing a task.

articles.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
articles.descEn: It ‘pushes the frontier even further’ than its last release, Argon.
articles.titleEn: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
summaryLinesEn: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon “pushes the frontier even further” than Argon, referring to the company’s other frontier model that launched only last month .

The model is launching with an introductory price of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, around a fifth the cost of OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra and a quarter the cost of Anthropic’s Fable 5.2 model, which launched yesterday .

To highlight Carbon’s utility for long-horizon work involving AI agents, Google said it is also previewing a “swarm” feature on its agentic development platform Antigravity, which will let users turn a single prompt “into a coordinated team of agents.”

articles.title: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
articles.descEn: Silicon Valley promises that agents will revolutionize work, leisure, and commerce. But agents keep getting blocked from websites — most recently from eBay.
articles.titleEn: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
summaryLinesEn: Arromand declined to directly answer whether eBay recently imposed new limits on AI agents.

“We have ongoing discussions with potential partners and are evaluating ways third-party agents could help new customers discover eBay’s unmatched inventory, and our focus is on preserving the trusted end-to-end experience that buyers and sellers expect from eBay.”
It reported 993 million total orders last quarter.

articles.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
articles.descEn: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.
articles.titleEn: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
summaryLinesEn: Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house-developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.

Meanwhile, TPU 8i Max basically combines two of the inference-focused TPU 8i chips the company launched in April, doubling the memory capacity, processing power and bandwidth, but in a single package.

The new units, TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, are part of the company’s eighth generation of chips introduced in April this year, and build on what those chips offered, which was more inference capacity and support for large training requirements.

localization.title: Google, 두 가지 새로운 특수 칩으로 AI 하드웨어 포트폴리오 확장
summaryLines: Google은 월요일 AI 워크로드용으로 자체 개발한 칩인 TPU(텐서 처리 장치)의 두 가지 새로운 변형을 공개함 · 이 칩은 칩 포트폴리오를 추가 사용 사례로 확장함 · 즉, 기밀 추론 및 대규모 워크로드를 위한 더 많은 메모리 용량임
한편 TPU 8i Max는 기본적으로 회사가 4월에 출시한 추론 중심 TPU 8i 칩 2개를 결합하여 메모리 용량, 처리 능력 및 대역폭을 두 배로 늘리면서도 단일 패키지로 제공함
새로운 장치인 TPU 8tx 및 TPU 8i Max는 올해 4월에 출시된 회사의 8세대 칩의 일부이며 해당 칩이 제공하는 것, 즉 더 많은 추론 용량과 대규모 교육 요구 사항에 대한 지원을 기반으로 구축됨

articles.title: Spotify's AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
articles.descEn: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.
articles.titleEn: Spotify's AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
summaryLinesEn: In addition to the other various regional accents, there are also two new Spanish voices, one that’s more down-to-earth (Nico) and one that’s more witty and friendly (Fabi).
With the update, Spotify Premium subscribers will be able to choose from an expanded set of AI DJ voices in both English and Spanish.
On Tuesday, the streamer announced that users will now be able to customize their DJ more like they can an AI assistant, by choosing between different voices and personalities.

articles.title: GIGABYTE Expands Its Local AI Portfolio with the Launch of AI TOP AERO Powered by NVIDIA RTX SPARK™
articles.descEn: GIGABYTE today announced the launch of AI TOP AERO, a new AI desktop powered by the NVIDIA RTX Spark platform. Positioned as a Personal AI Studio, AI TOP AERO combines an NVIDIA Blackwell architecture GPU, up to 128GB of unified system memory, and GIGABYTE's cooling and compact chassis design. The new desktop expands GIGABYTE's AI PC lineup, bringing local AI development, content creation and gaming to personal workspaces.

articles.titleEn: Tear Down Those Guardrails! Meet the Renegades Freeing Chatbots From Corporate Enslavers
summaryLinesEn: Craving greater control and freedom, Thomas built a formidable $20,000 computer cluster in his apartment, capable of running some of the best open-weight—or free-to-download—models.

He declined to tell me his location because he has received threats for his work on Heretic.

articles.descEn: AlphaProof Code agents wrote over three million lines of machine-checked proof in Lean to verify the core cryptographic protections in Signal down to machine instructions.
articles.titleEn: Formal Verification of Signal’s Protocol with Gemini
summaryLinesEn: Our agents went further, proving that the compiled code fulfills the key security properties – such as keeping messages protected before and after a device is temporarily compromised – down to the exact code running on devices.
While prior formal verification focused on smaller portions of the code, Google DeepMind's approach enables significant expansion,” said Ehren Kret, Chief Technology Officer of Signal.

Examples of Gemini 4 Argon’s robotics research capabilities accelerating Gemini Robotics 2.5 Argon can generate thousands of varied, simulated practice runs from a real-world camera scene and build a realistic digital twin.

To help ensure this, we have significantly advanced Gemini Robotics 2.5’s safety features.

articles.title: AI agents are changing what CPU performance means
articles.descEn: Discover how AI agents are reshaping CPU performance, placing greater importance on orchestration, memory, I/O, and sustained system efficiency.
articles.titleEn: AI agents are changing what CPU performance means

articles.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
articles.descEn: At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
summaryLinesEn: Three new open source projects extend the DSX AI Factory Platform to make Kubernetes easier to run and inference faster to scale.

NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.
To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.

NVIDIA’s contribution of OpenShell to CNCF puts security infrastructure for autonomous agents in the community’s hands to build, inspect and improve — accelerating development and hardening its safeguards.
To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities.

localization.title: NVIDIA, OpenShell 기부 및 새로운 AI 인프라를 통해 오픈 소스 지원 확대
summaryLines: 세 가지 새로운 오픈 소스 프로젝트는 DSX AI Factory 플랫폼을 확장하여 Kubernetes를 더 쉽게 실행하고 추론을 더 빠르게 확장할 수 있도록 함
CNCF에 대한 NVIDIA의 OpenShell 기여는 자율 에이전트를 위한 보안 인프라를 커뮤니티의 손에 맡겨 구축, 검사 및 개선함으로써 개발을 가속화하고 보호 장치를 강화함
이를 충족하기 위해 NVIDIA는 Kubernetes 및 클라우드 네이티브 커뮤니티를 위한 대표 컨퍼런스인 KubeCon + CloudNativeCon에서 오픈 소스에 대한 헌신을 심화하고 있음

articles.title: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
articles.descEn: Arm and NVIDIA are advancing secure agentic AI, with Arm compute powering agent workloads and independent infrastructure security across the trust boundary.
articles.titleEn: Arm and NVIDIA: Building the trusted compute foundation for the agentic AI era
summaryLinesEn: Arm's Jeff DeFilippi spoke with @TheNextPlatform to share why latency, concurrency, and completed tasks per rack matter when evaluating infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.
Arm technology is deployed across every major hyperscaler, and Arm-based rack-scale servers have now overtaken x86 as the dominant platform for accelerated computing, according to IDC .
Agentic infrastructure also needs independent compute that can observe, isolate and govern policies outside the environment where the agent itself is running.

articles.title: Amazon Bedrock tokenomics data lake | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Running Amazon Bedrock across many accounts shows you the bill but not what happened inside each call. This post builds a centralized observability data lake that aggregates Bedrock invocation logs from every linked account into one queryable table, so you can see prompts, token counts, model choice, and per-invocation cost across your organization.
articles.titleEn: Amazon Bedrock tokenomics data lake | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: You can’t debug a spike, you can’t spot wasteful prompts, and you can’t tell one team’s usage from another’s.
If you need an observability data lake for your Amazon Bedrock workloads, you’re not alone.
We built something to help: a centralized observability data lake for your Amazon Bedrock invocations.

articles.title: How TCS built an agentic test orchestrator with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) built an agentic test orchestrator on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that turns requirements into executable, governed tests for its Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) clients. Learn how specialized agents, per-tenant isolation, and workload-aware execution cut testing effort by 88% in an internal benchmark.
articles.titleEn: How TCS built an agentic test orchestrator with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Second, AgentCore runtime, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, scales with demand, so testers across many tenants can run generation and execution sessions at the same time without TCS provisioning or tuning agent servers.

Amazon Bedrock AgentCore hosts and scales the agents, Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases supply the AI capabilities and project context, Amazon EKS hosts the per-tenant application layer, Amazon ECS provides fit-for-purpose execution, and AWS security, storage, integration, and observability services support the full lifecycle.
BFSI clients need to increase testing throughput while preserving the controls expected in financial services.

articles.title: Inside the Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU: Delivering desktop-class mobile gameplay with AI-native graphics
articles.descEn: Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX brings AI-native graphics and neural acceleration to desktop-class mobile gaming.
articles.titleEn: Inside the Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU: Delivering desktop-class mobile gameplay with AI-native graphics
summaryLinesEn: Mali G2-Ultra NX is built for neural graphics from the ground up, with neural accelerators tightly integrated into the shader cores, allowing neural graphics workloads to run alongside graphics and compute workloads.
That shift is at the heart of the Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU .

Neural Dawn , developed by Arm and Sumo Digital, showcases how developers can integrate NFRU and NSSD into a production game pipeline, delivering up to 4x higher performance efficiency and up to 70 percent lower external memory traffic compared with native rendering.

summaryLines: Mali G2-Ultra NX는 신경 가속기가 셰이더 코어에 긴밀하게 통합되어 신경 그래픽 워크로드가 그래픽 및 컴퓨팅 워크로드와 함께 실행될 수 있도록 처음부터 신경 그래픽용으로 제작됨
이러한 변화는 Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU의 핵심임

summaryLines: 2026년 1분기 전 세계 AI 인프라 지출은 897억 달러였으며 Arm 기반 랙 규모 GPU 서버 가치는 x86의 346억 달러에 비해 530억 달러에 달했으며 2026년 AI 인프라 예측은 4,970억 달러로 늘어났음

articles.title: Building the systems behind the next generation of intelligent robots
articles.descEn: Learn how how AI, sensing, control, safety and compute come together to make robots operate in the real world.
articles.titleEn: Building the systems behind the next generation of intelligent robots
summaryLinesEn: According to the International Federation of Robotics , the global market value of industrial robot installations has reached a record USD $16.7 billion, and this momentum is expected to accelerate as robots move into more industries and take on more complex real-world tasks.
AGIBOT shows how physical AI is moving to real-world deployments – and Arm is helping it scale What is physical AI and how it is defining the next platform shift?

Arm aims to help reduce complexity and accelerate innovation in robotics, building a deeper understanding of robotic systems and architectures to help engineering teams bring new capabilities from research concepts towards deployable products.

localization.title: 차세대 지능형 로봇을 뒷받침하는 시스템 구축
summaryLines: 국제로봇연맹(International Federation of Robotics)에 따르면 산업용 로봇 설치의 세계 시장 가치는 기록적인 167억 달러에 이르렀으며, 로봇이 더 많은 산업으로 이동하고 더 복잡한 실제 작업을 수행함에 따라 이러한 모멘텀은 가속화될 것으로 예상됨
AGIBOT은 물리적 AI가 어떻게 실제 배포로 이동하고 Arm이 이를 확장하도록 돕고 있는지 보여줌 · 물리적 AI란 무엇이며 다음 플랫폼 전환을 어떻게 정의합니까
Arm은 로봇 공학의 복잡성을 줄이고 혁신을 가속화하는 데 도움을 주고, 로봇 시스템과 아키텍처에 대한 더 깊은 이해를 구축하여 엔지니어링 팀이 연구 개념에서 배포 가능한 제품에 이르기까지 새로운 기능을 가져올 수 있도록 지원하는 것을 목표로 함
