articles.title: Arm and UNICEF launch AI in Play to expand access to AI innovation
articles.descEn: Arm and UNICEF launch AI in Play to expand access to responsible AI, support local innovators and equip young people with AI skills.
articles.titleEn: Arm and UNICEF launch AI in Play to expand access to AI innovation
summaryLinesEn: “The decisions the tech industry makes about AI in the next four years will shape how a whole generation of children grow up, learn, and work,” said Kitty van der Heijden, UNICEF Deputy Executive Director of Partnerships.
Yet as AI adoption accelerates, access to the tools, data, and expertise needed to build AI systems remains uneven.

“Arm has shown what it looks like to make that decision with children in mind: a decade of joint work and an investment of expertise and resources to design AI in Play, an ecosystem open to the tech sector to join and play a critical and positive role in.”

summaryLines: 유니세프 파트너십 담당 부국장인 키티 반 데르 하이덴(Kitty van der Heijden)은 “향후 4년 동안 기술 산업이 AI에 대해 내리는 결정은 전 세대의 어린이가 성장하고, 배우고, 일하는 방식을 결정하게 될 것임” · 라고 말함
그러나 AI 채택이 가속화됨에 따라 AI 시스템을 구축하는 데 필요한 도구, 데이터 및 전문 지식에 대한 액세스는 여전히 고르지 않음
"Arm은 아이들을 염두에 두고 그러한 결정을 내리는 것이 어떤 모습인지 보여주었음 · 즉, 기술 부문에 참여하여 중요하고 긍정적인 역할을 수행할 수 있는 개방형 생태계인 Play에서 AI를 설계하기 위한 10년 간의 공동 작업과 전문 지식 및 리소스 투자임"

articles.title: Autonomous treasury agents: How Trovata built an AI-native solution on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Trovata built autonomous treasury agents on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using an RBAC-secured architecture for bank-branded AI deployment and agentic workflows that move corporate treasury from manual operations to real-time decision-making at enterprise scale.
articles.titleEn: Autonomous treasury agents: How Trovata built an AI-native solution on Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Trovata’s evolution from its first generative AI for treasury in 2023 to its AI-native capabilities with autonomous agents represents a fundamental shift.

Trovata’s customers have seen measurable results: $1M+ in annualized cost savings, over 5 hours per day saved per accounting team, a 77 percent reduction in annual TMS costs, and treasury reporting reduced from hours or days to under a minute.
In 2023, Trovata launched the first generative AI built specifically for treasury.

articles.title: The agent evaluation playbook: Built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: When you deploy an agent, whether it is working is really several questions: did it finish the task, stay on topic, leak data, or skip steps? This post shows how to evaluate agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval evaluators, and how to match each behavior that matters to the right evaluator at the right level.
articles.titleEn: The agent evaluation playbook: Built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: When you use them in managed mode, AgentCore hosts the code, picks the judge model, and runs inference on its own capacity, exactly like built-in evaluators.
That includes the judge prompt it uses, the trace or session level it runs at, and whether it needs a reference answer or an expected trajectory.

Figure 4: The full evaluator landscape on AgentCore across built-in, DeepEval, AutoEval, and custom sources Response quality covers whether the answer is accurate, grounded, and well-formed: Correctness , Faithfulness , Helpfulness , ResponseRelevance , Conciseness , Coherence , InstructionFollowing , and Refusal .

sourceContent.description: When you deploy an agent, whether it is working is really several questions: did it finish the task, stay on topic, leak data, or skip steps? This post shows how to evaluate agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with built-in, DeepEval, and AutoEval evaluators, and how to match each behavior that matters to the right evaluator at the right level.
paragraphs: When you use them in managed mode, AgentCore hosts the code, picks the judge model, and runs inference on its own capacity, exactly like built-in evaluators.
That includes the judge prompt it uses, the trace or session level it runs at, and whether it needs a reference answer or an expected trajectory.

articles.title: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
articles.descEn: HONOR join forces with Wattpad, the global multi-platform entertainment company and world’s leading social storytelling platform, to empower writers to share their stories and aspirations.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
summaryLinesEn: [10 November 2020] – Global technology brand HONOR today announced the global availability of the HONOR 10X Lite and a line-up of partnerships that leverages HONOR’s core competencies to encourage creativity and innovation among users.

The HONOR 10X Lite features a stunning quad-camera set up, a 6.67” punch-hole display and a whopping 5000mAh battery, to help users live life to the max.

articles.title: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
articles.descEn: The British Standards Institute (BSI) presented the ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification to HONOR.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
summaryLinesEn: HONOR’s e-commerce system, sales and customer services, Magic UI, cloud service business, internal information security management system, and IT services, are all certified by this standard as well.

By showcasing its capability in integrating internal resources and establishing an efficient information security management system, HONOR was able to achieve the international certification from BSI in a short period of time.
Keeping up with the rapid growth of the company while ensuring the information security risks controllable is an important mission for HONOR.

articles.title: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
articles.descEn: Innovative fitness band, HONOR band 6, offers a holistic range of health and fitness tracking capabilities to empower people to stay mentally and physically fit.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
summaryLinesEn: Providing a clear and comfortable viewing experience on your wrist, the HONOR Band 6 boasts a large and vivid 1.47-inch AMOLED display with a resolution of 194 x 368, offering a 148% increase in display area when compared to its predecessor.

Equipped with up to 50 meters of water resistance, the HONOR Band 6 is ideal for swimmers for its capability of tracking activity under water, such as your SWOLF score and swimming stroke rates, helping users to boost their swimming efficiency.

Equipped with a stunning 1.47-inch AMOLED display and packed full of health and fitness management functions with an outstanding 14-day battery life, the HONOR Band 6 is the perfect fusion of innovative style and exquisite technology, allowing users to keep better tabs on their mental and physical wellbeing.

summaryLines: 손목에서 선명하고 편안한 시청 환경을 제공하는 HONOR Band 6는 194 x 368 해상도의 크고 생생한 1.47인치 AMOLED 디스플레이를 자랑하며, 이전 제품에 비해 디스플레이 영역이 148% 증가함

articles.title: Accelerating the agentic era: How Arm and ​​Google​ Cloud co-design​ infrastructure for TPU 8i Max
articles.descEn: Google expands its AI infrastructure with Arm-based Axion CPUs powering host compute for TPU 8i Max and next-generation AI workloads.
articles.titleEn: Accelerating the agentic era: How Arm and ​​Google​ Cloud co-design​ infrastructure for TPU 8i Max
summaryLinesEn: Google Cloud Delivers Customized Silicon Powered by Arm Neoverse for General-Purpose Compute and AI Inference Workloads Arm and Google Cloud redefine agentic AI infrastructure with Axion processors Arm propels cloud-to-car development in new Google Axion-based instances We're expanding Arm Flexible Access and Arm Total Access with the new Arm Cortex-M42 processor.
Google Cloud’s continued investment reflects a broader industry shift toward pairing CPUs with accelerators to unlock the next era of AI inference.​
“Delivering AI performance at scale requires​ co-designing​ CPUs and accelerators ​to work​ seamlessly​ together,” said Mark Lohmeyer, VP & GM, AI and Computing Infrastructure​​, Google Cloud.

articles.title: Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) Benchmark | Artificial Analysis
articles.descEn: Compare AI model performance on Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) Benchmark. Artificial Analysis' implementation of Google DeepMind's Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark. It tests whether agents can read visually dense project files, such as architectural drawings, engineering schematics and clinical scans, and produce the deliverables a professional would.
articles.titleEn: Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) Benchmark | Artificial Analysis
summaryLinesEn: Measures how models communicate rather than whether they are correct: 30 judged personality traits rolled up into 8 indexes, plus 21 measured communication characteristics.

A private evaluation developed by Artificial Analysis for frontier agentic capability in long-horizon knowledge work, testing agents on realistic business workflows that require deliverables such as spreadsheets, presentations, and memos.

Artificial Analysis' implementation of Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), testing AI agents on real-world legal work from Harvey's dataset of 120 private tasks spanning 24 legal practice areas. v1.1, built in collaboration with Harvey, checks every deliverable against the task's source documents for hallucinations, so work that passes every rubric criterion but contains a material hallucination receives no credit.

summaryLines: 모델이 올바른지 여부보다는 의사소통 방식을 측정함 · 판단된 30개의 성격 특성이 8개의 지표로 통합되고 21개의 측정된 의사소통 특성이 추가됨
스프레드시트, 프리젠테이션 및 메모와 같은 결과물이 필요한 현실적인 비즈니스 워크플로우에서 에이전트를 테스트하여 장거리 지식 작업의 프론티어 에이전트 기능을 위해 인공 분석에서 개발한 비공개 평가임

Harvey의 법률 대리인 벤치마크(LAB)를 인공 분석으로 구현하여 24개 법률 업무 영역에 걸쳐 120개 개인 작업으로 구성된 Harvey의 데이터 세트에서 실제 법률 업무에 대한 AI 에이전트를 테스트함 · Harvey와 협력하여 구축된 v1.1은 환각에 대한 작업의 원본 문서와 비교하여 모든 결과물을 확인하므로 모든 루브릭 기준을 통과하지만 실질적인 환각이 포함된 작업은 인정되지 않음

articles.title: Sundrop turns your endless baby photos into recaps, time lapses, and more — without AI
articles.descEn: Sundrop is a new iPhone app that uses Apple's on-device AI to help parents rediscover their favorite photos and create keepsakes without uploading images to the cloud.
articles.titleEn: Sundrop turns your endless baby photos into recaps, time lapses, and more — without AI
summaryLinesEn: A new app, Sundrop , aims to make those pictures more useful by turning them into weekly recaps, highlights, time lapses of the child growing up, and other cute scenes, like putting the child’s photo on a magazine cover or a rookie card.
This feature, the company says, means the pictures aren’t sent to any external servers it runs.
Others can put two siblings side-by-side at the same age, generate a time-lapse series of photos or a video of a kid growing up, or cut out a photo of the child and place it into a layered template.

sourceContent.headline: Sundrop turns your endless baby photos into recaps, time lapses, and more — without AI
sourceContent.description: Sundrop is a new iPhone app that uses Apple's on-device AI to help parents rediscover their favorite photos and create keepsakes without uploading images to the cloud.
paragraphs: A new app, Sundrop , aims to make those pictures more useful by turning them into weekly recaps, highlights, time lapses of the child growing up, and other cute scenes, like putting the child’s photo on a magazine cover or a rookie card.
This feature, the company says, means the pictures aren’t sent to any external servers it runs.
Others can put two siblings side-by-side at the same age, generate a time-lapse series of photos or a video of a kid growing up, or cut out a photo of the child and place it into a layered template.
New parents take a lot of pictures of their children, but those photos often end up languishing in photo galleries, never to be seen again after the initial snap and share.

While Google Photos and Apple Photos already provide extensive tools to organize and manage photos, Sundrop is taking aim at a particular niche: parents with a new baby (usually their first!) who take an overwhelming number of photos and want to do more with those pictures.

articles.title: Qualcomm survey unsurprisingly finds people want AI agents on their wearables
articles.descEn: Qualcomm’s survey shows people want proactive AI agents across their wearables, but also want control over their data.
articles.titleEn: Qualcomm survey unsurprisingly finds people want AI agents on their wearables
summaryLinesEn: The company’s blog post adds that Qualcomm’s processors offer strong on-device AI capabilities and can meet nearly every demand raised by users in its survey.
The survey also reveals that consumers increasingly view wearables as intelligent devices that can help them navigate the world, rather than simple accessories.
In fact, Qualcomm thinks wearables will see the highest AI adoption among users in the coming years.

articles.title: Agentic commerce is slow to catch on
articles.descEn: Silicon Valley’s bet that billions of agents will be out ordering food, booking travel, and filling up their humans’ shopping carts is running into an early reality check.
articles.titleEn: Agentic commerce is slow to catch on
summaryLinesEn: Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said Friday that the site was seeing “very, very low numbers” of bookings by Meta’s Muse and Instinct AI agents, while DoorDash has received “maybe several hundred orders in total” from personal AI assistants, CEO Tony Xu said.
“The adoption of these horizontal personal agents may be much slower than is anticipated,” Booking Holdings CEO Glenn Fogel said.
Either adoption is slow, or much of Silicon Valley is dead wrong in its assumptions about regular people’s behavior (it wouldn’t be the first time ).

articles.title: CoreWeave earnings put debt-fueled AI build-out under scrutiny
articles.descEn: CoreWeave’s earnings after the bell could calm fears about its debt-fueled AI buildout — or stoke more fear.
articles.titleEn: CoreWeave earnings put debt-fueled AI build-out under scrutiny
summaryLinesEn: CoreWeave reported $35.6 billion of debt, $5.5 billion of cash and a $104.2 billion revenue backlog in the second quarter.

Wells Fargo expects the company's capex needs for the rest of the year to be largely covered by its remaining undrawn debt, debt issuances in August/September and the $12 billion it is holding for project costs, which will flow into capex, analyst Michael Turrin said in a note Sunday.
CoreWeave owes roughly $15 billion in principal payments through 2028, according to its second-quarter earnings statement .

articles.title: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
articles.descEn: DeepMind researchers were able to formally verify that the widely used encryption protocol works as intended. Their stretch goal? Do the same for “all the software of the world.”
articles.titleEn: A New AI Tool From Google DeepMind Proved the Signal Protocol Is Secure
summaryLinesEn: Agentic AI can significantly cut down the time of the latter project, enabling analyses like DeepMind's Signal evaluation.
DeepMind conducted the Signal analysis free of charge as a research project, and Google declined to share the cost of the analysis.

While the speed of the project was notable, the DeepMind researchers point out that they were able to get a head start to a degree because of some past formal verification work that the Signal Foundation has conducted.

articles.title: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
articles.descEn: As a California state senator, Scott Wiener authored legislation aimed at curbing the risks of advanced AI. Now, after winning a tight congressional race for former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi’s open San Francisco seat, he could play a key role in setting federal AI policy. I spoke with Wiener on Friday, only a…
articles.titleEn: Nancy Pelosi’s replacement is ready to regulate AI
summaryLinesEn: Wiener’s congressional campaign received over $3 million from Public First Action, a nonprofit in favor of AI regulation that receives substantial funding from Anthropic.

The fact that voters approved 40 out of 41 anti-data-center ballot measures on Tuesday might seem to be a good sign for Wiener and others who support AI regulation, but Wiener says he sees this movement as far more tied to local concerns than to bigger questions about AI risk.
Once you’re in that realm, that really is potentially a recipe for total loss of control.”

articles.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
articles.descEn: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.
articles.titleEn: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
summaryLinesEn: Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has pulled out of the ElevenLabs Summit scheduled for this Wednesday in New York, ElevenLabs, the voice AI company, confirmed Monday.
The withdrawals come after Huang admitted to an extramarital affair over the weekend, and Nvidia opened an investigation into his relationship with a possible Chinese spy.

summaryLinesEn: AI’s power crunch has become so acute that Anthropic, a company that has generally avoided buying physical infrastructure, is spending $3.4 billion on natural gas turbines.
The company disclosed in its S-1 filing in May that it is paying SpaceX subsidiary xAI $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use xAI’s computing power.
The generators are capable of producing up to 1.7 gigawatts of electricity.

articles.title: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
articles.descEn: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison said in an earnings call that AI will ”significantly” reshape its business, and compared its impact on film to CGI.
articles.titleEn: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
summaryLinesEn: As a result of those tools, Ellison claims, “content will be easier to produce, projects across the organization will speed up, and how we work will transform.”
Ellison gave Terminator as an example, describing how it cost $4 million to make, but “if you wanted to make that picture today, shot for shot, it’s $60 to 70 million.”
During Paramount Skydance’s latest earnings call , CEO David Ellison said “it’s hard to imagine” AI won’t have a bigger impact on the film industry than CGI.

articles.title: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
articles.descEn: Apple has started selling $50 usage packs, giving users continued access to Creator Studio AI features that have usage limits.
articles.titleEn: Apple’s $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
summaryLinesEn: Users finding themselves running out of access can find the option to buy an Intelligence Usage Pack in the Intelligence Features > Show Usage section of the app’s main menu.

After publishing a support article in early September outlining usage limits for some Apple Intelligence features, the company has updated Logic Pro with an option to “Buy More Usage” for a one-time purchase price of $49.99, as spotted by 9to5Mac .

These Intelligence Usage Packs, as Apple calls them, will allow users to continue accessing certain Apple Intelligence features that have usage limits because they rely on cloud-based AI models from OpenAI or Google Gemini.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
articles.descEn: Anthropic is releasing Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, its most powerful models to date, in two versions: one freely available and one reserved for verified organizations. The models solve open physics problems, show stronger cybersecurity capabilities, design functioning operating systems, and write more than 90 percent of the changes merged into Anthropic's core code, according to the company. Anthropic says it has deliberately curbed any capabilities that would let the AI accelerate its own development.
articles.titleEn: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
summaryLinesEn: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 share the same model foundation but, just like their predecessors, differ in access.
Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 reclaim the AI performance lead shortly before the company's IPO, in some cases by a wide margin.
Ad The models produce output up to 30 percent faster than Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, Anthropic says.

articles.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
articles.descEn: Meta is introducing Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model, optimized for repetitive agent tasks such as tool calls, routing, and data extraction. According to Meta, it delivers more intelligence per dollar than Claude Haiku 5.5 or GPT-6 Luna. But it falls short when it comes to actual programming tasks.
articles.titleEn: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
summaryLinesEn: Muse Ember leads in most of Meta's own tests, but Haiku outperforms it on real coding tasks in FrontierCode 2.0-AA, scoring 34.9 percent to Muse Ember's 27.2 percent.
Meta has introduced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model to date.
It's available now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

articles.title: IBM's enterprise AI operating model takes shape - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: IBM is building an enterprise AI operating model around hybrid cloud, agent orchestration, trusted data and governance to bring AI into production.
articles.titleEn: IBM's enterprise AI operating model takes shape - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: IBM already has a substantial book of business around generative AI, with AI-related software sales and consulting engagements totaling more than $12.5 billion as of Q4 2025 , up from $9.5 billion the previous quarter.

This feature is part of SiliconANGLE Media’s exploration of how enterprise AI has moved beyond the race for model supremacy, with major technology players now focused on enabling governed enterprise AI that delivers trust, reliability and predictable business outcomes.
Its goal is to help companies maintain operational consistency even as AI regulations and geopolitics constantly shift.

articles.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
articles.descEn: AI leaders claim their tech will fix the climate. The evidence mostly points in the opposite direction so far.
articles.titleEn: The climate case for AI has not been made
summaryLinesEn: At this point it would be surprising if the sector even manages to zero out its climate pollution: Emissions associated with global data centers (which may handle AI as well as non-AI computing tasks) could exceed 300 million tons annually in 2035, according to the IEA’s base forecast .
CATL—which controls roughly 40% of the global market for electric-vehicle batteries—launched an AI system trained on more than 100,000 battery design cases and 600 terabytes of test data.

A peer-reviewed study published last year, led by researchers at the London School of Economics’ Grantham Research Institute and the firm Systemiq, estimated that AI could help cut global emissions by the equivalent of 3.2 to 5.4 billion tons of carbon dioxide annually by 2035—roughly on par with the US’s annual energy-related emissions on the high end, even after subtracting AI’s own energy footprint.

localization.title: AI에 대한 기후 사례는 아직 만들어지지 않았음
summaryLines: 현 시점에서 해당 부문이 기후 오염을 완전히 제거할 수 있다면 놀라운 일이 될 것임 · IEA의 기본 예측에 따르면 글로벌 데이터 센터(AI 및 비AI 컴퓨팅 작업을 처리할 수 있음)와 관련된 배출량은 2035년에 연간 3억 톤을 초과할 수 있음
전 세계 전기 자동차 배터리 시장의 약 40%를 장악하고 있는 CATL은 100,000개 이상의 배터리 설계 사례와 600테라바이트의 테스트 데이터를 학습한 AI 시스템을 출시함

런던 정경대학(London School of Economics)의 Grantham Research Institute와 Systemiq 회사의 연구자들이 주도한 동료 검토 연구에서는 AI가 2035년까지 연간 32억~54억 톤에 달하는 이산화탄소 배출량을 줄이는 데 도움이 될 수 있다고 추정함 · 이는 AI의 자체 에너지 발자국을 차감한 후에도 미국의 연간 에너지 관련 배출량과 대략 비슷한 수준임

articles.title: Nvidia espionage scandal weakens Huang's lobby against tighter AI chip export controls
articles.descEn: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman US intelligence agencies classify as a suspected Chinese informant. The board has launched an independent investigation. The affair weakens Huang's lobbying efforts against stricter AI chip export controls, with a newly elected Democratic Congress poised to ramp up scrutiny of AI chip smuggling to China and push for tighter restrictions.

summaryLinesEn: Tech stocks fell, with a collective loss of $2.5 trillion in market cap , and the Nasdaq dropped more than 5.5%.
A GPU-based AI economy will shift in the next several years, Furrier believes, which could lead to surprising winners and losers.
He thinks the tech titans are in a solid position while neoclouds are taking on a greater share of risk by pioneering a new software model, although not all of them will make it in the long term.

articles.title: Meta is expanding AI age detection for Instagram teen accounts - Engadget
articles.descEn: The company will increase its use of the tech on Facebook and Threads too.
articles.titleEn: Meta is expanding AI age detection for Instagram teen accounts - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Update, November 9, 2026, 2:12PM ET: A previous version of this story indicated that Meta is using bone structure analysis of photos, as well as mentions of things like school grades or birthday celebrations to estimate a person's age.
If the systems determine the person is aged between 13 and 17, they'll be funneled into a teen account, even if they used an adult date of birth while signing up.
In August, the company reached an agreement (under which it may have to pay as much as $18 billion) with 52 attorneys general to settle a lawsuit that alleged harms to young users of its apps.

articles.title: Authors Can Defend Against AI Allegations With ‘Paper Trail’ Tools. Is It Enough?
articles.descEn: As the publishing industry wrestles with paranoia over the provenance of manuscripts, writers are caught in an impossible bind.
articles.titleEn: Authors Can Defend Against AI Allegations With ‘Paper Trail’ Tools. Is It Enough?
summaryLinesEn: While Pangram claims an “industry-leading” false positive rate of 0.01 percent when used on creative writing, Rasenberger said the Authors Guild has “heard of lots of instances where people have put their own human-authored work in Pangram and gotten a result back saying it was AI-generated.”

Rasenberger worries that authors are up against a climate of distrust—they should “refrain from accusations of other authors because it just does not support a healthy literary community,” she says—and overconfidence in AI detection tools, which can be fooled and have been known to produce false positives.
According to Pangram , a robust but by no means infallible AI detection tool, some 78 percent of the text was AI-generated.

localization.title: 저자는 'Paper Trail' 도구를 사용하여 AI 주장을 방어할 수 있음 · 충분합니까
summaryLines: Pangram은 창의적인 글쓰기에 사용될 때 "업계 최고의" 오탐률이 0.01%라고 주장하지만 Rasenberger는 Authors Guild가 "사람들이 자신의 인간 저작물을 Pangram에 넣고 그것이 AI로 생성되었다는 결과를 얻은 사례를 많이 들었다"고 말함
Rasenberger는 작가들이 불신의 분위기에 직면해 있다고 걱정함 · 그들은 "건강한 문학 공동체를 지원하지 않기 때문에 다른 작가들의 비난을 삼가야 합니다"라고 그녀는 말함 · 그리고 속일 수 있고 거짓 긍정을 생성하는 것으로 알려진 AI 탐지 도구에 대한 과신이 있음
강력하지만 결코 오류가 없는 AI 탐지 도구인 Pangram에 따르면 텍스트의 약 78%가 AI에서 생성됨

articles.title: Medium's new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
articles.descEn: Medium's new writing app embraces AI-assisted writing, despite growing controversy over the technology's role in publishing.
articles.titleEn: Medium's new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
summaryLinesEn: “This is a start of what we believe is required to publish in the AI era, which is to make the provenance of writing clear, transparent, and inspectable, right down to the prompting and source material,” Medium explained in a blog post about the launch.
Online publishing platform Medium on Monday launched a new app, called TK, which aims to bring AI technology deeper into the writing process.
The company suggests the AI assistant could help answer questions that you might normally have to switch to another tab to quickly look up, like how many days are in a particular month.

articles.titleEn: Introducing the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2
summaryLinesEn: We test 120 questions with variations such as reordered options, swapped labels, and negated yes/no questions, then measure how consistent the model’s probabilities are across those variations ➤ AA-Omniscience-Decision v1.1 and HLE-MultiChoice v1.1 (15% each, down from 25%): AA-Omniscience-Decision now varies the wording of its “I don’t know” option across ten alternatives.

➤ Three decision models sit within 1 point at the top of the Index: Drex Max v1.1 from Nace AI and GLiDE v1.2 from Fastino Labs both score 73, with Mammoth 27B from Base Labs scoring 72 ➤ Cost per 1M Tasks varies by more than 60x across decision models: Celeris-1.1 Decision ($14), Decider v1.2 ($68) and Drex Max v1.1 ($102) sit on the Decision Index vs.

This means GLiDE v1.2 costs $780, nearly 8x higher than Drex Max v1.1 despite only 33% higher list prices ➤ Language models can score higher, alongside higher Cost and Time per Task: Claude Haiku 5.5 (Max) scores 77 and GPT-6 Luna (Max) scores 76 on Decision Index v2, putting them ~3 points ahead of Drex Max v1.1.

summaryLines: 재정렬된 옵션, 교체된 레이블, 부정된 예/아니요 질문과 같은 변형을 사용하여 120개의 질문을 테스트한 다음 해당 변형에서 모델의 확률이 얼마나 일관성이 있는지 측정함 · ➤ AA-Omniscience-Decision v1.1 및 HLE-MultiChoice v1.1(각각 15%, 25%에서 감소): AA-Omniscience-Decision은 이제 10개의 대안에 걸쳐 "모름" 옵션의 표현을 변경함

➤ 세 가지 결정 모델이 지수 상단에서 1포인트 이내에 위치함 · Nace AI의 Drex Max v1.1과 Fastino Labs의 GLiDE v1.2는 모두 73점, Base Labs의 Mammoth 27B는 72점 ➤ 1M 작업당 비용은 결정 모델에 따라 60배 이상 다름 · Celeris-1.1 Decision($14), Decider v1.2($68) 및 Drex Max v1.1($102)은 의사결정 지수에 있음

즉, GLiDE v1.2의 가격은 780달러로 정가가 33%만 높음에도 불구하고 Drex Max v1.1보다 거의 8배 더 높음 · ➤ 언어 모델은 더 높은 작업당 비용 및 시간과 함께 더 높은 점수를 받을 수 있음 · Claude Haiku 5.5(Max)는 Decision Index v2에서 77점, GPT-6 Luna(Max)는 76점으로 Drex Max v1.1보다 3점 정도 앞서 있음

즉, GLiDE v1.2의 가격은 780달러로 정가가 33%만 높음에도 불구하고 Drex Max v1.1보다 거의 8배 더 높음 · ➤ 언어 모델은 더 높은 작업당 비용 및 시간과 함께 더 높은 점수를 받을 수 있음 · Claude Haiku 5.5(Max)는 Decision Index v2에서 77점, GPT-6 Luna(Max)는 76점으로 Drex Max v1.1보다 3점 정도 앞서 있음

summaryLinesEn: BCP 作成を行動に変える、平時の体制整備ハンドブック～災害への備えと「対話」～ （前半）令和7年度 社会福祉推進事業 医療扶助における多剤・重複投薬対策等の効果的かつ効率的な実施方法等に関する調査研究 報告書 （後半）令和7年度 社会福祉推進事業 医療扶助における多剤・重複投薬対策等の効果的かつ効率的な実施方法等に関する調査研究 報告書 令和7年度 障害者総合福祉推進事業 共同生活援助の質の確保のための（自立支援）協議会の役割等に関する実態調査 報告書

本調査研究事業は、福祉事務所が実施する被保護者健康管理支援事業等の実態把握を行うとともに、「被保護者健康管理支援事業の手引き（第2版）」の改定方策を検討すること、同時に、令和7年度より始まった都道府県による市町村支援の実施実態等を把握すること等を目的として実施した。

articles.title: 減少する児童館の新たな役割
articles.titleEn: 減少する児童館の新たな役割
summaryLinesEn: 担い手が多様化するなかで、公的施設である児童館が、地域でどのような役割を果たすのかが、あらためて問われている。
一方、児童館の数は2006年の4,718館をピークに減少し、24年には4,248館となった。
2023年12月に「こどもの居場所づくりに関する指針」が閣議決定されるなど、こどもの居場所づくりは政策として推進され、こども食堂や学習支援の場など、NPOや地域住民が担う多様な居場所が全国で広がっている。

articles.title: 規制見直しのその先へ
articles.titleEn: 規制見直しのその先へ
summaryLinesEn: 本誌2024年10月号で述べたように、技術を使う側には新たな仕組みの導入に伴うリスクへの懸念が、売る側には販売の見通しが立たず開発や営業に人員・資金を振り向けにくいという事情があり、双方に障壁が存在する。
政府が目視や現地での確認などを求める約1万条項のアナログ規制を見直したことは、意義ある一歩であった。

articles.title: 2026 APAC Shopping Season Playbook
articles.descEn: Explore APAC’s 2026 shopping seasons, from Singles’ Day to Diwali, Lunar New Year, and Ramadan. See app and ad trends, standout markets & categories.
articles.titleEn: 2026 APAC Shopping Season Playbook
summaryLinesEn: Global shopping app downloads are forecast to reach 6.43 billion in 2026 , remaining above 6 billion for a fourth consecutive year.

China shows a different pattern: mid-year activity overlaps with the 618 festival, and the 2026 forecast peaks in October, within the broader Golden Week and Singles’ Day promotional window, before easing.
These differences support planning around multiple local shopping occasions rather than applying one year-end campaign calendar across the region.

articles.title: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
articles.descEn: NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production
summaryLinesEn: Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box.
They help developers bring Korea’s open models into production faster and turn them into broadly accessible AI for All services.

NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models: A.X K2 from SK Telecom , K-EXAONE 2.0 from LG AI Research , Solar Open 2 from Upstage and Motif-3 from Motif Technologies .

articles.title: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
articles.descEn: NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.
articles.titleEn: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.

The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.

Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference.

summaryLines: 엔비디아와 한국 과학기술정보통신부(MSIT)는 AI 반도체와 데이터센터 인프라부터 인재, 스타트업, 모델, 에이전트, 보안에 이르기까지 국가의 AI 생태계 전반에 걸쳐 협력을 확대하고 있음
이번 협력은 한국 NPU 및 XPU 기업이 NVIDIA NVLink Fusion 생태계에 참여할 수 있는 토대를 마련하고 GPU 활용도를 강화하기 위한 NVIDIA 교육 및 인증 프로그램, 해커톤 및 기술 세미나를 포함함
한국의 AI for All 이니셔티브를 통해 NVIDIA는 선정된 3개의 컨소시엄 및 4개의 주요 한국 기반 모델 구축업체와 협력하여 NVIDIA Dynamo 소프트웨어를 사용하여 AI 추론을 최적화하고 확장할 예정임

articles.title: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
articles.descEn: Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence explore NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure enterprise agents, and LG AI Research opens API for ‘K-EXAONE-2.5’ trained on Nemotron datasets.
articles.titleEn: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA
summaryLinesEn: Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts.
As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them.
On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea .

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
articles.descEn: Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum
summaryLinesEn: NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage.

The planned investments build on NVIDIA’s work with Korea’s startup and venture community, including more than 1,000 Korea-based members of NVIDIA Inception , a program that helps startups grow with access to preferred pricing, technical expertise and opportunities for investor introductions.

Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure.

summaryLines: NVIDIA는 또한 Motif Technologies, RLWRLD 및 Upstage에 대한 추가 투자 계획과 함께 한국 스타트업 Point2에 대한 투자를 발표함
계획된 투자는 스타트업이 우대 가격, 기술 전문 지식 및 투자자 소개 기회를 이용하여 성장할 수 있도록 돕는 프로그램인 NVIDIA Inception의 한국 기반 회원 1,000명 이상을 포함하여 한국 스타트업 및 벤처 커뮤니티와의 NVIDIA의 협력을 기반으로 함
AI 상호 연결 회사인 Point2 Technology는 AI 공장의 칩과 랙 간에 데이터를 이동하는 확장 가능한 무선 주파수 기반 상호 연결을 구축하여 AI 클러스터 확장을 위한 기존 구리 및 광 상호 연결 솔루션에 대한 혁신적인 대안을 제공하고 차세대 AI 인프라에 필요한 도달 범위, 성능 및 효율성을 제공함

articles.title: The Radish AI team joins Lovable to scale agentic capabilities for businesses | Lovable
articles.descEn: Lovable has acquired the team behind Radish AI, an agentic infrastructure platform. Its co-founders join our engineering team in London and Stockholm to build the agent capabilities and infrastructure behind Lovable.
articles.titleEn: The Radish AI team joins Lovable to scale agentic capabilities for businesses | Lovable
summaryLinesEn: Adrian Zgorzałek spent 12 years at Meta leading developer experience and infrastructure efforts across social graph distributed systems, privacy infrastructure, and GraphQL.

As millions of people build with Lovable, more of them are using it to run and grow their businesses—from tools that help them manage their operations to the software their whole company runs on, increasingly with AI automating core processes.
That's why we're excited to announce that Lovable has acquired the team behind Radish AI.

수백만 명의 사람들이 Lovable을 사용하여 구축함에 따라 운영 관리에 도움이 되는 도구부터 회사 전체가 실행하는 소프트웨어에 이르기까지 비즈니스를 운영하고 성장시키는 데 더 많은 사람들이 Lovable을 사용하고 있으며 AI가 핵심 프로세스를 자동화하는 경우가 점점 늘어나고 있음
이것이 바로 우리가 Lovable이 Radish AI 팀을 인수했다는 소식을 발표하게 되어 기쁘게 생각하는 이유임

articles.title: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
articles.descEn: At the Conference on Robot Learning, NVIDIA is introducing GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks, built in collaboration with partners, bringing precision and scale to robot training.
articles.titleEn: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
summaryLinesEn: Its latest release, Isaac Lab 3.0 , allows researchers to use agents to quickly set up training environments with simulation-ready assets , switch between NVIDIA PhysX and Newton physics solvers , choose renderers for perception-based training and apply a new reinforcement post-training library to foundation models like GR00T.

The shift from locomotion to manipulation is taking center stage at this week’s Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) in Austin, Texas, alongside the rise of agentic robotics — a new paradigm that integrates frontier agents to create interpretable code for physical robotics systems.
Trained on diverse robot and human data, including 100,000 hours of NVIDIA open source human egocentric data , the model enables robots to learn dexterous manipulation skills.

localization.title: 연습이 정확함을 만듬 · CoRL에서 NVIDIA와 파트너가 로봇이 시뮬레이션에서 섬세한 작업을 연습하는 방법을 공개함
summaryLines: 최신 릴리스인 Isaac Lab 3.0을 통해 연구자는 에이전트를 사용하여 시뮬레이션 지원 자산으로 교육 환경을 신속하게 설정하고, NVIDIA PhysX와 Newton 물리 솔버 간 전환하고, 인식 기반 교육을 위한 렌더러를 선택하고, GR00T와 같은 기초 모델에 새로운 강화 사후 교육 라이브러리를 적용할 수 있음
이동에서 조작으로의 전환은 이번 주 텍사스주 오스틴에서 열리는 로봇 학습 컨퍼런스(CoRL)에서 에이전트 로봇공학의 부상과 함께 중심 무대로 자리잡고 있음 · 에이전트 로봇공학은 물리적 로봇 시스템을 위한 해석 가능한 코드를 생성하기 위해 프론티어 에이전트를 통합하는 새로운 패러다임임
100,000시간의 NVIDIA 오픈 소스 인간 자기 중심 데이터를 포함하여 다양한 로봇 및 인간 데이터에 대해 훈련된 이 모델을 통해 로봇은 능숙한 조작 기술을 배울 수 있음

articles.title: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan: A Synthetic Dataset Capturing Japan's Demographics and Financial Context
articles.descEn: A Blog post by NVIDIA on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Nemotron-Personas-Finance-Japan: A Synthetic Dataset Capturing Japan's Demographics and Financial Context
summaryLinesEn: It holds 9M personas, 50% more than Nemotron-Personas-Japan, across 50 fields instead of 22.

Open Data Breaking Down Privacy Barriers to Pave the Way for AI in Finance A compound AI approach to Japanese personas grounded in real-world distributions In the financial sector, the utilization of real-world data faces significant constraints due to strict privacy regulations, compliance requirements, and the need for advanced domain expertise.

In this context, the development of agentic AI in the financial domain requires synthetic data capable of avoiding the risks of using real data while reflecting demographics, household structures, and asset statuses to reproduce diverse, realistic financial scenarios.

articles.title: Turn buying signals into pipeline with Sendoso gifts in Genie One | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Sales, marketing and customer success teams can turn intent signals into approved gifts in Genie One with Sendoso's MCP server, and track what they drive.
articles.titleEn: Turn buying signals into pipeline with Sendoso gifts in Genie One | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Gift history lives in the same workspace as pipeline data, so teams can report on the deals each gift influenced and manage gifting like any other investment.
Gifting is worth the effort because other channels are crowded: Sendoso's 2026 Digital Fatigue Report found 84% of buyers are fatigued by cold calls and 83% by marketing emails.
Sendoso's MCP server brings gifting and direct mail into Genie One, so business teams can turn an intent signal from their own data into a previewed, approved gift in one conversation.

summaryLines: 선물 내역은 파이프라인 데이터와 동일한 작업 공간에 있으므로 팀은 각 선물이 영향을 준 거래에 대해 보고하고 다른 투자와 마찬가지로 선물을 관리할 수 있음

Sendoso의 MCP 서버는 Genie One에 선물 및 다이렉트 메일을 제공하므로 비즈니스 팀은 한 번의 대화를 통해 자체 데이터의 의도 신호를 미리 보고 승인된 선물로 전환할 수 있음

articles.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
articles.descEn: We asked Claude to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet. The prototypes worked without any fixes to their circuitry.
articles.titleEn: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
summaryLinesEn: You have to not only design and simulate a circuit board, but also reason about the board’s physical layout and how it will behave, model the mechanical components, and write firmware—all while keeping track of which parts are readily available and what a factory is set up to build.
Because the devices are early prototypes, we don’t yet know how they’ll hold up with continued use or whether they would pass commercial certifications.

To see how newer Claude models have improved in this area, we collaborated with Diode again, this time asking Claude Fable 5.2 to design three electronic devices: a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet.

summaryLines: 회로 기판을 설계하고 시뮬레이션할 뿐만 아니라 기판의 물리적 레이아웃과 작동 방식을 추론하고, 기계 구성 요소를 모델링하고, 펌웨어를 작성하는 동시에 어떤 부품을 쉽게 사용할 수 있는지, 어떤 공장이 구축되어 있는지 추적해야 함
이 장치는 초기 프로토타입이기 때문에 계속 사용할 수 있을지, 상용 인증을 통과할지 여부는 아직 알 수 없음
이 분야에서 최신 Claude 모델이 어떻게 개선되었는지 확인하기 위해 우리는 Diode와 다시 협력하여 이번에는 Claude Fable 5.2에게 스피커폰, 음성 지원 허브, 휴대용 가상 애완동물 등 세 가지 전자 장치를 설계하도록 요청함

articles.title: Accelerate GPU training on Unity Catalog tables with UCDataset | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: UCDataset, now in Beta on AI Runtime, streams Unity Catalog tables directly to every GPU in a PyTorch training job, with no exports or custom loader code.
articles.titleEn: Accelerate GPU training on Unity Catalog tables with UCDataset | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Getting it into a distributed training job means picking one of three workarounds, and each one costs you time and money:
UCDataset is a native PyTorch data loader that streams Unity Catalog tables directly to every GPU in your training job, with no exports, no copies, and no custom loader code.
Most training data for your models already lives in Unity Catalog tables.

articles.title: Databricks' Commitment to European Sovereignty | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Databricks is expanding its European sovereignty capabilities across both AWS and Azure, enabling organizations to meet evolving data-residency and sovereignty requirements on the cloud of their choice.
articles.titleEn: Databricks' Commitment to European Sovereignty | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Databricks is classified as a regional service on Azure and has been Azure EU Data Boundary compliant since EUDB launched.
That investment has always been driven by a specific philosophy: customers should control where their data lives, how it's protected, and who can access it.
In addition, European customers can now contract directly with a Databricks European Union (EU) entity, making procurement simpler for customers that require a European counterparty.

articles.title: Single-shot and agentic retrieval with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports single-shot RAG and retrieval-only requests through AgenticRetrieveStream, alongside agentic retrieval. This post explains how the maxAgentIteration parameter matches retrieval effort to each request, using an illustrative internal banking policy assistant.
articles.titleEn: Single-shot and agentic retrieval with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Single-shot RAG uses one foundation model call to generate the answer, which can reduce latency and model usage compared with agentic retrieval.
The expanded maxAgentIteration range closes that gap.
Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base now supports single-shot Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and retrieval-only requests through AgenticRetrieveStream .

articles.titleEn: Q3 2026 Index Report: Digital Market Trends & Data
summaryLinesEn: Q3 Digital Market Index Report: A Cheat Sheet to the Landscape Digital Attention Shifts to Native Apps, Pulling Attention Away from Web: Global web visits totaled 1.96 trillion in Q3 2026 (-3% YoY), while time spent fell to 397 billion hours (-4.4% YoY) as user attention migrated toward native mobile apps.
Ad impressions expanded 5.3% YoY to 4.8 trillion, reflecting aggressive budget commitments and rising competition.
US Digital Ad Spend Nears Record Peak: Digital ad spend in the United States grew 17.4% YoY this quarter, pulling within 2% of the historic holiday peak set in Q4 2025.

articles.title: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
articles.descEn: How we replaced frontend Firestore listeners with a Go and NATS realtime service, with reactive authorization, server-shaped payloads, and 2.06 million live subscriptions.
articles.titleEn: How we moved our frontend off Firestore and built Lovable Realtime | Lovable
summaryLinesEn: The service handles peaks of over 2 million concurrent subscriptions and delivers around 2.6 billion data and patch frames per month.
We needed the backend to decide what each user received and keep that decision up to date as both the data and their permissions changed.

When a NATS message arrives, the pod dispatches it to every matching subscription instance, which re-evaluates its data projection, deduplicates via xxh3-128 hash, and pushes the deltas to the frontend if the output changed.

summaryLines: 이 서비스는 최대 200만 건 이상의 동시 구독을 처리하고 매월 약 26억 개의 데이터 및 패치 프레임을 제공함
각 사용자가 수신한 내용을 결정하고 데이터와 권한이 변경됨에 따라 해당 결정을 최신 상태로 유지하기 위해 백엔드가 필요함
NATS 메시지가 도착하면 포드는 이를 일치하는 모든 구독 인스턴스에 전달함 · 그러면 데이터 프로젝션을 다시 평가하고 xxh3-128 해시를 통해 중복을 제거하며 출력이 변경되면 델타를 프런트엔드에 푸시함

articles.title: How Smart Glasses Detector Apps Work, and How Much You Can Trust Them - CNET
articles.descEn: Detector apps can identify Meta’s glasses and similar devices by their Bluetooth signals, as long as they’re switched on, nearby and broadcasting.
articles.titleEn: How Smart Glasses Detector Apps Work, and How Much You Can Trust Them - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Smart glasses do the same thing, and apps such as Zuckoff listen for signals that match known models, then send an alert when one turns up nearby.

Unlike with smartphones, where it’s easier to tell when someone is recording or taking photos, “smart glasses shift the burden of privacy entirely onto the person being photographed,” Ananthakrishnan said.
“We made the decision from the beginning that smart glasses don’t need to have cameras on them in order to be useful,” Even Realities CEO Will Wang told CNET in an email.

summaryLines: 스마트 안경도 동일한 기능을 수행하며, Zuckoff와 같은 앱은 알려진 모델과 일치하는 신호를 듣고 근처에 신호가 나타나면 경고를 보냄
누군가가 녹음하고 사진을 찍고 있는지 쉽게 알 수 있는 스마트폰과 달리 스마트 안경은 개인 정보 보호에 대한 부담을 전적으로 사진을 찍는 사람에게 전가한다고 Ananthakrishnan은 말함

articles.title: How CrossnoKaye grounds physical AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: CrossnoKaye brought physical AI to heavy industry with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Its ATLAS platform and AURA agentic system ground AI reasoning in live plant data and run verifiable Python in isolated AgentCore sandboxes, giving plant engineers checkable, math-backed answers instead of model guesses.
articles.titleEn: How CrossnoKaye grounds physical AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Figure 1: CrossnoKaye AURA and ATLAS physical AI architecture with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore First, the plant is defined in software from the edge up.
At an aggregates quarry running primary, secondary, and tertiary rock crushers, the back half of the plant tripped twice in a single shift.

Because ATLAS already manages the facility model, the base control software, the historian, and the optimization applications in one platform on AWS, CrossnoKaye’s agentic intelligence system, AURA, has native access to the full operational state of the plant within a single security boundary.

summaryLines: 그림 1: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore를 사용한 CrossnoKaye AURA 및 ATLAS 물리적 AI 아키텍처 먼저, 플랜트는 처음부터 소프트웨어로 정의됨
1차, 2차, 3차 암석 분쇄기를 운영하는 골재 채석장에서 공장의 뒤쪽 절반이 단일 교대조로 두 번 넘어졌음
ATLAS는 이미 AWS의 단일 플랫폼에서 시설 모델, 기본 제어 소프트웨어, 히스토리언 및 최적화 애플리케이션을 관리하고 있기 때문에 CrossnoKaye의 에이전트 인텔리전스 시스템인 AURA는 단일 보안 경계 내에서 공장의 전체 운영 상태에 기본적으로 액세스할 수 있음

articles.title: Can We Trust AI Agents When Zero Trust Isn’t Really Zero
articles.descEn: As autonomous AI agents work together, verifying their actions, enforcing security policies, and maintaining accountability becomes increasingly difficult
articles.titleEn: Can We Trust AI Agents When Zero Trust Isn’t Really Zero
summaryLinesEn: As autonomous AI agents work together, verifying their actions, enforcing security policies, and maintaining accountability becomes increasingly difficult Vishal Sharma is a Reader in the School of Electronics, Electrical Engineering, and Computer Science at Queen's University Belfast, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom.

In a de-authentication attack on an aerial vehicle using a human- and agent-in-the-loop approach, an AI agent can quickly scan the active channel and autonomously intercept traffic, thus reducing the time to react and regain control.

articles.title: ASML Falls 20% in the Past Month as AI Growth Meets Execution Risk
articles.descEn: ASML shares have plunged 20% in a month despite robust AI demand, as premium valuation, capacity expansion challenges and export risks cloud its growth outlook.
articles.titleEn: ASML Falls 20% in the Past Month as AI Growth Meets Execution Risk
summaryLinesEn: ASML shares have fallen 20% in the past month even as the company continues to report rising demand tied to artificial intelligence, advanced Logic and Memory capacity, and greater lithography intensity.
ASML reported €11.7 billion in total net sales, a 57.5% gross margin and €5.0 billion in net income, while Installed Base Management sales reached €3.3 billion.
ASML's operating momentum remains favorable, but its valuation, manufacturing expansion, export-control exposure and High-NA adoption timelines leave meaningful execution risk.

articles.title: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
articles.descEn: Meta says it will use its AI technology to look for clues about people it suspects to be teenagers — even if they use an adult birthday.
articles.titleEn: Meta expands Instagram's AI age-guessing tech globally
summaryLinesEn: The global expansion comes as Meta reached settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every U.S. state and territory in August to resolve lawsuits alleging its platforms harm teens.

Meta announced on Monday that it’s expanding its AI-powered age-estimation technology on Instagram worldwide to identify more teens and place them under its Teen Account protections, as it faces numerous lawsuits accusing its platforms of harming teens.
Meta said parents in the U.S. will start seeing an in-feed video on Instagram explaining its approach to ensuring their teens are in age-appropriate protections.

localization.title: Meta, Instagram의 AI 연령 추측 기술을 전 세계적으로 확장
summaryLines: 이러한 글로벌 확장은 Meta가 플랫폼이 청소년에게 해를 끼친다고 주장하는 소송을 해결하기 위해 지난 8월 미국의 거의 모든 주 및 준주와 최대 180억 달러 규모의 합의에 도달함에 따라 이루어졌음
메타(Meta)는 플랫폼이 십대들에게 해를 끼친다고 비난하는 수많은 소송에 직면함에 따라 더 많은 십대들을 식별하고 그들을 십대 계정 보호 하에 두기 위해 전 세계 인스타그램에서 AI 기반 연령 추정 기술을 확장한다고 월요일 발표함
Meta는 미국의 부모들이 10대 자녀가 연령에 적합한 보호를 받을 수 있도록 하는 접근 방식을 설명하는 Instagram의 인피드 비디오를 보게 될 것이라고 말함

articles.title: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
articles.descEn: The New York Times has added a beta feature to its Cooking app that helps readers swap ingredients or adjust recipes to suit their needs. It mostly hits the mark.
articles.titleEn: I Used NYT Cooking’s New AI-Powered Recipe Modifier, and It’s Actually Pretty Good
summaryLinesEn: The Times doesn't share Cooking's subscriber numbers, but NYT executive communications director Jordan Cohen said the site and app were visited 514 million times in 2025, and its YouTube channel has over 1.4 million subscribers.

Earlier this year, the Times allowed AI to help with a recipe-scaling feature (modifying ingredient quantities so "serves 4" turns into "serves 6") and converting from imperial measurements to metric—cups, tablespoons, and Fahrenheit to grams, milliliters, and Celsius.

It thought about it for a moment—"simmering" in AI Cooking patois—and then offered up "Chicken Breast and Dumplings," with the "breast" in the title rendered in the red-orange color that indicates a modification.

localization.title: NYT Cooking의 새로운 AI 기반 레시피 수정자를 사용했는데 실제로 꽤 좋음
summaryLines: The Times는 Cooking의 구독자 수를 공유하지 않지만 NYT 커뮤니케이션 이사 Jordan Cohen은 사이트와 앱이 2025년에 5억 1,400만 번 방문했으며 YouTube 채널의 구독자 수는 140만 명 이상이라고 말함
올해 초 Times는 AI가 레시피 조정 기능(재료 수량을 수정하여 "4인분"이 "6인분"으로 바뀌도록 수정)과 영국식 단위를 미터법(컵, 큰 스푼, 화씨)으로 그램, 밀리리터, 섭씨로 변환하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있도록 허용함
AI Cooking patois에서 "끓는 중"으로 잠시 생각한 다음 "닭 가슴살과 만두"를 제안함 · 제목의 "가슴살"은 수정을 의미하는 빨간색-주황색으로 렌더링됨

articles.title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic
articles.descEn: Future versions of Apple’s Siri AI will be able to control third-party apps and perform more complex tasks.
articles.titleEn: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic
summaryLinesEn: Those capabilities are expected to land with iOS 27.3.
Apple is expected to push Siri to become more agentic and enable features that will allow it to perform ongoing tasks, not just one-offs.
Two significant improvements are expected to be made to Siri in the coming months.

articles.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
articles.descEn: OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy used Claude's Opus 5.5 to filter 43 million Hacker News comments into 6,454 curated videos. The result beats YouTube's own recommendations, he says.
articles.titleEn: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News
summaryLinesEn: Claude filtered 43 million comments from 20 years of Hacker News and distilled them into 6,454 videos that keep getting recommended there .
The site needs no login, shows a single mid-video frame instead of optimized thumbnails, and stores state locally in the browser.
Andrej Karpathy, OpenAI co-founder and current Anthropic AI researcher, built HackerTube over a weekend using Claude's Opus 5.5 model.

articles.title: Don't like Google Health's AI Coach? Here's how to turn it off - Engadget
articles.descEn: If this Premium feature is bugging you, there's good news: you aren't stuck with it.
articles.titleEn: Don't like Google Health's AI Coach? Here's how to turn it off - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Select Your data in Google Health then scroll down to Feature privacy controls and select Manage feature privacy controls .

If you don't like Google Health's AI Coach or need a break from its constant advice, the easiest way to get rid of it is to cancel your Google Health Premium subscription, since AI Coach does not come with the free Google Health tier.

Don't worry, because there is a way to keep Google Health Premium but temporarily (or permanently) set aside the Gemini-powered AI Coach in the app settings thanks to an update released in August 2026.

articles.title: I played Android’s first AI frame-gen game: Mobile just had its DLSS moment
articles.descEn: Can AI frame generation make 60 FPS ray tracing viable on phones? We test Arm's NFRU and Unreal's MegaLights in Neural Dawn to see if the illusion holds.
articles.titleEn: I played Android’s first AI frame-gen game: Mobile just had its DLSS moment
summaryLinesEn: Likewise, using upscaling and denoising to quadruple a game’s rendering resolution from 540p to 1080p leaves far more room for smudging, blurring, and other artifacts compared to taking an already healthy 1080p up to 4K.

Neural Dawn was initially locked to a very tight 60 FPS, but once the phone warmed up slightly and hit some more open-ended areas, the frame rate began to fluctuate due to the occasional missed frame.
The OPPO Find X10 Pro Max I played Neural Dawn on costs a whopping £1,799; you could buy three PlayStation 5s for that!

articles.title: Suno AI music generator sued again for copyright infringement - Engadget
articles.descEn: Groups that own the music rights to Elvis Presley and Eminem’s tracks filed the latest lawsuits.
articles.titleEn: Suno AI music generator sued again for copyright infringement - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: It recently filed a lawsuit against Anthropic , claiming $41 million in damages for allegedly training its AI models on the musician's works without permission.
New lawsuits are claiming that Suno has once again committed copyright infringement by using Elvis Presley and Eminem's likeness to create AI-generated songs.

As first reported by Variety , a group that owns the rights to Presley's music and Eight Mile Style, a music publishing company that owns hundreds of Eminem recordings, filed separate lawsuits against Suno.

articles.title: Teaching AI to build scientific models
articles.descEn: AI for Science grantees Jakob Macke, Daniel Gedon, and Stefan Wahl on how AI is starting to change how scientific models are built and interpreted.
articles.titleEn: Teaching AI to build scientific models
summaryLinesEn: Hodgkin and Huxley’s approach can be broken down into three steps, and most scientific modeling involves some version of them.
All SBI requires is that you can run the model: put in a set of parameters and get back the kind of data you would expect to see.
Hodgkin and Huxley’s four-particle hypothesis came about because equations involving the fourth power are what you would expect if four separate things all had to happen before a gate could open.

articles.title: Watch Tech Investor Dan Niles: AI Revenue Slowdown Demands Stock Picking - Bloomberg
articles.descEn: Niles Investment Management Founder and veteran tech investor Dan Niles says competition from open-source models is weighing on token prices and slowing revenue growth at leading artificial intelligence companies. articles.title: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
articles.descEn: Coreweave's steep yields reflect stress in the AI debt markets as investors worry about a data center slowdown. What comes next.
articles.titleEn: The AI ‘credit card’ is getting costlier as CoreWeave bond yield tops 16%
summaryLinesEn: Coreweave's five-year credit default swaps spiked above 1,289 basis points on Thursday, widening above their October peak, according to Deutsche Bank.
Moratoriums could impact 45% of planned capacity in the U.S. with a large amount of that in Texas, according to Goldman Sachs.
Goldman tallies five AI bond deals totaling $67 billion since October 29, pushing total hyperscaler debt issuance this year to $296 billion.

articles.title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
articles.descEn: China’s intelligence agency recruited a businesswoman, Alice Huang, to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times.
articles.titleEn: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy Apple’s M5 MacBook Air is down to its lowest price since July
China’s intelligence agency recruited Megaspeed executive Alice Huang to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to The New York Times .

summaryLinesEn: MobileGym , MemGUI-Bench , PhoneHarness , CopilotKit/OpenMuse , Open-AutoGLM , ClawGUI : the phone operator, the traces and the product ideas. nanoMuse is an independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms, Inc.; Muse is their trademark.

One agent with a name and a look of its own, in the style of Meta's Muse : it does things instead of answering questions, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and stops to ask before anything you could not undo. nano means the whole set, small enough to run and deploy yourself: the phone app, the desktop app, the web console and the relay that joins them are all in this repository, under GPL-3.0-or-later.

Open an issue or send a pull request ; either one helps nanoMuse get better. 2026-10-21 ⭐ 2,000 stars on GitHub and first on GitHub Trending's Swift list ( Trendshift : third on October 20, first on October 21), twenty-six days after the first release.

articles.title: WhatsApp’s AI-powered photo expansion tool starts rolling out on iOS - 9to5Mac
articles.descEn: Select WhatsApp users on TestFlight and in the main app are now seeing the option to expand an image in the app’s photo editor.
articles.titleEn: WhatsApp’s AI-powered photo expansion tool starts rolling out on iOS - 9to5Mac
summaryLinesEn: Once the process is complete, WhatsApp shows the expanded photo in the drawing editor, and users can choose to send it.

According to WABetaInfo , the platform is rolling out a Meta AI-powered image expansion tool, though it is currently limited to select users, primarily those in WhatsApp’s beta program via TestFlight.

Here are the details. iPhone users with access to Apple Intelligence have a native AI-powered photo expansion tool called Extend , which lets users pinch or drag to expand an image beyond its original borders.

articles.title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
articles.descEn: Election week is already reshaping the AI data center debate. This week on Equity, we dig into the fallout, plus Canva’s layoffs, a $115B chip deal, and microdramas.
articles.titleEn: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
summaryLinesEn: On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Kirsten Korosec, Sean O’Kane, and Anthony Ha discuss what the election will mean for the tech industry moving forward — not just when it comes to data centers (which OpenAI is already trying to rebrand ), but also increased government scrutiny of Big Tech.
Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry.
And even when data centers weren’t on the ballot directly, they were a major talking point, with newly-elected Democratic governors and congressmembers likely to support additional regulation .

articles.title: Midterm elections will put AI and data centers on trial, but will Big Tech end up winning anyway? - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Midterm elections will put AI and data centers on trial, but will Big Tech end up winning anyway? - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Midterm elections will put AI and data centers on trial, but will Big Tech end up winning anyway? - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: But then on Thursday, tech stocks almost across the board plunged back down even more for a collective loss of $2.5 trillion in market cap — the Nasdaq fell more than 5.5% — on more generalized worries that, well, the AI boom could slow.

The day after the elections, stocks of many tech companies shot up, a bit paradoxically because investors apparently believe potential limits on AI and data centers could tamp down spending on compute and thus improve tech company margins that have made investors nervous.

Here’s all of this week’s enterprise and emerging tech news, analysis and commentary from SiliconANGLE and beyond: Amazon, Microsoft and other tech giants close higher after Democrats’ midterm sweep No, data centers won’t get shut down, and AI will continue apace — just regulated as it needs to be, and we can hope it’s in the right way to protect people and communities and innovation all at the same time.

선거 다음 날, 많은 기술 기업의 주가가 급등함 · 약간 역설적이게도 투자자들은 AI와 데이터 센터에 대한 잠재적인 제한이 컴퓨팅에 대한 지출을 억제하여 기술 기업의 마진을 향상시켜 투자자들을 불안하게 만들 수 있다고 믿었기 때문임

다음은 SiliconANGLE 및 기타 지역에서 나온 이번 주의 모든 기업 및 신흥 기술 뉴스, 분석 및 논평임 · Amazon, Microsoft 및 기타 거대 기술 기업은 민주당의 중간 선거 이후 더 높은 수준으로 상승함 · 아니요, 데이터 센터는 폐쇄되지 않으며 AI는 계속해서 빠르게 발전할 것임 · 필요한 대로 규제되며 동시에 사람과 커뮤니티를 보호하고 혁신을 보호하는 올바른 방법이 되기를 바랄 수 있음

summaryLinesEn: Gogo Inc (GOGO) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Record Galileo Shipments Offset ATG Decline ...
The decline in consolidated financial results is attributed to a planned technology transition as legacy ATG customers migrate to next-generation products or experience expected attrition.

articles.title: GIGABYTE 'WRX90 AI TOP' Debuts with Up to 2TB Memory Support, 7 PCIe 5.0 Slots | ASCII.jp English Edition
articles.descEn: GIGABYTE, through its domestic authorized distributors, will begin handling the "WRX90 AI TOP" workstation motherboard, equipped with the AMD WRX90 chipset...
articles.titleEn: GIGABYTE 'WRX90 AI TOP' Debuts with Up to 2TB Memory Support, 7 PCIe 5.0 Slots | ASCII.jp English Edition
summaryLinesEn: The price is open, expected to be around 222,000 yen.
It features a 32+3+3+3 phase digital power design and supports R-DIMM DDR5 memory with a maximum total capacity of 2TB.
The target users are those in AI development and professional workstation users who require large-capacity memory, high-speed storage, and numerous expansion cards.

articles.title: TSMC Mulls Making Advanced AI Memory Chips, Information Says
articles.descEn: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is considering broadening its business to include advanced memory chip manufacturing, The Information reported, a move that would give the world’s largest chipmaker an even bigger share of the AI hardware supply chain.
articles.titleEn: TSMC Mulls Making Advanced AI Memory Chips, Information Says
summaryLinesEn: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is considering broadening its business to include advanced memory chip manufacturing, The Information reported Bloomberg Terminal , a move that would give the world’s largest chipmaker an even bigger share of the AI hardware supply chain.

The Taiwanese company recently began drafting plans to produce a particular type of advanced memory chips, known as 3D DRAM, at the request of Nvidia Corp. , its biggest customer, The Information reported, citing two people familiar with the plans.
The Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company fabrication plant in Phoenix, Arizona.

summaryLines: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.는 고급 메모리 칩 제조를 포함하도록 사업 확장을 고려하고 있다고 Bloomberg Terminal이 보도함 · 이는 세계 최대의 칩 제조업체가 AI 하드웨어 공급망에서 훨씬 더 큰 점유율을 차지하게 될 움직임임

articles.title: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Egyptian and Nigerian English join the Open ASR Leaderboard
summaryLinesEn: Because Liva owns both the collection environment and distribution, it can design products around specific model gaps across domains, industries, languages, modalities, and interaction types.
A few months ago, we added private data to the Open ASR Leaderboard : 11 splits from Appen and DataOceanAI covering scripted and conversational speech from five accents ( blog ).
We’re excited to announce a new collaboration with Liva AI to add even more private data with two new accents: Egyptian 🇪🇬 and Nigerian 🇳🇬.

articles.title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
articles.descEn: Over the past several months, we’ve partnered with six organizations to accelerate curing disease. We’ve also started drug discovery efforts of our own, including programs for rare childhood forms of muscular dystrophy. In this post, we provide an update on our progress.
articles.titleEn: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
summaryLinesEn: BMS is using Claude to assess plans of an early-stage drug in clinical trials, and to estimate the likelihood of those trials succeeding.

We’ve also recently launched an open call for guest investigators in the life sciences; we’re seeking proposals from research groups who want to use Claude to investigate key questions in drug discovery and other areas.
If Claude is to significantly increase the rate of new cures, we need to work with many more biotechnology firms and integrate Claude more deeply into their development processes.

articles.title: Investigating vault particles with Claude
articles.descEn: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells.
articles.titleEn: Investigating vault particles with Claude
summaryLinesEn: We began by using Claude Science to search for the vault protein’s relatives across a database of about 15 billion predicted proteins.
We moved the best performers into living E. coli bacteria, where 15 of 24 produced soluble protein.
We took the project on anyway, because Claude could make up for what we didn’t know and rapidly perform analyses that would otherwise have taken us much longer.

articles.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
summaryLinesEn: ToyBlocks scales data generation through generating and executing hundreds of such plans in parallel on a single graphics processing unit (GPU), reaching up to 24 times real-time performance.

During the episode, the agent muses, “I need to figure out whether pick-and-place naturally straightens orientation or if I need to correct it manually… I have 63 calls left, plenty to run a controlled test” (0:06).

Building on our earlier work in open robot learning, including MolmoAct 2 , MolmoBot , and MolmoSpaces , ToyBlocks gives researchers a way to study robotics questions in a deliberately constrained domain.

localization.title: ToyBlocks: 로봇 학습 및 평가를 위한 통제된 세계
summaryLines: ToyBlocks는 단일 그래픽 처리 장치(GPU)에서 수백 개의 이러한 계획을 병렬로 생성 및 실행하여 데이터 생성을 확장하여 실시간 성능을 최대 24배까지 향상시킴
에피소드 중에 에이전트는 "선택 및 배치가 자연스럽게 방향을 곧게 펴는지, 아니면 수동으로 수정해야 하는지 파악해야 함 · 통화가 63개 남았으니 통제된 테스트를 실행하기에 충분합니다."(0:06)라고 생각함
MolmoAct 2, MolmoBot 및 MolmoSpaces를 포함한 개방형 로봇 학습에 대한 이전 작업을 기반으로 ToyBlocks는 연구자에게 의도적으로 제한된 영역에서 로봇 공학 질문을 연구할 수 있는 방법을 제공함

articles.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
articles.descEn: With over a million downloads, NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools are equipping research institutions worldwide to develop wireless systems that help robots react faster, improve signal reception and match network capacity to demand.
articles.titleEn: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
summaryLinesEn: At the University of Leeds , researchers developed a system that predicts network demand 10 minutes ahead and uses those forecasts to guide base station sleep decisions.
Over the past year, global developer adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and NVIDIA Sionna software has grown 10x, while NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools have surpassed 1 million downloads.
Before powering down, it checks that neighboring active stations can continue serving affected devices and monitors for changes that require capacity to be restored.

articles.title: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Run Claude Code as a remote agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Each coding task runs in its own isolated session in your AWS account, every model call goes through Amazon Bedrock, and the result comes back as a GitHub pull request you review and merge.
articles.titleEn: Extend Claude Code to remote sessions on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with security controls | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Amazon Bedrock doesn’t use your content to train models or share it with model providers, and providers can’t access your prompts, completions, or the Amazon Bedrock service logs.
Model calls from remote tasks therefore keep the same security characteristics as Claude Code on your laptop.
Claude Code reviews the result with Claude Opus and can send it back to planning for another attempt, up to three attempts in total.

articles.descEn: Taxbit built Taxbit Assist, a cited, permission-aware AI assistant embedded in its enterprise dashboard, on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post shows how they grounded answers in a curated knowledge base, enforced role-aware and region-compliant safety, and continuously measured answer quality on live production traffic.
articles.titleEn: Taxbit Assist: A grounded, role-aware AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Today more than 55 percent of users who ask Assist a question return to ask another within 24 hours, according to Taxbit’s internal production analytics.

articles.title: The freed-up analyst: how AI leverage becomes a sourcing advantage
articles.descEn: Discover how AI frees analyst capacity for deal sourcing in banking. Learn why governed AI and compliance guardrails turn freed time into won mandates.
articles.titleEn: The freed-up analyst: how AI leverage becomes a sourcing advantage
summaryLinesEn: Deloitte estimated that generative AI could lift front-office productivity at the world’s largest investment banks by 27% to 35% by 2026, adding roughly $3.5 million in additional revenue per front-office employee.
Solomon’s example captures the shift happening across investment banking.

( Business Insider ) When every employee can delegate work to teams of agents, the question shifts from how many analysts you need to what team members, from junior to senior, should focus on with the time that is now freed up.

articles.title: How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Greenlight Financial resolves more than 90% of up to 4,000 monthly security and risk cases without human intervention using Luna, a tiered multi-agent system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post covers the architecture, episodic memory for continuous learning, and the expansion from SOC operations into financial risk triage.
articles.titleEn: How Greenlight Financial built an autonomous SOC solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The Tier 2 supervisor runs on a scheduled basis, using Amazon EventBridge rate triggers and Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) queue completions to batch-process escalated cases, and on demand for urgent Tier 1-escalated cases.
Invokes specialized agents through boto3 with expanded context windows.
Greenlight Financial resolves more than 90 percent of up to 4,000 security and risk cases each month without human intervention.

articles.title: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: As we built Amazon Quick, its agents grew from answering questions to taking actions, and the same primitives kept getting rebuilt under different names. This post shares the taxonomy we converged on — triggers, agents, capabilities, and learned context — found by decomposing agentic work into four plain questions: When, What, Who, and How.
articles.titleEn: Taxonomy of agentic primitives in Amazon Quick | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Because these primitives compose, the same request can be met several valid ways: A scheduled task with a one-line instruction, leaving the agent to figure out the rest.
Over the past year, as we built Amazon Quick, our agents went from answering questions to taking actions: scheduling meetings, running research, generating reports.
Next in the series: the agentic operating system that builds on these primitives and powers Amazon Quick.

articles.title: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports GPU partitioning with NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), which divides one GPU into hardware-isolated partitions so you can run a different model in each or take a right-sized fraction of a newer accelerator. This post shows how two optional API fields place one model per partition, and what we measured against a whole older GPU.
articles.titleEn: SageMaker Inference now supports Multi-Instance GPU to maximize GPU utilization for model endpoints | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Use multi-model endpoints – These load and unload models from a shared GPU on demand, which fits sparse, bursty traffic.
Today, Amazon SageMaker Inference supports GPU partitioning, which uses NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) to divide a physical GPU into independent partitions.

Because the split is in hardware rather than software, you get guarantees that other sharing methods can’t give: Predictable latency – Each partition has dedicated memory bandwidth, so one model’s traffic spike doesn’t show up in another model’s p99.
