articles.title: The components of agent memory
articles.descEn: For Claude to learn from experience, it has to decide what’s worth remembering before it knows what’s next. Here’s how “dreaming” helps it organize memory and correct mistakes.
articles.titleEn: The components of agent memory
summaryLinesEn: In this post, we share how we’ve come to think about agent memory and walk through several evaluations we’ve used to explore agent memory, including the use of dreaming, and what each component contributes to memory organization.
Sonnet 3.7’s approach was a problem mainly because the game state of Pokémon changes constantly—Sonnet 3.7’s detailed record was continuously going out of date.
By writing down a rule, an agent predicts that the pattern it’s describing will be relevant again.

articles.titleEn: Read, don't copy: replacing file and API feeds with OpenSharing - Part 1 (The Why) | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Read the customer's table in place instead of copying it: With OpenSharing, you can follow changes on the tables your customers share through streaming or change data feed, without tracking what's been processed yourself.
Can I get new data as soon as my customer writes it, instead of waiting for the next file drop?
Sharing gets easier for your customers: Adding you as a recipient is just a grant on a table they already maintain, and audit logs record every time you access their shared data.

articles.title: Beyond code generation: A developer's guide to agentic engineering
articles.descEn: Writing code got faster. The work around it didn't. See how you can plan, write code, review changes, and investigate production issues with GitHub Copilot.
articles.titleEn: Beyond code generation: A developer's guide to agentic engineering
summaryLinesEn: This October, GitHub saw more than 1.2 billion commits in one week—over 400% more than a year earlier.

As AI speeds up implementation, software developers are feeling more pressure in other places: a Faros AI study found that pull requests spent 441% longer in review when teams went from low to high AI adoption.
Copilot helps tasks progress independently with shared project knowledge, while letting you pick up a session where you left off across devices.

articles.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
articles.descEn: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.
articles.titleEn: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
summaryLinesEn: Other VC-backed companies that Palo Alto Networks has scooped up this year include NEA-backed Embrace, for $325 million ; Chronosphere, an observability platform backed by Greylock and Lux Capital, for $2.95 billion ; and Koi, a cyber startup backed by Battery and Team8, for $231 million , according to regulatory filings.
In September, Palo Alto Networks acquired Console, a two-year-old startup that uses AI agents to automate routine IT help desk tasks.

Palo Alto Networks is in talks to acquire Clutch Security , a startup that secures AI agents’ access to company systems, for $500 million in cash plus additional milestone-based payouts, according to a person familiar with the discussions.

summaryLines: Palo Alto Networks가 올해 인수한 다른 VC 지원 회사로는 NEA가 지원하는 Embrace(3억 2,500만 달러); Greylock과 Lux Capital이 지원하는 관측 플랫폼인 Chronosphere는 29억 5천만 달러에 판매됨 · 규제 서류에 따르면 Battery와 Team8의 지원을 받는 사이버 스타트업 Koi는 2억 3100만 달러에 인수됨
지난 9월 Palo Alto Networks는 AI 에이전트를 사용하여 일상적인 IT 헬프 데스크 작업을 자동화하는 2년 된 스타트업인 Console을 인수함
해당 논의에 정통한 소식통에 따르면 팔로알토 네트웍스는 AI 에이전트의 회사 시스템 액세스를 보호하는 스타트업인 클러치 시큐리티(Clutch Security)를 현금 5억 달러에 추가 마일스톤 기반 지급금으로 인수하기 위해 협상 중이라고 함

articles.title: Improve Social Media Management With Hootsuite's Social OS and MCP: A Guide by Software Experts
articles.descEn: Software Experts has recognized Hootsuite's Social OS and Hootsuite MCP in a new guide examining how AI social media management can connect publishing, customer service and social intelligence. Social OS brings content creation, reporting and customer interactions into a shared environment supported by live insights and conversational tools.
articles.titleEn: Improve Social Media Management With Hootsuite's Social OS and MCP: A Guide by Software Experts
summaryLinesEn: Hootsuite says Wisdom draws on more than 15 years of proprietary social data and over 150 million monitored data sources.
Hootsuite introduced Social OS and Wisdom on June 24, 2026, alongside Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors designed to bring Hootsuite capabilities into external AI workflows.
With 18 years of expertise and more than 25 million users, Hootsuite helps businesses identify relevant signals, make informed decisions and act on emerging opportunities.

articles.title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
articles.descEn: I’m not the sort of person who typically pays for a house cleaner. I’m too frugal, and I kind of enjoy putting on a podcast and going to town on my tub with a Magic Eraser. But when I saw an X post about a new humanoid-robot cleaning service in San Francisco, I immediately signed…
articles.titleEn: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
summaryLinesEn: At the time I booked, Tau was offering $30 for an hourlong cleaning with a single robot; now the charge is $60 per weekly cleaning with two robots, or $100 for a one-time visit.
Because this data is so valuable to Tau, the company charges less for cleaning than one might expect for such a cutting-edge product.
But when I saw an X post about a new humanoid-robot cleaning service in San Francisco, I immediately signed up for the waitlist.

articles.title: OPPO Partners with Manus to Bring Agentic AI Experiences to Smartphones | OPPO Malaysia
articles.descEn: OPPO today announced a collaboration with Manus, a leading AI agent platform, to bring next-generation agentic AI experiences to smartphones.
articles.titleEn: OPPO Partners with Manus to Bring Agentic AI Experiences to Smartphones | OPPO Malaysia
summaryLinesEn: Designed to move beyond simple question-and-answer interactions, AI Mind Pilot can understand a user's end goal, break it down into multiple steps, identify relevant information, select the appropriate tools, and deliver a finished result, including by working directly with files and photos stored on the device.
"Agentic AI marks an important shift from answering questions to helping users get things done." said Kai Tang, President of Software Engineering at OPPO.

By integrating Manus' agentic capabilities to OPPO AI Mind Pilot, the collaboration will help users turn complex, multi-step tasks into ready-to-use results—advancing OPPO's vision for Personalized Proactive Intelligence, where AI understands users and proactively helps them get things done.

summaryLines: 단순한 질문과 답변의 상호 작용을 넘어서도록 설계된 AI Mind Pilot은 사용자의 최종 목표를 이해하고, 이를 여러 단계로 나누고, 관련 정보를 식별하고, 적절한 도구를 선택하고, 장치에 저장된 파일 및 사진으로 직접 작업하는 것을 포함하여 최종 결과를 제공할 수 있음
"에이전트 AI는 질문에 답하는 것에서 사용자가 작업을 완료하도록 돕는 것으로 중요한 변화를 의미함" · OPPO의 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 사장인 Kai Tang은 말함
Manus의 에이전트 기능을 OPPO AI Mind Pilot에 통합함으로써 이번 협업은 사용자가 복잡하고 다단계 작업을 즉시 사용할 수 있는 결과로 전환하는 데 도움이 되며, AI가 사용자를 이해하고 작업을 완료하도록 사전에 지원하는 개인화 사전 지능에 대한 OPPO의 비전을 발전시킴

articles.descEn: UNESCO recently advocated a shift away from resource-intensive AI models in favour of more compact ones. The UNESCO report calls for governments and industry to invest in sustainable AI research and development. as a way to reduce energy consumption by up to 90%. articles.titleEn: On-device AI Is ready to challenge cloud dominance
summaryLinesEn: VisionPsy-Nano 460M-Flash is engineered for fast, real-world deployment on everyday smartphones (e.g., cutting time-to-first-response by up to 23x on a Pixel 9) while retaining around 99% of full model quality.

In the last couple of years, even the largest cloud providers have moved into compact VLMs, with Google evolving its lightweight open-weight lineup from PaliGemma in 2024 through the Gemma 3 and Gemma 4 families.

Driven by growing demand for localised user privacy, environmental concerns à la ‘tokenmaxxing’ , and efficiency required by some use cases, breakthroughs in smaller purpose-built AI models have shown developers that capable AI does not always require large cloud setups.

In the last couple of years, even the largest cloud providers have moved into compact VLMs, with Google evolving its lightweight open-weight lineup from PaliGemma in 2024 through the Gemma 3 and Gemma 4 families.

articles.title: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to build a serverless Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate that gives AI agents secure, metadata-driven access to an enterprise data lake. Exposing a new dataset requires only a JSON file, with no per-dataset integration code.
articles.titleEn: Serverless MCP server for AI agent data lake access on Amazon ECS Fargate | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The pipeline picks up metadata files, generates vector embeddings with Amazon Titan Text Embeddings, and indexes them into Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases.
Our team supports Amazon’s North America Sort Center (NASC) network, where planning teams rely on operational data to manage capacity, labor, and package flow.

Figure 1: Request flow through the serverless MCP server, from client applications to the data layer MCP client layer: Authentication and session management A request flows from the client application through Amazon Route 53 for DNS resolution to an Application Load Balancer configured with HTTPS and AWS WAF .

articles.title: China’s Hua Hong defies chip selloff on strong earnings, upbeat guidance
articles.descEn: Investing.com-- Hua Hong Grace Semiconductor (HK:1347) bucked a broad selloff in global chip stocks on Friday, as record quarterly revenue and stronger-than-expected guidance underscored resilient demand for artificial intelligence-related semiconductors and tightening supply across specialty chip markets.
articles.titleEn: China’s Hua Hong defies chip selloff on strong earnings, upbeat guidance
summaryLinesEn: HK A Look At Hua Hong Semiconductor (SEHK:1347) Valuation After Its Strong Recent Share Price Momentum Simply Wall St. • 8mo ago HHUSF Global chip stocks rally as Super Micro forecast revives AI demand optimism Investing.com • 19d ago SMCI SKHY SMIC shrugs off US curbs with record revenue outlook on back of tight chip supply South China Morning Post • 11mo ago 0981.

See this month's earnings picks » Excluding the newly acquired Huali Microelectronics, revenue reached $803.4 million, exceeding the company's previous guidance of $770 million to $780 million, while gross margin came in at 19.9%, above its forecast of 16% to 18%.
Hua Hong forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $1.08 billion to $1.09 billion, with gross margin of 25% to 26%, signalling further improvement in profitability.

summaryLines: 이 가이드는 11월 1일부터 12월 31일까지 미국 소매 사이트에 대한 AI 트래픽이 전년 대비 130% 증가할 것으로 예상하는 Adobe의 9월 28일 휴일 예측과 Google이 10월 15일 출시한 Universal Cart(검색 장바구니 및 소매업체 전체의 가격과 재고를 추적하는 Gemini 앱)를 따름

articles.titleEn: ACM Research Q3 Earnings Call Highlights

articles.title: Analyze your Stripe data directly with your agent
articles.descEn: You can now use natural language to create an investor slide deck highlighting where your business outperformed in the previous quarter, or build a custom dashboard to understand why your Stripe revenue changed.
articles.titleEn: Analyze your Stripe data directly with your agent
summaryLinesEn: If you want to better understand your subscriptions business, Stripe can route the agent to track monthly recurring revenue over time and attribute changes to upgrades, downgrades, churn, and anything else that is important for you to understand and take action on.

We introduced the ability for you to connect compatible agents such as Claude and Cursor to your Stripe analytics data via Stripe’s MCP or by using the Queries API and Reports API directly—now available for all Stripe users.
To make use of your Stripe data, an agent needs to know which tables to use, how Stripe defines the relevant metrics, and how to construct the analysis.

summaryLines: 구독 비즈니스를 더 잘 이해하려는 경우 Stripe는 에이전트를 라우팅하여 시간이 지남에 따라 매월 반복되는 수익을 추적하고 업그레이드, 다운그레이드, 이탈 및 이해하고 조치를 취하는 데 중요한 기타 사항에 대한 변경 사항을 지정할 수 있음
Claude 및 Cursor와 같은 호환 에이전트를 Stripe의 MCP를 통해 또는 Queries API 및 Reports API를 직접 사용하여 Stripe 분석 데이터에 연결할 수 있는 기능을 도입함 · 이제 모든 Stripe 사용자가 사용할 수 있음
Stripe 데이터를 활용하려면 상담원은 사용할 테이블, Stripe이 관련 측정항목을 정의하는 방법, 분석을 구성하는 방법을 알아야 함

articles.title: 日本の本当の強みはどこにあるのか
articles.titleEn: 日本の本当の強みはどこにあるのか
summaryLinesEn: 米中主導の国際社会への不安が広がるなか、ある調査によると国際社会から寄せられる安心感が日本はカナダに次いで高いという結果がでた。
日本はこれを活かし、アジアの一員という地理的特性をテコに国際協調の旗振り役となることで経済成長を促すことができるのではないか。

articles.title: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: A Closer Look at Phonon TTS. Launching High-Quality On-Device Speech That Tops the Benchmarks.
summaryLinesEn: How Phonon did on the Hugging Face Open TTS Leaderboard Two weeks ago, we opened up Phonon, our small text-to-speech model that runs on your own device.
It needs no server and no network, and what you type stays with you.
On intelligibility, Phonon ranks first in German and Spanish , and in the top three in every language we evaluated, next to models up to 100 times its size.

articles.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
articles.descEn: Genie 4 introduces real-time interactive world simulation with native audio, advanced physics, natural human motion, and steering powered by Gemini models.
articles.titleEn: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
summaryLinesEn: We have started rolling Genie 4 out as a research preview for trusted testers — gathering feedback before we release it to consumers and developers, starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

The Genie 4 model incorporates and builds on capabilities from the Gemini family: Gemini Omni anchors the simulations in real-world appearance and behavior, while other Gemini models provide the complex reasoning needed to help maintain a simulation’s coherence and continuity.
Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation.

summaryLines: 우리는 신뢰할 수 있는 테스터를 위한 연구 미리보기로 Genie 4를 출시하기 시작함 · Project Genie의 Google AI Ultra 구독자와 Gemini API 및 Google AI Studio의 조기 액세스 파트너를 시작으로 소비자와 개발자에게 출시하기 전에 피드백을 수집함
Genie 4 모델은 Gemini 제품군의 기능을 통합하고 구축함 · Gemini Omni는 실제 모양과 동작에 시뮬레이션을 고정하는 반면, 다른 Gemini 모델은 시뮬레이션의 일관성과 연속성을 유지하는 데 필요한 복잡한 추론을 제공함
오늘 우리는 전례 없는 현실감을 구현하고 실시간 대화형 시뮬레이션을 향상시키는 새로운 세계 모델인 Genie 4를 발표함

articles.title: Introducing Apache Spark® 4.3 - Now available in Databricks Runtime 19 | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Apache Spark 4.3 brings stateful streaming with millisecond-scale latency, history-preserving Auto CDC, and faster data and AI development.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Apache Spark® 4.3 - Now available in Databricks Runtime 19 | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Iterate faster and build with richer APIs: Project Feather reduces execution overhead for eligible small-data queries, while improvements to Spark Connect, Python, and SQL make data and AI applications easier to develop, debug, and operate.

Streaming aggregations, deduplication, and custom stateful processing can now run in Structured Streaming's low-latency execution mode, extending it to applications that need to remember context across events.
Apache Spark 4.3 brings stateful processing to Real-Time Mode, achieving sub-150 ms P99 end-to-end latency across three representative stateful benchmarks.

Apache Spark 4.3 brings stateful processing to Real-Time Mode, achieving sub-150 ms P99 end-to-end latency across three representative stateful benchmarks.

summaryLines: 더 빠르게 반복하고 더 풍부한 API로 구축 · Project Feather는 적격한 소규모 데이터 쿼리에 대한 실행 오버헤드를 줄이는 동시에 Spark Connect, Python 및 SQL의 개선으로 데이터 및 AI 애플리케이션을 더 쉽게 개발, 디버그 및 운영할 수 있음
이제 스트리밍 집계, 중복 제거 및 사용자 지정 상태 저장 처리를 구조적 스트리밍의 짧은 대기 시간 실행 모드에서 실행하여 이벤트 전반에 걸쳐 컨텍스트를 기억해야 하는 애플리케이션으로 확장할 수 있음
Apache Spark 4.3은 실시간 모드에 상태 저장 처리를 제공하여 세 가지 대표적인 상태 저장 벤치마크에서 150ms 미만의 P99 종단 간 대기 시간을 달성함

articles.title: The agentic era needs a computing platform everywhere – Arm is building it
articles.descEn: The Arm platform and ecosystem remain central to delivering the consistency, choice and breadth that the agentic world demands.
articles.titleEn: The agentic era needs a computing platform everywhere – Arm is building it
summaryLinesEn: Arm provides that platform, combining industry-leading performance per watt with the flexibility to choose between IP, compute subsystems or silicon, all underpinned by an unmatched software ecosystem of more than 22 million developers.

AI infrastructure is increasingly moving to Arm, with adoption across every major hyperscaler and Arm-based rack-scale servers overtaking x86 as the dominant accelerated computing platform, according to IDC .
The industry needs a platform that can deliver the consistency developers need with the freedom to differentiate.

summaryLines: Arm은 업계 최고의 와트당 성능과 IP, 컴퓨팅 하위 시스템 또는 실리콘 중에서 선택할 수 있는 유연성을 결합한 플랫폼을 제공하며, 이는 모두 2,200만 명 이상의 개발자로 구성된 탁월한 소프트웨어 생태계를 기반으로 함

업계에는 개발자가 필요로 하는 일관성을 제공하고 자유롭게 차별화할 수 있는 플랫폼이 필요함

articles.title: Fintech Rankings
articles.descEn: IDC examines consumer markets by devices, applications, networks, and services to provide complete solutions for succeeding in these expanding markets.
articles.titleEn: Fintech Rankings
summaryLinesEn: IDC FinTech Top 100: Solution providers that derive more than one-third of their revenue from the financial services and FinTech industries AND across no more than two additional key non FSI industry verticals.
Firms such as market data providers or credit bureaus that derive revenues from excluded categories, but also have revenue tied to software, hardware, or services, are considered in these rankings.

For these data providers, the revenue attributed to data is used to qualify the provider to the appropriate IDC FinTech category, yet only the qualifying portion of revenue is included in the process.

summaryLines: 그러나 Opus 5.5와 우리의 내부 연구 모델은 10%와 67%의 시간 동안 자발적으로 중지되었으며, 우리의 테스트에서는 모델의 다음 몇 차례만 조사했기 때문에 이러한 비율은 이러한 모델이 공격을 중단했을 가능성을 과소평가할 것으로 예상됨
그럼에도 불구하고, 근본적인 실패가 반드시 이와 같은 사이버 사고에만 국한되는 것은 아니기 때문에 이 동작을 연구하는 것이 중요함
정렬 2026년 10월 9일 평가 및 내부 사용에서 의도하지 않은 모델 동작 조사 2026년 8월 4일 영국 AI 보안 연구소(AISI)는 모델의 사이버 기능을 테스트하는 동안 Claude Mythos 5에서 관찰한 동작과 관련된 일부 동작을 자세히 설명하는 보고서를 발표함

articles.title: The Long-Term Benefit Trust
articles.descEn: An independent body of five trustees with authority to elect and remove Anthropic board members, balancing stockholder and public interests.
articles.titleEn: The Long-Term Benefit Trust
summaryLinesEn: At the close of our Series C , we amended our corporate charter to create a new class of stock (Class T) held exclusively by the Trust.1 The Class T stock grants the Trust the authority to elect and remove a number of Anthropic’s board members that will phase in according to time- and funding-based milestones; in any event, the Trust will elect a majority of the board within 4 years.

For example, the LTBT can ensure that the organizational leadership is incentivized to carefully evaluate future models for catastrophic risks or ensure they have nation-state level security, rather than prioritizing being the first to market above all other objectives.
Paired with our Public Benefit Corporation status, the LTBT helps to align our corporate governance with our mission of developing and maintaining advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.

articles.titleEn: Powering agentic AI with the Arm AGI CPU software ecosystem
summaryLinesEn: While agentic AI applications share a common software foundation, their infrastructure requirements vary significantly based on the tasks they perform.

summaryLines: 에이전트 AI 애플리케이션은 공통 소프트웨어 기반을 공유하지만 인프라 요구 사항은 수행하는 작업에 따라 크게 다름
이러한 워크로드 차이는 AI 애플리케이션을 설계하고 배포하는 방식에 대한 광범위한 변화의 일부임

articles.descEn: Explore what it takes to scale agentic AI, from memory and orchestration to infrastructure, open ecosystems and end-to-end performance.
articles.titleEn: Agentic AI explained: How agentic AI changes computing from cloud to edge
summaryLinesEn: Before your next meeting, a personal AI agent recognizes what is coming up and starts preparing without waiting for a prompt.
That means, agentic AI will require the whole system – software and hardware together – to be rethought from the ground up.
Agentic workflows increase that pressure further as each change may need to be stored, built, tested and evaluated before another action can begin.

articles.title: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge
articles.descEn: NVIDIA intentionally designs GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage and software together to get more useful work out of memory at every layer of the AI factory.
articles.titleEn: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge
summaryLinesEn: At 125 tokens per second per user, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivers up to 30x higher throughput per dollar than GB300 NVL72, with HBM capacity per GPU up about 3%.
NVIDIA was first to adopt HBM3e and HBM4 technologies into an accelerated computing stack.

Recent models, including FLUX.2 [klein] from Black Forest Labs , Inkling from Thinking Machines Lab, Beam 1.0 from Reflection , Meta Muse Spark from Meta , Step 5 Preview from StepFun and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL have been released with NVFP4 checkpoints, demonstrating growing model-builder adoption of 4-bit precision for faster, more memory-efficient inference.

articles.title: Scaling trust in confidential AI requires a common language
articles.descEn: Arm and Fujitsu explore how CoServe, IETF RATS and Veraison can help standardize attestation across increasingly heterogeneous confidential AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Scaling trust in confidential AI requires a common language
summaryLinesEn: And for the wider ecosystem, it provides something equally important: a common language through which different parts of an increasingly diverse computing supply chain can participate in trust.
These factors create a scaling problem the industry needs to address.

CoSERV is an adopted work item within the IETF RATS working group designed to provide a common conveyance mechanism through which verifiers can obtain endorsements and reference values from potentially complex supply-chain sources.

articles.title: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models
articles.descEn: Chris Alexiuk is a senior product research engineer in deep learning at NVIDIA who specializes in making open large language models (LLMs) practical for working developers.
articles.titleEn: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models
summaryLinesEn: “I think Nemotron is the most important project that exists,” said Alexiuk, who also uses the pseudonym “Joe Nemotron” across social media.
“It would be the greatest day of my life to be surpassed by an even bigger fan of Nemotron, who had heard about Nemotron through the work I was doing,” Alexiuk said.

“There’s a category of model that’s going to be close to the kind of work you want to accomplish,” Alexiuk said, explaining that Nemotron supports that whole ecosystem of AI users: from individual developers using a model like Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for repetitive, high-frequency execution work to a company deploying Nemotron Ultra for long-running autonomous agents, deep research and enterprise tasks.

localization.title: 개방형 가중치의 마법사 · Chris Alexiuk, 개방형 모델을 사용하여 AI를 쉽게 만듬
summaryLines: 소셜 미디어 전반에 걸쳐 'Joe Nemotron'이라는 가명을 사용하는 Alexiuk는 “Nemotron은 현존하는 가장 중요한 프로젝트라고 생각함” · 라고 말함
Alexiuk은 “내가 하고 있는 작업을 통해 Nemotron에 대해 알게 된 훨씬 더 큰 Nemotron 팬을 능가하는 것은 내 인생에서 가장 멋진 날이 될 것임” · 라고 말함

Alexiuk는 "당신이 달성하고자 하는 작업 종류에 가까운 모델 범주가 있습니다"라고 Nemotron은 반복적이고 빈도가 높은 실행 작업을 위해 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning과 같은 모델을 사용하는 개인 개발자부터 장기 실행 자율 에이전트, 심층 연구 및 기업 작업을 위해 Nemotron Ultra를 배포하는 회사에 이르기까지 AI 사용자의 전체 생태계를 지원한다고 설명함

articles.title: From Delta Sharing to OpenSharing: what changed, what's next | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Delta Sharing is now OpenSharing: an open protocol for sharing tables, agent skills, AI models, and unstructured data across platforms.
articles.titleEn: From Delta Sharing to OpenSharing: what changed, what's next | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: By the time Databricks announced OpenSharing in June 2026, Delta Sharing had reached more than 28,000 data recipients, with roughly a third of shares flowing across platforms through open connectors rather than staying inside Databricks-to-Databricks sharing ( Databricks blog ).

When Databricks introduced Delta Sharing at Data + AI Summit 2021, the core problem it addressed was simple to state and hard to solve well: organizations wanted to share live data with partners, customers, and other teams, without exporting files, standing up brittle ETL jobs, or forcing every recipient onto the same platform.
Existing Delta Sharing setups keep working, and you enable the new asset types on a Unity Catalog metastore using the same share, recipient, and grant workflow.

localization.title: Delta Sharing에서 OpenSharing으로 · 변경된 사항과 다음 단계 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: Databricks가 2026년 6월 OpenSharing을 발표할 때까지 Delta Sharing은 28,000명이 넘는 데이터 수신자에게 도달했으며, 공유의 약 3분의 1은 Databricks-Databricks 공유 내부에 머물지 않고 개방형 커넥터를 통해 플랫폼 간에 이동했습니다(Databricks 블로그)
Databricks가 Data + AI Summit 2021에서 델타 공유를 도입했을 때 해결한 핵심 문제는 설명하기는 간단하지만 잘 해결하기는 어렵음 · 조직은 파일을 내보내거나 취약한 ETL 작업을 수행하거나 모든 수신자를 동일한 플랫폼에 강제로 적용하지 않고 파트너, 고객 및 다른 팀과 실시간 데이터를 공유하기를 원함
기존 델타 공유 설정은 계속 작동하며 동일한 공유, 수신자 및 권한 부여 워크플로를 사용하여 Unity 카탈로그 메타스토어에서 새로운 자산 유형을 활성화함

articles.descEn: OpenSharing, Clean Rooms, or Marketplace? Learn which Databricks data collaboration tool fits your use case based on who is on the other side of the data.
articles.titleEn: Which Data Collaboration Tool: OpenSharing, Clean Rooms, Marketplace | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: With this growing demand, we have seen three methods of sharing pop up in Databricks: OpenSharing, Clean Rooms, and Marketplace.
This changes the paradigm as you no longer need to stand up pipelines to ship data to each consumer.
Let the relationship decide how you share data: use OpenSharing for live, read-only access with a known recipient.

articles.title: Stop treating agents as one-off projects and start running them as a continuous discipline | Microsoft Azure Blog
articles.descEn: Learn why Microsoft Foundry is the enterprise AI platform to build, ground, and govern AI apps and agents at scale.
articles.titleEn: Stop treating agents as one-off projects and start running them as a continuous discipline | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Stop treating agents as one-off projects and start running them as a continuous discipline Transformation begins at the line between an experiment that works and a capability the business depends on.

A new IDC InfoBrief, sponsored by Microsoft, Scaling AI Without Scaling Costs *, on how organizations are funding and governing AI, shows both the urgency of that shift and the friction holding it back.

Only 17% of organizations build models to project how costs scale in production—even as about 78% prioritize cost efficiency when selecting a model. 86% expect financial results within six to 24 months—roughly one budget cycle to show something real.

articles.title: How Amazon Marketplace evaluates content quality with Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Amazon Marketplace evaluates A+ Content quality at scale on Amazon SageMaker AI by rendering each product page as a single snapshot, scoring it with a vision-language model fused with OCR readability signals in a CatBoost classifier, and using SHAP to turn each decision into prioritized, actionable recommendations for selling partners.
articles.titleEn: How Amazon Marketplace evaluates content quality with Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Selling partners using high-quality A+ Content boost their sales by 8–20 percent compared to those without it.

The baseline reached 0.80 accuracy and an F1 score of 0.84 on the high-quality class.

articles.title: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
articles.descEn: As businesses put more agents to work, AI factories need CPUs that can execute those steps quickly and support many agents at once, all within the limits of available power.
articles.titleEn: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents
summaryLinesEn: Why it matters: NVIDIA Vera delivers both fast agent performance and high capacity per watt within a single CPU.
The data that proves it: In a 100-megawatt data center comparison, NVIDIA found that a single Vera CPU performs better than the fastest x86 CPU and the most energy-efficient x86 CPU.
DeepInfra : Delivered up to 2.2x speed of the best x86 processor on agentic orchestration for its production agent workload, achieving the fastest of the four architectures tested.

articles.descEn: Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore returns a synthesized, source-cited answer to a natural-language question in a single tool call, with no search, retrieve, synthesize, and citation pipeline to build. Learn how it works and how to add it to an AgentCore Gateway and call it from an agent.
articles.titleEn: Getting started with Web Answer on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Web Answer runs new searches for every question, and its model is given today’s date so it can search for up-to-date information.
For Web Answer, the role needs: bedrock-agentcore:InvokeWebAnswer , to call Web Answer.
Figure 1: Request flow from an agent through the Gateway to Web Answer and back Your agent sends a question to your AgentCore Gateway, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

articles.title: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
articles.descEn: Sierra today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation. The award was presented to Bret Taylor, Co-founder and CEO of Sierra, at J.P. Morgan’s 18th annual Technology Innovation Symposium.
articles.titleEn: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
summaryLinesEn: Established in 2011, the Hall of Innovation recognizes privately held technology companies that have made a significant impact at JPMorganChase through their innovation, business value, and close collaboration with the firm’s teams.
Sierra, the leading customer experience AI platform, today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation.

“Agentic AI has the potential to create simpler, more intuitive experiences for customers, but realizing that potential requires getting trust, security and controls right from the start,” said Gill Haus, Chief Information Officer of Chase.

articles.descEn: Hot Chips 2026 showed how IBM, Fujitsu, NVIDIA and Arm are redefining the CPU for agentic AI around a common Arm software foundation.
articles.titleEn: Hot Chips 2026: The CPU’s next chapter is being built on Arm
summaryLinesEn: But the CPU sessions at Hot Chips revealed something else.: Arm showed up almost everywhere.
The designs could hardly be more different, spanning mission-critical enterprise computing, green data centers, accelerated AI systems and purpose-built agentic infrastructure.
The resulting design integrates up to 136 Arm Neoverse V3 cores, 12 DDR5 memory channels, 96 lanes of PCIe Gen6 and CXL 3.0 support within a 300-watt TDP.

summaryLinesEn: With the worldwide server market growing 30 percent in a single year to hit $122.6bn in the first quarter of 2025, IDC now feels safe recategorizing AI-driven investment "from cyclical to durable".

articles.title: BofA lifts Supermicro target despite AI margin concerns
articles.descEn: Record sales and strong AI demand prompted higher forecasts, but BofA remains concerned about profit margins and cash flow.
articles.titleEn: BofA lifts Supermicro target despite AI margin concerns
summaryLinesEn: Bank of America raised its Supermicro price target to $39 from $38 after the AI server maker reported record quarterly revenue, but maintained its Underperform rating over concerns about future profit margins and cash flow.

Also read: Warren Buffett shares a simple rule for surviving a market crash The company's reported margins and full-year outlook show the difference: During the company's Nov. 3 earnings call , Chief Financial Officer Mark Long said the sequential decline largely reflected a shift toward large AI data-center projects, which generally carry lower margins than the company's enterprise and channel business.
Long also said during the earnings call that the company expects a gross margin of 12% to 12.5% for the quarter.

This shift lines up with recent analyst commentary that highlights a mixed setup for the stock, with softer near term results weighed against progress in advanced packaging, AI data center programs, and the long term Arizona build out. articles.titleEn: Amkor Technology (AMKR) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower As Analysts Weigh Mixed Outlook
summaryLinesEn: The modeled fair value for Amkor Technology has been revised from $74.50 to $66.00, which the update describes as a moderate downward adjustment.

This shift lines up with recent analyst commentary that highlights a mixed setup for the stock, with softer near term results weighed against progress in advanced packaging, AI data center programs, and the long term Arizona build out.
Riley highlights new AI data center program ramps, steadier iPhone related demand and lower capex, while also calling out Nvidia prepayments that support Amkor Technology's Arizona investment.

summaryLines: Amkor Technology의 모델링된 공정 가치는 $74.50에서 $66.00로 수정되었으며, 업데이트에서는 이를 적당한 하향 조정으로 설명함
이러한 변화는 고급 패키징, AI 데이터 센터 프로그램 및 장기적인 애리조나 구축의 진행 상황에 비해 단기 결과가 더 부드러워지고 주식에 대한 혼합 설정을 강조하는 최근 분석가 논평과 일치함
Riley는 새로운 AI 데이터 센터 프로그램 램프, 안정적인 iPhone 관련 수요 및 낮은 자본 지출을 강조하는 동시에 Amkor Technology의 애리조나 투자를 지원하는 Nvidia 선불을 요청함

articles.title: AI meltdown: Nvidia and Qualcomm drop more than 9%, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025
articles.descEn: Companies tied to the AI buildout are all selling off as concerns mount about a slowdown following the midterm elections.
articles.titleEn: AI meltdown: Nvidia and Qualcomm drop more than 9%, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025
summaryLinesEn: Qualcomm and Nvidia both dropped more than 9%, with the latter losing almost $450 billion in market cap.
Intel last week reported a 78% jump in data center revenue, but the stock got crushed due to a weaker-than-expected forecast from the memory shortage.

Chipmakers plummeted on Thursday, with Nvidia pushing the Nasdaq to its worst day in 19 months, after this week's midterm election results raised concerns on Wall Street that the artificial intelligence buildout is poised to slow down.

articles.title: Reinventing software delivery with AI-SDLC on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Verisk partnered with AWS to build AI-SDLC: specialized AI agents spanning requirements, grooming, development, code review, and QA on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with people reviewing and approving the work at each stage. See the architecture, early productivity gains, and lessons from a regulated insurance environment.
articles.titleEn: Reinventing software delivery with AI-SDLC on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: QA : Engineers spent 3–4 hours writing test plans per feature and 1–2 days setting up automation.

Operating across the insurance value chain, from underwriting and risk assessment to claims management, fraud detection, and catastrophe modeling, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk for more than 50 years.
Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock : Powers the Developer Agent for end-to-end ticket implementation, reading coding standards, breaking down tasks, and generating code across full stack layers.

articles.titleEn: Dell Technologies (DELL) Shares Just Moved, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
summaryLinesEn: Recent months have been choppy for Dell Technologies, with the share price down 18.6% over the past week and 27.4% over 30 days, even after a 4.0% gain in the last session to US$408.40.

Dell Technologies is experiencing accelerating demand for AI servers and data center solutions as enterprises globally increase investments in AI and machine learning workloads and digital transformation, supported by more than US$130b of AI server orders in the past 12 months, a US$95b AI backlog and a pipeline that is multiples of backlog, which ties directly to future revenue and earnings.

That near term pullback comes against a much stronger backdrop, including a 219.6% year to date share price return and a 1 year total shareholder return of 166.9% as investors react to headlines on AI server backlogs, new AI Factory partnerships and cybersecurity launches, while reassessing how quickly those themes might translate into cash flows and risk.

localization.title: 델 테크놀로지스(DELL) 주식이 막 움직였는데 지금 주목받고 있는 것은 무엇입니까
summaryLines: 최근 몇 달 동안 Dell Technologies의 주가는 지난 주에 18.6%, 지난 세션에서 US$408.40로 4.0% 상승한 이후에도 30일 동안 27.4% 하락하는 등 고르지 못함

Dell Technologies는 지난 12개월 동안 미화 1,300억 달러 이상의 AI 서버 주문, 미화 950억 달러의 AI 백로그 및 향후 수익 및 수익과 직접적으로 연결되는 파이프라인의 지원을 받아 기업이 전 세계적으로 AI 및 머신 러닝 워크로드와 디지털 변혁에 대한 투자를 늘리면서 AI 서버 및 데이터 센터 솔루션에 대한 수요가 가속화되고 있음을 경험하고 있음
이러한 단기 하락은 투자자들이 AI 서버 백로그, 새로운 AI Factory 파트너십 및 사이버 보안 출시에 대한 헤드라인에 반응하면서 이러한 주제가 얼마나 빨리 현금 흐름과 위험으로 전환될 수 있는지 재평가하면서 현재까지 주가 수익률 219.6%, 1년 총 주주 수익률 166.9%를 포함하여 훨씬 더 강력한 배경에서 발생함

summaryLinesEn: The $340 million cash acquisition of EIS marks Amdocs' entry into the insurance software market, providing a platform for policy, billing, and claims across dozens of global carriers.
Management views AI as an opportunity to shift from manual service-heavy models to autonomous 'business-to-machine' operating systems.
Profitability in FY2027 is expected to follow a 'U-shaped' trajectory, starting the year well below the 19.5% margin midpoint and improving sequentially as internal AI efficiencies materialize.

articles.title: Arm Performix brings AI-guided performance analysis to agentic development
articles.descEn: Discover how Arm Performix Dynamic Insights combines runtime performance data with AI-powered analysis to help developers and coding agents identify bottlenecks, validate optimizations, and improve software performance on Arm-based platforms.
articles.titleEn: Arm Performix brings AI-guided performance analysis to agentic development
summaryLinesEn: Developers can then ask follow-up questions, request additional explanations or challenge recommendations, while retaining access to the underlying performance evidence.
Agentic development and AI coding agents are changing software development by accelerating the generation, modification and refactoring of code.

Dynamic Insights also supports emerging agentic workflows in which AI coding agents can execute performance analysis, interpret the results, propose code changes and measure their impact automatically.

articles.titleEn: We're sharing our framework for building safer and more helpful AI for health.
summaryLinesEn: The adoption of technology for health is accelerating and impacts billions of people every day.

By sharing our methodology, we hope to promote transparency in how we approach this important area, and seek to support the entire health ecosystem — from developers to researchers to clinicians — in building AI tools people can trust.
Dana Gelb Safran , we published a whitepaper detailing an end-to-end evaluation approach to assess AI use cases for addressing people’s health needs.

articles.title: Predicting and detecting failures: How Azure strengthens reliability for mission-critical workloads | Microsoft Azure Blog
articles.descEn: Azure Failure Prediction and Detection (AFPD) helps reduce interruptions by predicting hardware failures, moving eligible workloads, and notifying customers when action is needed. See what that means for SAP on Azure and other mission-critical workloads.
articles.titleEn: Predicting and detecting failures: How Azure strengthens reliability for mission-critical workloads | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Prepare your automation for Scheduled Events : Make sure your automation can process Scheduled Events for Azure Virtual Machines , including events with a NotBefore time up to seven days in the future.
This is the old model Azure has spent years moving away from, one built around mission-critical escalations, supply chain constraints, and manual recovery.
To learn more, watch our companion video to learn how AFPD helps reduce the risk of failures disrupting your critical workloads.

articles.title: How U Mobile built agentic telco operations with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: U Mobile, Malaysia's newest 5G network provider, built AiDaH, an agentic AI operations platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that moves beyond AI assistance to autonomous action across telco operations. Nine months after production launch, AiDaH handles over 150 operational scenarios across six divisions, cutting trouble tickets by up to 84.5%.
articles.titleEn: How U Mobile built agentic telco operations with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: U Mobile’s internal measurements show trouble ticket volumes falling by up to 84.5 percent in key categories.
Through 2026 the platform hardened and expanded, adding three-tier routing and reaching 6 agents by mid-year.

Roughly 70 percent of requests resolve through deterministic keyword matching with no model invocation, 20 percent are classified by a lightweight model, and only 10 percent require the full orchestrator.

articles.title: How Indegene is modernizing and scaling enterprise data quality in life sciences | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: This post explores how Indegene built a production-grade, LLM-powered Data Quality Agent in its NEXT Unified Data Platform on AWS. The agent generates context-aware data quality rules, validates them, and produces ready-to-run SQL and Python under human-in-the-loop governance, helping life sciences organizations scale enterprise data quality.
articles.titleEn: How Indegene is modernizing and scaling enterprise data quality in life sciences | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: To address this, the Data Quality Agent uses two complementary knowledge bases that combine curated domain knowledge with experience gained from governed usage.
The agent boosts data engineer and data steward productivity by accelerating rule creation, simplifying validation, and helping maintain consistent governance at enterprise scale.

Figure 1: NEXT Unified Data Platform dashboard with use cases and AI agents Indegene’s life sciences clients needed an agent that could run reliably in production and meet strict governance requirements, while giving the team flexibility in how they build it.

articles.descEn: In production AI agents, context management is the real bottleneck. articles.titleEn: Four layers of context engineering for production AI agents: How Deep Insight applies them in working code | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In Deep Insight, all agents share one standardized format: Implementation detail 2-2: Self-contained code philosophy The Coder agent’s prompt explicitly states “variables do not persist between scripts.”
It introduced how Strands Agents SDK , Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore , and AWS Fargate each address different layers of the problem, with code examples.

articles.title: Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick: Human oversight where it matters | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick reviews eligible agent actions within your existing controls, reducing unnecessary approval prompts while keeping consequential decisions with a person. See how policy sets the boundary, how a classifier reviews actions, and how AWS CloudTrail and Amazon CloudWatch Logs support audit.
articles.titleEn: Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick: Human oversight where it matters | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: That would change the audience beyond the recipients she specified, so Smart Approvals is designed to return the proposed send to her for review, where she can decline it.
With Smart Approvals enabled, an action is eligible only when the user’s setting is “Ask each time” and no other control requires human approval.
Research on security warnings shows that attention and adherence can decline with repetition.

summaryLinesEn: Most of the standalone tools I’ve used share the same problem, regardless of how much they tout AI.
Abridge led the shift to ambient AI in clinical documentation, centering the patient conversation and cutting the after-hours charting clinicians used to take home .
The tasks pile up right behind them, and each one means more time clicking through the chart before the shift ends.

summaryLinesEn: Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
Jessica Faraci, a family medicine physician at Maine Health and an early adopter of the Abridge Assistant’s context-aware clinical intelligence for decision support.
Because I'm doing something different in almost every room, it's been hard to find technology flexible enough to keep up, even though I'm an EHR super user myself.

articles.title: The Future of AI Pre-Charting Is More Than a Chart Summary | Abridge
articles.descEn: See how Abridge’s Pre-Visit Summary determines what matters from the patient record, surfacing relevant information without overloading clinicians.
articles.titleEn: The Future of AI Pre-Charting Is More Than a Chart Summary | Abridge
summaryLinesEn: Proctor values about the “telephoto lens” is how Abridge selects the right information and orders it appropriately: Catch up: A short summary of the patient's recent care, tailored to specialty.

In an upcoming release, clinicians using Abridge will be able to precisely tailor their own pre-visit summary, including what information is prioritized, the timeframe considered, and how it is organized.
Seeing how clinicians actually prepare for visits helps Abridge understand what they look for in the chart, what slows them down, and which information helps them get oriented.

articles.title: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Dharma-AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
summaryLinesEn: The full benchmark covers 546 documents across three request scenarios, for 1,638 total cases: extracting every field with no schema, a partial schema naming only real fields, and a schema that also includes deliberately nonexistent fields.
A 2-billion-parameter model that extracts exactly the fields you ask for, from any document type, outperforming every frontier LLM we tested, at a fraction of the cost.
Ours isn't billed per token: the model runs self-hosted, so the figure is GPU time on a single L40S at $2.24 per hour.

articles.title: Use decision models with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Some agent-evaluation questions are narrow and repeatable, and decision models answer exactly that kind of question. This post shows how to connect two decision models, Jev and Strands Decider, to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations through code-based evaluators, and how to validate a decision-model check before you gate a release on it.
articles.titleEn: Use decision models with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, scores an agent through its entire lifecycle, on demand during development, in batch jobs against stored sessions, and online against production traffic.
This code sample helps you set up the framework for testing decision models compared to LLM-as-a-judge for your own use cases.

Figure 3: How the code-based evaluator Lambda adapts OpenTelemetry spans for the decision model and maps the result back to AgentCore The adapter converts the model’s probability distribution into a result that AgentCore evaluation expects.

그림 3: 코드 기반 평가기 Lambda가 의사 결정 모델에 대한 OpenTelemetry 범위를 조정하고 결과를 다시 AgentCore에 매핑하는 방법 어댑터는 모델의 확률 분포를 AgentCore 평가에서 기대하는 결과로 변환함

articles.titleEn: The Enterprise Case for Open-Weight Models on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: As field engineers at Databricks, we spend our days inside enterprise AI deployments, where we’ve observed a clear shift in strategy.
AI budgets have outpaced revenue and cost savings, prompting a need for better unit economics [1].
Unity AI Gateway serves open-weight, frontier, and external models through one governed API with fast inference, smart routing, fallbacks, and budget controls.

articles.title: Arm delivers a record second quarter, reaching $1.44 billion in total revenue
articles.descEn: Arm reports record Q2 FYE27 revenue of $1.44 billion, up 27% year-over-year, driven by strong licensing growth and rising AI demand.
articles.titleEn: Arm delivers a record second quarter, reaching $1.44 billion in total revenue
summaryLinesEn: For the first time, Arm’s partners reported more than 10 billion Arm-based chips shipped during the quarter – an increase of 1.5 billion chips year over year – adding to the scale of the platform already used by more than 30 million developers .

Arm launched Arm Total Design for Physical AI , bringing together more than 80 companies across compute, software, AI models, and system integration, to accelerate the development and deployment of physical AI systems.

The infographic below provides the key highlights for the quarter: Here are what the results mean and how they were achieved: Total revenue for Arm in Q2 FYE27 increased 27% year over year to $1.44 billion , representing Arm’s highest ever second quarter.

articles.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
articles.descEn: The startup allows software engineers to deploy teams of agents to work on various aspects of a project simultaneously.
articles.titleEn: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
summaryLinesEn: Meta has acquired Conductor , an AI coding startup that allows users to spin up software projects by deploying multiple agents into parallel workspaces.
Meanwhile, the company’s recently launched Muse agents are seeing significant adoption, with the company recently reporting that the service had surpassed 10 million users.

The company’s agentic teams, which can be deployed in the cloud, locally, or via a user’s phone, are designed to help software engineers work on separate, compartmentalized parts of a project in concert.

articles.descEn: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) is working with Meta to integrate the Muse AI shopping agent into its online retail experience. Muse will act as an AI-powered buyer assistant for Walmart customers, helping users plan and execute shopping journeys on Meta platforms. Amazon has blocked Meta's Muse agent from operating on its marketplace, in contrast to Walmart's decision to participate. articles.title: Windows pushed AI PCs, but now it's hit a wall of RAM prices
articles.descEn: Customers sweating assets amid tight budgets, as Microsoft execs get creative with sales pitches
articles.titleEn: Windows pushed AI PCs, but now it's hit a wall of RAM prices
summaryLinesEn: Microsoft last week reported profit and loss accounts for Q1 of its fiscal 2027 , ended September 30, and revenue in the Windows OEM and Devices division shrank 22 percent from last year to $3.55 billion.
So there is a pent-up demand that we believe will come once it stabilizes and once IT budgets get a little bit more settled and expanded."

" Growth will continue to be impacted by elevated inventory levels, PC market demand and a prior year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support," Microsoft CFO Amy Hood said on an earnings call.

summaryLinesEn: Trio-Tech exited fiscal 2026 with a backlog of $24.2 million compared with $11 million a year earlier.

summaryLinesEn: When the acquisition was announced, Hugging Face said it had around 18 million users.

Nvidia, the world’s dominant AI chipmaker, announced that it would acquire the platform for $12.93 billion this September.

articles.title: How ElevenLabs' CTO is rolling out AI agents—and why he thinks bigger efficiency gains are ahead for the voice AI startup | Fortune
articles.descEn: ElevenLabs field CTO Alex Holt has deployed agents across sales, recruiting, and customer service. He's also beginning to embrace multi-agent systems to improve workflows across the $22 billion AI startup.
articles.titleEn: How ElevenLabs' CTO is rolling out AI agents—and why he thinks bigger efficiency gains are ahead for the voice AI startup | Fortune
summaryLinesEn: The AI voice startup has deployed an inbound sales development representative (SDR) agent that has handled over 3,000 customer leads this year, qualifying over 90% of those potential clients in 32 different languages without any human intervention.

Marvell says the deal will allow the combined company to address a market worth $550 billion, with Chairman and CEO Matt Murphy saying, “AI infrastructure is undergoing a fundamental architectural shift toward optical connectivity, creating an opportunity that comes along once in a generation.”
He says that the efficiency gains ElevenLabs reaps from agentic AI may feel cutting edge today, but “in six months time, you can see even more gains.”
articles.summary:

articles.title: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: CWE-bench v2: More coverage, quality, and transparency
summaryLinesEn: In our continued pursuit to push the horizon at Collinear AI , CWE-bench v2 opens up a public set of 100 tasks that anyone can run and evaluate their models on.

On cost, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017), Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon form the Pareto frontier: DeepSeek reaches 57.0% pass@1 at $0.04 per rollout, Opus adds ten points at $1.83, and Gemini edges ahead at $3.92.

Harbor can therefore run the whole benchmark straight from the Hugging Face repo, without cloning anything yourself: -k 4 runs 4 attempts per task, and the reported score is the mean reward over all 400 trials.

articles.title: Transformers Model Integration Contracts
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Transformers Model Integration Contracts
summaryLinesEn: 108.6 billion parameters become 44.7 million.
Transformers supports over 750 model types, and its test suite is big: 88,000+ CPU tests on main, plus 200,000+ GPU tests in a daily run.

A Model Integration Contract (MIC) has three parts: a fixture : the shrunk model described above, published once and pinned a usage path : a runnable Markdown example of something people do with the model, such as generating text or running a training step baselines : the outputs recorded when running that example, reviewed by a human The contract holds if running the usage path on the fixture still produces the baselines.

localization.title: Transformers 모델 통합 계약
summaryLines: 1,086억 개의 매개변수가 4,470만 개가 됨
Transformers는 750개 이상의 모델 유형을 지원하며 테스트 제품군은 규모가 큼 · 메인에서 88,000개 이상의 CPU 테스트와 일일 실행 시 200,000개 이상의 GPU 테스트가 이루어짐

MIC(모델 통합 계약)는 세 부분으로 구성됨 · 고정 장치 · 위에서 설명한 축소 모델, 한 번 게시되고 고정된 사용 경로 · 텍스트 생성 또는 교육 단계 실행과 같이 사람들이 모델을 사용하여 수행하는 작업에 대한 실행 가능한 Markdown 예 기준선 · 해당 예를 실행할 때 기록되고 사람이 검토한 출력 고정 장치에서 사용 경로를 실행하여 여전히 기준선이 생성되는 경우 계약이 유지됨

articles.title: Advancing research and partnering with universities in Singapore
articles.descEn: Google is investing in new research grants and capacity-building initiatives to advance AI for science and support the next generation of scientific leaders in Singapore.
articles.titleEn: Advancing research and partnering with universities in Singapore
summaryLinesEn: AI safety and security ($340,000 grant — NTU) : We are funding four sponsored research studies at NTU focused on advancing AI safety frameworks, robust evaluation methodologies, trustworthy multi-agent systems, and privacy-preserving LLM watermarking.

Along with a new research hub in Singapore, Google is deepening its academic partnerships in the country with more than $6 million in grants for NUS and NTU — driving breakthroughs in AI for science and compute efficiency, strengthening AI safety frameworks, and nurturing scientific leaders.

Our targeted grants address both urgent biomedical frontiers and the core building blocks of computing: Alzheimer’s research ($1.5 million grant — NUS) : Selected from over 3,500 global applications, NUS has been awarded an AI for Science Google.org Impact Challenge Grant to advance breakthroughs in neurodegenerative disease research using AI models and data science.

localization.title: 연구 발전 및 싱가포르 대학과의 파트너십
summaryLines: AI 안전 및 보안($340,000 보조금 — NTU): 우리는 AI 안전 프레임워크, 강력한 평가 방법론, 신뢰할 수 있는 다중 에이전트 시스템 및 개인 정보 보호 LLM 워터마킹에 초점을 맞춘 NTU의 4가지 후원 연구 연구에 자금을 지원하고 있음
Google은 싱가포르의 새로운 연구 허브와 함께 NUS 및 NTU에 600만 달러 이상의 보조금을 지원하여 싱가포르 내 학술 파트너십을 심화하여 과학 및 컴퓨팅 효율성을 위한 AI의 혁신을 주도하고 AI 안전 프레임워크를 강화하며 과학 리더를 양성하고 있음
우리의 목표 보조금은 긴급한 생물 의학 분야와 컴퓨팅의 핵심 구성 요소를 모두 다룸 · 알츠하이머 연구(150만 달러 보조금 - NUS): 3,500개 이상의 글로벌 응용 프로그램 중에서 선정된 NUS는 AI 모델과 데이터 과학을 사용하여 신경퇴행성 질환 연구의 획기적인 진전을 이루기 위해 과학용 AI Google.org 임팩트 챌린지 보조금을 받았음

articles.title: La ambición de nuestros clientes impulsa nuestro crecimiento
articles.descEn: Lanzamos Sierra hace poco más de dos años y medio. Esta semana, superamos los 400 millones de dólares en ingresos recurrentes anuales (ARR), tras sumar más de 150 millones solo en el tercer trimestre. En un solo trimestre hemos generado más ARR que en todo el año pasado.
articles.titleEn: La ambición de nuestros clientes impulsa nuestro crecimiento
summaryLinesEn: Y, lo que es más importante, nuestro crecimiento se acelera: tardamos seis meses en duplicar el ARR de 100 a 200 millones de dólares, y solo cinco en pasar de 200 a 400 millones.

Este crecimiento responde a varios factores, entre los que se encuentran: La creciente ambición de nuestros clientes : pese a figurar entre las empresas más grandes y más reguladas del mundo, buscan sacar más partido a sus agentes y avanzar más rápido.

La facilidad para crear y mejorar agentes con Ghostwriter : este mes, una gran empresa minorista estadounidense, con más de 40 000 millones de dólares de ingresos, pasó de la primera reunión a tener un agente en funcionamiento en 27 días.

articles.title: L’ambition de nos clients accélère notre croissance
articles.descEn: Nous avons lancé Sierra il y a un peu plus de deux ans et demi. Cette semaine, nous avons dépassé les 400 millions de dollars de revenus récurrents annuels (ARR), avec une hausse de plus de 150 millions de dollars au seul troisième trimestre. En un trimestre, nous avons ainsi généré plus d’ARR que sur l’ensemble de l’année dernière.

summaryLinesEn: Surtout, notre croissance s’accélère : nous avons mis six mois pour doubler notre ARR, de 100 à 200 millions de dollars, et seulement cinq mois pour passer de 200 à 400 millions.

Plusieurs facteurs expliquent cette croissance, notamment : L’ambition croissante de nos clients — bien qu’ils comptent parmi les plus grandes entreprises au monde et les plus soumises à la réglementation, ils veulent aller plus loin et plus vite avec leurs agents.

articles.title: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
articles.descEn: From infrastructure planning and transportation to public services, cities are using NVIDIA-powered applications to address local needs and expand capacity for the broader AI ecosystem.
articles.titleEn: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
summaryLinesEn: Cities can extend AI to more services by building on infrastructure already in place and adding capacity.

In Wrocław, Poland , K2K is building shared AI infrastructure using NVIDIA accelerated computing, NVIDIA Cosmos world reasoning models, and NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for video search and summarization (VSS) to transform existing camera streams into actionable intelligence for mobility, safety and event response — using the same infrastructure across several city functions.
City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough.

localization.title: 전 세계 도시에서는 NVIDIA Physical 및 Agentic AI를 사용하여 AI 서비스를 구축하고 확장함
summaryLines: 도시는 이미 존재하는 인프라를 구축하고 용량을 추가하여 AI를 더 많은 서비스로 확장할 수 있음

폴란드 브로츠와프에서 K2K는 NVIDIA 가속 컴퓨팅, NVIDIA Cosmos 세계 추론 모델, 비디오 검색 및 요약(VSS)을 위한 NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint를 사용하여 공유 AI 인프라를 구축하고 있으며, 이를 통해 여러 도시 기능에서 동일한 인프라를 사용하여 기존 카메라 스트림을 이동성, 안전 및 이벤트 대응을 위한 실행 가능한 인텔리전스로 변환하고 있음
도시 팀은 이러한 AI 서비스 구축을 시작하기 위해 막대한 인프라 투자가 필요하지 않음 · 워크로드에 따라 NVIDIA RTX 워크스테이션 또는 소형 GPU 시스템이면 충분할 수 있음

articles.titleEn: Designing responsible AI for learning
summaryLinesEn: Google Classroom: Starting today, Guided Learning is globally available in Google Classroom, a central hub where teachers and students organize schoolwork, share assignments and stay connected.
We’ll share more specifics with schools in the coming months ahead of the changes rolling out so they have time to prepare and enable a smooth transition.
When a student starts a Guided Learning activity assigned by their teacher, it acts like a 1-1 study tool, anchored in class material to help them stay on task.

We’ll share more specifics with schools in the coming months ahead of the changes rolling out so they have time to prepare and enable a smooth transition.

When a student starts a Guided Learning activity assigned by their teacher, it acts like a 1-1 study tool, anchored in class material to help them stay on task.

articles.title: New research shows how Guided Learning supports students
articles.descEn: New research shows Guided Learning boosts student performance, now available with new teacher controls in Google Classroom. See the study results.
articles.titleEn: New research shows how Guided Learning supports students
summaryLinesEn: Guided Learning is designed to help students work through complex concepts step by step, prioritizing deep understanding over providing direct answers.
New research shows this approach leads to higher learning gains and allows teachers to provide more targeted support.
But students with access to Guided Learning improved by 8.1 percentage points, representing 1.5x higher learning gains in just a single study session.

articles.title: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
articles.descEn: An AI-defined fab uses accelerated simulation, learned physics models and AI agents to give engineers faster answers across design, testing and manufacturing.
articles.titleEn: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
summaryLinesEn: Engineers direct the work and make decisions based on their expertise while spending less time waiting for answers.
Using the NVIDIA cuDSS library, multiphysics simulation software provider COMSOL is accelerating such simulations for semiconductor manufacturing by up to 10x.

Together, these capabilities describe an AI-defined fab: a semiconductor manufacturing factory where AI helps engineers optimize processes, catch problems earlier and make better decisions across the full manufacturing chip lifecycle.

summaryLines: 엔지니어는 답변을 기다리는 시간을 줄이면서 자신의 전문 지식을 바탕으로 작업을 지시하고 결정을 내림

articles.title: Introducing India-based inference for Kimi K3 on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock now offers in-country inference in India for Kimi K3, keeping processing within the Mumbai and Hyderabad Regions. This post explains the global and geographic cross-Region inference options and shares example code for reading and understanding Indic-language documents with Kimi K3.
articles.titleEn: Introducing India-based inference for Kimi K3 on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The inference profile ID you invoke controls which destination Regions are eligible: See the Amazon Bedrock Kimi K3 model card for up-to-date information on available inference profiles, which AWS Regions they can be called from, and what destination Regions they can use for inference.
In addition to global and US-based inference, Amazon Bedrock now supports in-country inference in India for Kimi K3: unblocking local workloads with strict data residency requirements.
A: Bill ka total ₹2,217.20 hai, aur last date 20/10/2026 hai.

articles.title: Building ultra-low-latency voice AI applications on AWS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Cartesia, an AWS Partner, uses purpose-built State Space Models and AWS infrastructure to deliver sub-100ms text-to-speech and speech-to-text at global scale, and how to deploy its Sonic model on Amazon SageMaker AI or self-managed Amazon EC2 GPU instances.
articles.titleEn: Building ultra-low-latency voice AI applications on AWS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Telehealth: Remote patient consultations demand low-latency voice for accurate, empathetic communication.

The demand for real-time voice AI is growing rapidly across industries: Contact centers: AI agents handling millions of customer interactions require instantaneous speech generation to maintain natural dialogue.

Sonic is Cartesia’s flagship streaming text-to-speech model, delivering ultra-realistic speech synthesis with sub-100ms latency: First audio byte in approximately 90ms: Users hear the voice respond almost instantaneously.

articles.descEn: Learn how to build a governed semantic layer for agentic AI inside EDB Postgres AI and query it from a Strands Agents agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Business meaning, join paths, and access control all live in Postgres, with GRANT and row-level security enforcing what each agent can read.

summaryLinesEn: An agent that reads it as a unit price and multiplies by quantity returns $502,529 for the top customer instead of $27,991.66.
The Stardog post in this series introduced this framing.

An agent that answers business questions from live data needs three layers: a model that plans and writes queries, a meaning layer that tells the agent what the data represents, and a runtime that hosts the agent and controls identity and access.

articles.title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
summaryLinesEn: We find that recurrent and hybrid models can generalize much farther than transformers when trained directly on these tasks, while frontier models including Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Sol and Luna still break down on harder forms of state tracking as inputs grow longer.

However, not all state-tracking problems are created equal: some require only finding the latest update; harder ones require following a chain of changes, where one missed step can throw off the final answer.
The models trained on sequences of up to 256 assignments and were tested on sequences as long as 64,000 assignments, or 250 times the maximum training length.

The models trained on sequences of up to 256 assignments and were tested on sequences as long as 64,000 assignments, or 250 times the maximum training length.
localization.title: StateBench: 언어 모델이 긴 문서의 상태 변경을 추적하는 방법 테스트
summaryLines: 반복 및 하이브리드 모델은 이러한 작업에 대해 직접 교육을 받을 때 변환기보다 훨씬 더 일반화할 수 있는 반면, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol 및 Luna를 포함한 프론티어 모델은 입력이 길어짐에 따라 여전히 더 어려운 형태의 상태 추적으로 분류됨

articles.title: Declare and optimize with UNIQUE constraints on Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Databricks UNIQUE constraints let teams declare multiple nullable or composite uniqueness guarantees beyond a table’s single PRIMARY KEY, and reference them with foreign keys.
articles.titleEn: Declare and optimize with UNIQUE constraints on Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: In 10 TB TPC-DS benchmarks, UNIQUE with RELY removed over 99.99% of shuffle and delivered up to 12× faster queries.
Databricks already supports PRIMARY KEY and FOREIGN KEY constraints : a primary key identifies a table's rows, and foreign keys can reference it to describe relationships.
UNIQUE constraints, now available in Public Preview for Unity Catalog Delta tables in Databricks SQL and Databricks Runtime 18.2 and above, add a way to record the other uniqueness guarantees.

articles.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
articles.descEn: Sharing progress on a powerful type of cryptographic proof known as a zkSNARK, which is uniquely fit for provable inference.
articles.titleEn: Progress on provable inference for large language models
summaryLinesEn: 1 This research post is meant to share intermediate progress, and not a completed research agenda.
Our aim is twofold: (i) accelerating and facilitating the development of provable inference; and (ii) demonstrating that zero-knowledge succinct arguments are practical for provable inference.

Specifically, we have made progress on a powerful type of cryptographic proof known as a “zkSNARK”, which is uniquely fit for provable inference (owing to its strong hiding and efficiency properties).

articles.title: Adobe’s Premiere mobile app is adding licensed music from ‘leading artists’
articles.descEn: Adobe is teaming up with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group to add a library of licensed music clips to the Premiere mobile video editing app.
articles.titleEn: Adobe’s Premiere mobile app is adding licensed music from ‘leading artists’
summaryLinesEn: Adobe is teaming up with Universal Music Group and Warner Music Group to add a library of licensed music clips to the Premiere mobile video editing app.

No specific musicians have been announced with this partnership, but Adobe said it will include “popular songs” from “leading artists,” and enable Premiere mobile users to quickly jump on “the latest trend.”
Adobe says this feature is “coming soon,” and will allow Premiere mobile users to: Add up to 60 seconds of a popular track directly to the video.

localization.title: Adobe의 Premiere 모바일 앱에 '주요 아티스트'의 라이선스 음악이 추가됨
summaryLines: Adobe는 Universal Music Group 및 Warner Music Group과 협력하여 라이선스가 부여된 음악 클립 라이브러리를 Premiere 모바일 비디오 편집 앱에 추가하고 있음
이번 파트너십에 구체적인 뮤지션이 발표되지는 않았지만 어도비는 '주요 아티스트'의 '인기곡'을 포함해 프리미어 모바일 사용자가 '최신 트렌드'에 빠르게 뛰어들 수 있도록 할 것이라고 밝힘
Adobe는 이 기능이 "곧 출시될 예정"이며 Premiere 모바일 사용자는 다음과 같은 작업을 수행할 수 있다고 밝힘 · 인기 트랙을 최대 60초까지 비디오에 직접 추가할 수 있음

articles.title: iOS 27.3 brings Apple Intelligence features to China - 9to5Mac
articles.descEn: iOS 27.3 beta 1 is here, and it includes the first Apple Intelligence features in China. Here’s everything to expect.
articles.titleEn: iOS 27.3 brings Apple Intelligence features to China - 9to5Mac
summaryLinesEn: Apple Intelligence launched in the US in October 2024, so users in China have had to wait more than two years for the features to arrive.

Real-time translation across Messages, FaceTime, Phone, and compatible AirPods Siri improvements including Type to Siri, more natural language support, and ability to retain context during a conversation Essentially, none of the new AI capabilities introduced in iOS 27 are included.
iOS 27.3 beta 1 is here , and it includes the first Apple Intelligence features in China.

articles.title: Runway AI Says ARR Set to Double to $450 Million by End of Year
articles.descEn: Runway AI Inc.’s co-Chief Executive Officer said the startup’s annual recurring revenue is set to hit $450 million by the end of the year, more than double the total in September as demand surges for its video-generation software.
articles.titleEn: Runway AI Says ARR Set to Double to $450 Million by End of Year
summaryLinesEn: Runway AI Inc. ’s co-Chief Executive Officer said the startup’s annual recurring revenue is set to hit $450 million by the end of the year, more than double the total in September as demand surges for its video-generation software.
Runway said it had hit $200 million in ARR two months ago.
Anastasis Germanidis , who is also one of the co-founders of the New York-based company, made the comments at the Bloomberg Tech conference in London.

articles.title: Apple warns of risks related to AI agents behaving in 'unintended or unpredictable' ways
articles.descEn: Apple’s annual filing warns that AI agents could exceed permissions, resist instructions or take actions that are difficult to reverse.
articles.titleEn: Apple warns of risks related to AI agents behaving in 'unintended or unpredictable' ways
summaryLinesEn: Here's why measuring water usage is hard Nintendo Switch 2 sales plunge 41% as price hikes and memory crunch bite Hyperscalers and Apple surge after election results remove investor uncertainty Separately, the ability of agents to use a computer in human ways is forcing big companies like Amazon and JPMorgan Chase to come up with policies around agentic access to services for strategic or security reasons.
Earlier this year, OpenAI released Dots, and Meta introduced Muse.
The new risk factors in Apple's filing show the disruptive potential of AI agents, which have proliferated across the business world.

articles.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Joins $700 Million Hark Funding Round In AI Assistant Bet
articles.descEn: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) joined Nvidia and AMD in a US$700 million Series A funding round for AI startup Hark, which is valued at US$6b. Hark is working on foundation models, software, and AI-focused hardware aimed at a next generation personal assistant platform. Qualcomm Ventures' participation links the chip designer to Hark's efforts to build AI systems that could reach consumer devices over time. Qualcomm's move into Hark's Series A round sits alongside other shifts in its AI ambitions...

summaryLinesEn: Ⅰ 新たな産業振興に関する地方創生の功罪 Ⅱ 高付加価値化のための「編曲」 Ⅲ 束ね役を束ねる「指揮者」候補 Ⅳ 持続する地域ビジネスとは何か 日本の地域には、歴史・文化に根差した一次産品や製造技術、観光資源など、輸出やインバウンドで外貨を稼ぐポテンシャルが数多く眠っている。

articles.title: Speeding up planning decisions with AI
articles.descEn: PlanAssist, developed with the UK government, handles routine planning checks to reduce householder assessment times by up to 58% across local authorities.
articles.titleEn: Speeding up planning decisions with AI
summaryLinesEn: For the economy, they slow progress toward the UK government's goal of building 1.5 million new homes by 2029.
Designed to support human judgement, the tool speeds up routine checks while ensuring planning officers retain the final say on every application.
PlanAssist has shown it can cut the time planning officers spend assessing householder applications by up to 58%.

summaryLines: 경제 측면에서는 2029년까지 150만 채의 신규 주택 건설을 목표로 하는 영국 정부의 목표 달성을 지연시키고 있음
인간의 판단을 지원하도록 설계된 이 도구는 일상적인 점검 속도를 높이는 동시에 기획 담당관이 모든 신청에 대한 최종 결정권을 유지하도록 보장함

articles.title: Claude accelerates protein design and analytical chemistry
articles.descEn: Two results show how Claude helps life sciences researchers speed up their work: designing protein binders from scratch and analyzing NMR and LC-MS data to speed chemical analysis.
articles.titleEn: Claude accelerates protein design and analytical chemistry
summaryLinesEn: The protein design and analytical chemistry tasks described below are representative of the work that makes up some parts of the early stages of the drug development process.

Accelerating these phases is one component of our much larger effort to speed up drug development end-to-end, many aspects of which have more to do with policy and operational bottlenecks than with improvements in core scientific capabilities.
Second, we share how Claude Opus 5 performed on an analytical chemistry task, demonstrating how general-access models can support the routine and time-intensive aspects of research.

localization.title: Claude는 단백질 설계 및 분석 화학을 가속화함
summaryLines: 아래에 설명된 단백질 설계 및 분석 화학 작업은 약물 개발 프로세스의 초기 단계 중 일부를 구성하는 작업을 대표함
이러한 단계를 가속화하는 것은 신약 개발을 전체적으로 가속화하려는 훨씬 더 큰 노력의 한 구성 요소이며, 그 중 많은 측면은 핵심 과학적 역량의 개선보다는 정책 및 운영 병목 현상과 더 관련이 있음
둘째, Claude Opus 5가 분석 화학 작업을 어떻게 수행했는지 공유하여 일반 접근 모델이 연구의 일상적이고 시간 집약적인 측면을 어떻게 지원할 수 있는지 보여줌

articles.title: Claude-shaped science
articles.descEn: Matthew Schwartz describes what happened when he stopped fighting Claude and allowed Claude to find “Claude-shaped” problems. This led him to build BootLoops, a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science, which he has been applying across scientific fields alongside experts.
articles.titleEn: Claude-shaped science
summaryLinesEn: Knowing where the amplitude is infinite (its “singularities”) might narrow it to 20,000 options; a symmetry cuts that to 500; and so on down to one.
Matthew Schwartz returns to describe a new approach to AI-accelerated science.
Because similar calculations often turn up across very disparate areas of science, Claude found connections to ecology, population genetics, and a dozen other fields.

이는 적어도 부분적으로 광고 자금의 최대 94%를 Meta의 Facebook 및 Instagram에 투자하는 El-Sayed의 전략으로 설명됨 · 여기서 노출 비용은 일반적으로 Texas PAC가 대규모 투자를 한 Linear TV와 같은 기존 채널보다 훨씬 저렴함

articles.titleEn: Lakebase Postgres is now generally available on Google Cloud | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Lakebase is a key component of the Lake Transactional/Analytical Processing (LTAP) architecture which allows organizations to unify their data foundation, decrease operational overhead and lower infrastructure costs.
The result is a Postgres database that scales with your application, shares one governance model with the rest of your data estate, and reduces your total cost of ownership.
Lakebase Postgres, a fully managed, serverless Postgres database, is now generally available on Google Cloud.

articles.title: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
articles.descEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report reveal the benefits and challenges of implementing AI.
articles.titleEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
summaryLinesEn: For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.

Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.
